(36)be/:rerjes ske stun sheste /)krung da rag pa ba 'jug gnas bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

phal po che/ nyami (36)0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ 3sum cu pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/(smad) 3sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sa bcu'i le'u/ 355sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ kun tu bzang pos bstan pa'i le'u/ 604sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ ting nge 'dzin bcu'i le'u/ 618sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ mngon par shes pa'i le'u/ 751sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ bzod pa'i le'u/ 774sum cu rtsa drug pa/ sems kyi rgyal pos dris nas grangs la 'jug pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 807sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ che'i tshad kyi le'u/ 825sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas kyi le'u/ 827bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1027)

tsho sa5ci gar ri45 ༄5sku/cigadisho ༷ ring༄55 )dzes da gci 4444574༷༷45/rngos / sto bsku'i5༄༄snyen nariri pa richodu/rtsa ri shā gu /su'i lha ts+tsha ri 81 /she ci 4 ga ni — mi ci 0tsho ru stong ko rme/ snyo ri rdo lardo snyo snatsho gyi (nya ma)tre/ rdo spya4 rte //sto ṭaX tsho du ༷ stsi/ ro/(rdo ༷ //ṭ+wāṃ rdzi ske go ge de che la r+sha ci cho chi ga ci ga sku haṃ r+sha rdzi / nga ——— ga sne ci ci ོ lte mi mo ci /tsho mi mu 0( la/kyi / nga sgros cing ji sa ci sngo ru bye ji ci ci cing kho /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs che/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /
tsha/rdo༄:dro rica / 4 6 na4 phung tshog ba ca /ga༄ 4 57/bste kho /rmad byung thugs bskyed go cha can/ /phul byung byang sems nor bzang zhabs/ /
cu la kun ma na nga' rang sabazlas ༄ rmad bang thags ba da canachu rngo rī d+ngha 4 4 50 ༄ 4'i ngo na nocha' ba sas 'jam dnga' dbangs phal bang bang sams ra bshing 'basakyu ri 4 / spa lhu 4 rī /

༄ga /sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/91༄tshog / sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/m+mu /bam po dang po'o/ /lakye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yongs su bsngo 55ba sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par bskyed pa zhes bya ba gsum pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis noyongs su bsngo ba la yang rjes su slob bo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 7yongs su bsngo ba la'ang 8)rjes su slob bo / /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis9)yongs su bsngo ba la'ang rjes su slob po/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 1 7spyod pa'i tshe/mi 11mthun 12pa ma yin zhing yid du 'ong 1lhab 'am/ mi mthun pa ma yin zhing yid du 'ong bar reg pa 'am/ mi mthun pa ma yin zhing yid du 'ong ba'i chos sam/36—3

mi mthun pa ma yin zhing kha na ma tho ba myed pa rnam 1par dag pa/ dge ba yangs pa/ 'od gsal ba/ gang gis yid dga' ba skye zhing bde bar 'gyur ba / dang ba skye ba/ dga' ba skye ba/ rab tu dga' bar gnas pa/ spro ba rab tu 'byung ba yid mi bde ba rnam par bzlog pa/ sems bde bar 'gyur ban / nyams dga' bar 'gyur ba/ bsam pa 'jam par 'gyur ba dang da /dbang po sim par 'gyur ba'i cagazugs gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad mthong bar gyur te/ de bde ba'i 'du shes nade dag mthong ba'i tshe/ 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ bdag gi 6bde ba yongs su bsngo ba 'dis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa'i bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / phyi phyir zhing yang ldan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba mtshungs pa myed pas yang dag par gzung bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje chen po'i bde ba mtha' yas pa 7)phyir zhing yang 8shin tu brtan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa'i bde ba tshad med pa dang 9yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul tshad myed pas shin tu gzung 1 bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba'i bde ba rnyed par dka' bas shin tu khyab par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi stobs kyi71bde ba tshad myed pas shin tu bde bar gyur nya cig /tshor ba thams cad zhi zhing skye ba med pa'i 1 bde bas 'gyur ba med par bde bar 'gyur cig /chags pa med par gnas pa rtag tu mnyam par gzhag75pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde ba gnyis su med cing yang dag par spyod pas 'khrug pa myed pa'i hu9bde bar gyur cig ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos dge ba'i rtsa ba de 36—4

dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yongs su bsngos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yongs su bsngo ba byed de/ 'di ltar bsam pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su ma dag pa 3)rnams yongs su dag par bya ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / byang chub kyi sems rdo rje lta bu shin tu brtan par bya ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go ca (7phyir mi ldog pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba dang /byang chub tu gzhol ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsrung ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyedam pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par spyod pa thob par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'ishedabang po thams cad kyi mngon par shes pa shin tu rno bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du thug lgopar 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ste/ de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don du yongs su bsngo'o/ /de yang dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu na se gol gtogs pa tsam ④du sangs rgyas zhi ba'i sgra thos sam/ chos nyan tam/'phags pa'i dge 'dun bebasnyen bkur byed dam/ gang ci yang rung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la bar chad med par yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yongs su rdzogs par yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa rab tu sbyor bar yongs su bsngo'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rim gro〈shebya bar yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar yongs su 36—5

bsngo'o / /sems rnam par dag par yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos khong du chud par yongs su bsngo'o/ /tshad myed pa'i yon tan la rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /mngon par shes pa dang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos kyi the tsomatsha37rnam par bstsalas 5)ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /ji ltar nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnam par dag pa bstan pa la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la yongs su bsngo ba de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la'ang yongs su bsngo ste( no/ 'di ltar sems can dmyal ba'i lam rnam par bzlog pa'i 45phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /byol songapo)gi skye gnas rgyun gcad phyopa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten rtsa 7ba nas 'chad rinyepa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /ngan song gi rgyud thams cad ma lus par rgyun gcadamathosapa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang bla na myed pa'i byang chub tu mos shing phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa rab tu thob 3 ripar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mi spang ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa shin tu bde ba thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad shin tu rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad ye shes mtha' yas pa khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yang rung ste/ byang chub tu dmyigs pa dang ma 11bral ba'i sems dang /thams cad mkhyen par 12dmyigs pa la brtson pa'i yid la byed pa dang / bdag 36—6

gdul ba dang pha rol gdul ba la gzhol ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / bdag dang gzhan yongs su sbyin 17par sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mitshul dang ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang bas yongs su smin par byed pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / sems bskyed pa gnas pa med pa dang /'grogs pa'i mnyam par gzhag pa dang / sngon snying rje chen po bskyed pas khyim na gnas pa dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas rang gi chung ma'i rjes su 'brang ba dang / sbyor ba nyams pa myed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam shin tu rnam par dag pas brtson gepa dang / yang dag par brtson ge pa dang /sgrubalgepa dang / yang dag par sgrub 6)pa dang / skyed pa dang yang dag par skyed 7pa dang / dmyigs pa chen pos yang dag par sdud pa dang / grub par byed pa dang ske/ rgya cher byed pa dang / yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / khyim na gnas pa dang / bu dang 'grogs shing gnas pa na 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/byang chub sems dpa' khyim na gnas pa'i tshe gang ci yang rung ste/ gos dang zas dang mal stan dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad dang 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang / spyod pa dang ldan pa nadang / stan khapa dang / skye mched 'byung ba'i las dang / spyod lam la gnas pa dang / spyod lam brtul ba dang /lus dang ngag gi las spyod pa dang / dbang po drug bsdams pa dang / rang gi lus phyi ba dang / mnye ba dang / khrus byed pa dang / zos pa dang /'thungs pa dang / 'chos pa dang / myangs pa dang / brkyang ba hu nodang /brkumatsha11pa dang / lta ba dang / kun tu lta ba dang / log pa dang / sad pa dang ske/ rang gi lus brten nya par bya banyusnye/ de dag thams cad byang chub sems 36—7

dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen par dmyigs pa la brtson pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar sems pa1/ byang chub tu smon lam tshad med pa btab pa sems tshad myed pa dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po yongs su sdud ripa/ 'gro ba thams cad bskyab (par brtson pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la rtag tu brtson pa/ rlom pa dang bag myed pa rnam par bzlog pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid la rab tu brten 4pa/ rnam par shes pa dang sems bskyed pa dang / yid la byed pa gzhan med gepa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub la mngon par gnas pa nyon mongs pa'i phyogs thams cad las phyir (5phyogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa la slob pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam nyams pa myed pa/ ye shes kyi sa la rtenamame pa/ bstan pa'i gnas 8dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa bas shes rab che ba/ bung ba bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs chen po stsogs 9pa/ 'gro ba thams cad las 3 )rgyud shin tu 'phags pa/ 'du byed la mngon par zhen pa myed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdams 11ngag 'thun par 'dzin pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ma bsngos pa gang yang med de/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyim na gnas pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yang dag pa sdud cing sgrub bo12/ /yongs su bsngo ste de ltar de chung ngu na khyi'i lam gyi rgyud du gtogs pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byol song gi rigs nyi su gtogs pa la zas sna 'ga' 'amanya / kham ska'aga' yongs su gtong ba byed kyang de thams cad de dag nyid la phan pa dang / de dag nyid la bde ba dang / byol song 7gi skye gnas nyu tsho36—8

de dag sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho de dag dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyud 1de dag dang /sdug bsngal gyi phung po de dag dang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de dag dang / sdug bsngal gyi bstsags 3pa de dag dang / sdug bsngal mngon par 'du byed pa de dag dang / tsha 3sdug bsngal gyi gter de dag dang / sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba de dag dang ske/ sdug bsngal gyi skye mched de dag nas sems can de dag yongs su sgrol zhing rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /de la dmyigs pas sems can thams cad mngon du byed do/ /dmyigs par byed do/ /yid la byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang de dag la yang sngon ci du 'gro bar byed dor/ /'di ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pas yongs su 'dzin to/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la nye bar 'jog go/ /'khor ba'i dgon pa las 6)rnam par bzlog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi bde ba bsgribs napa med pa 8yang mngon du byed rdo9)/ /'khor ba'i rgyud las 'byin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos la brtson pa'i byams pas kyang yongs su rgyas par byed do/ /snying rje chen pos kyang de dag la snying brtse bar byed de/ bde ba 7rnam par dag pa yang de dag la yongs su bsngo'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir yang rab tu 'jug ste/ de dag sangs rgyas kyi chos la nye bar sdud do/ /de dag bdud kyi yul las rnam par bzlog go/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'jug par byed do/ /de dag 'jig rten gyi rgyud thams cad las gyen du skyod par byed do/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs la yang dag par bsgrub 17par byed do/ /de dag dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la rab tu gzhog ste / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci yang rung ste yang dag 36—9

par bsgrubs 1pa dang / yang dag par bsgrub pa dang /na yang dag par bsgrub par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ 'di snyam ④du sems bskyed de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sngonam byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 6spyod cing sangs rgyas la57rim gro mdzad pa'i dmyigs pa dang ske/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi dmyigs pa la brtson par mdzad rme pa'i tshe/gzugs la gnas pa myed pa dang / tshor ba la mngon par ma chags pa dang /'du shes kyi rnam pa phyin ci log med 9pa dang 'du byed mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa dang / rnam par shes pa mngon par chags pa myed pa dang / skye mched drug las gyen du 'phags pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos dang mi 'grogs pa dang /'jig rten las 'das par yongs su bsngo ba dang / nam mkha' lta bu'i chos 'byam 1 klas pa rab tu mkhyen pa dang / chos thams cad gnas med par rab tu rtogs pa dang / chos thams cad ma skyes pas 'byung ba dang / chos thams cad ma 'gags par 11gzigs pa dang / mi bden pa'i chos thams cad la mngon par chags pa las gyen du 'phags pa dang / chos thams cad mi brdzun /2zhing bden par gzigs pa dang / chos thams cad 'pho ba med pa la shin tu mos pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 1 yang dag pa'i mtha' mnyam pa k+ṣal gnas pa dang / chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid las shin tu 'phags pa dang / chos de lta bu'i mtshan nyid can thams cad rang bzhin myed pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa dang / sgo kun nas dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrub 15pa la brtson pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis gzigs pa thams cad la shin tu gzhol bsal/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs 36—10

su bsngos pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang chos nyid de dag kho na la mos par bya ste ske/ chos de lta bu la brtson pa'i sems bskyed pa/ chos thams cad dang ②mi 'gal ba/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las byung bad no/ myig yor dang chu zla lta bu'i rjes su song ba dang / me long gi50dkyil 'khor la gdong gi dkyil 'khor yod pa lta bu'i rgyud ⑤dang ldan pa'i las kyi yimathu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i mthar phyin par las kyi rgyu yongs su shes pas yongs su bsngo'o/ /zhes sems bskyed dedu/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rjes su slob cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /'das pa rnams la ji lta ba de bzhin du ma byon pa dang /de bzhin du da ltar byung bama'o/dang / de bzhin du 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba'i rjes su bslabs te/ ri/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /yang 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' hu1dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di ltar yongs su bsngo'o/ /zhes bya bar thugs su chud pa de lta bu'i bsngo ba rab dam pa mchog /bla na med pa mnyam pa myed pa/mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa12/ 'dra ba myed pa/ mtshungs pa myed pa/ gtso bor gyur pa/ thu bor gyur pa/nya kun tu snyoms pa/ myi mnyam pa myed pa/bdag nyid che ba shin tu yangs pa/ dge ba rnam par dag pa kha na ma tho ba myed pa/ brjod du med pas 36yongs su bsngo'o snyam du sems bskyed de/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de ltar yongs su bsngo ba ni lus kyi las rnam par dag pas lus rnam par dag pa yin/ ngag gi las rnam par dag pas ngag rnam 36—11

par dag pa yin/ yid kyi las rnam par dag pas yid rnam par dag pa yin/kha na ma tho ba med pa la gnas pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa yin / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i las dang ldan pas dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson pa yin / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu brtson pas sems nyams pa med pa yin / chos thams cad byed pa med pa la tsho1zhugs pas shin tu che ba la gnas pa yin / 'jig rten gyi chos kyis ma gos pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos dang 'byor pa yin/ ye shes dang ldan pa'i namangon par shes pa'i las dang ldan pas las 'byam klas pa mtha' dang dbus 4med pa thams cad rab tu shes pa yin/gnas pa thams cad yang dag par bcom pas yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa yin ter / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba gsum pa sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par bskyed pa zhes bya ba ste bsngo ba de la gnas pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin di tsholas kyi zil dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi phun sum 75tshogs pa la zhugs pa yin/ye shes kyi yul la zhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i las dang ma bral ba yin / thabs mkhas pa rnam par dpyod pa 8la mkhas pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings la rab tu zhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpas 9yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i phyir1 / mtshams sbyor ba la mkhas pa dang ldan pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs 11dang rgyud du chud pa yin/ chos thams cad kyi rgyus 12mtha' dang dbus med pa la mkhas pas rab tu dbye bar 1 khong du chud pa yin / 'jig rten du skye bar snang 1 yang 'jig rten gyi chos kyis dmi brjod pa 36—12

yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyiḍūrlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam ②par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /de dag bsngo ba bslab pa bslabs dpa ste/ /skyes bu'i gtso bo ji snyed 'das pa dang / /gang dag ma byon gang dag bzhugs pas snarnams / /de dag spyod pa55narjes su dpa' ba slob/ /bde ba ji snyed gang dag rgyu ba dang / /skyes bu'i gtso bos gang dag rab bsngags pa/ /myig du 'ong zhing dag pa rgya chen rnams/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa rnams la 56)yongs su bsngo/ /lus kyi bde ba gang dag shes57pa dang / /myig bde de bzhin rna ba'i bde ba dang ske/ /sna dang lce yis3)bde ba mtha' yas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba kun la yongs su bsngo/ /'gro ba kun na dge ba gang yod pa/ /skyes bu 'dul bas thugs su chud pa59)rnams/ /de dag thams cad ma lus bsdu 1 byas te/ /'jig rten phan phyir de la rjes su dga'/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i de la dgar byas nas/ /skyes bu'i 61seng ge'i bde ba gang mnga' ba/ /de 'dra'i bde dang 'gro ba ldan gyur ces/rte/ /'gro ba kun la de dag bsngo ba byed/ /'jig rten dag na bde kyi 'gyur gang yod pa/ /skyes bu dam pas nyi thugs su chud pa 8rnams/ / bde ba de dang 'gro kun ldan 'gyur79te/ /'jig rten sgron 1 ma bzhin du kun gyur cig /bde ba de dag yongs su bsngo byed kyang / /mtshungs med rtag tu 'gro phan byed pa dag /sems can phan par rtag tu zhugs pa 3shernams/ /yongs su bsngo bas rlom sems nam yang myed/ /de ltar de dag yongs su bsngo ba na/ /tshe rabs skyes bu seng ge ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i dam par bsod nams 'di gyur cigatunye /snying rje chen pos sems kyang ni riyongs su bskyed(1/ /'jig rten 'di na 36—13

byang chub spyad spyod cing / /'gro ba dag gyo)tu ji ltar las bsgrubasalgepas/ /rgyal bas ji ltar mkhyen pa gematshungs med pa'ibu/ /bde ba kun dang 'bral bar ma gyur 5cig /gang yang 'gro ba kun na yod pa yiger/ /skye mched bsdams pa yang dag skyes pa 7rnams/ /ye shes ngang gis bslab bya bslabs phyapa dag / skye dgu 9kun la phan phyir yongs su bsngo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi rnams / /gang yang rung ba'i lam la 3) yod pa dag /ye shes ngang gis bslab bya bslabs pa 31rnams/ /gti mug myed pas yongs su bsngo ba byed(ni/ /ji snyed de dag rab tu spyod pa nya rnams/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi k+ṣayang dag bsdu bya ba/ /de ni mtshungs med rgyal ba'i rjes su byung 1ge/ /de dag zhi ba'i yid phyir yongs su bsngo / /'jig rten thams cad ma lus bsdu byas te/ /'gro yangs 'di na ji snyed dge yod pa/ /bde ba de dang yongs su ldan pa'i phyir/ /de la de dag yongs su bsngo ba byed/ /bdag la bde ba nam yang mi tshol te/ /bde ba kun la'ang rtag par rab tu zhugs/ /spros pa rnams la nam yang mos pa myed/ /bdag med chos la'ang rtag par 'jug pa yin/ /rgyal ba kun gyis ji snyed gzigs pa yi/ /rgyal sras ji snyed yod pa de dag phyir/ /myur du ma lus sangs rgyas gyur cig ces/ /bsod nams de dag yongs su bsngo ba byed/ /bdag gis legs bstsags salas ni gang yod pa/ /de yis 1 'jig rten ma lus thams cad kyi/ /lam rgyud 18'gro bar gtogs pa'i sems can rnams/ /de dag ma lus mi yi gtsor gyur cig19 /smon lam mang po ji snyed gang yod pa/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyal bas bstan pa 2 rnams/ /rgyal sras bsam pa yongs su grub gyur te/ /smon lam de dag rnam par dag gyur cig /'jig rten ji snyed 36wa 14

las kyis ga(rnam bris pa/ /phyogs na yod pa thams cad mthong nas kyang / /de dag yongs btsal bslab bya bslabs pa'i 2rnams/ /ma lus bsod nams thams cad yongs su bsngo/ /gnyis kyi chos kyis 'jal bar mi byed de/ /gnyis med chos ni de dag mngon par shes/ /gnyis su myed caskudang gnyis su myed pa la/ /rgyal 5/sras de dag bsam pa mi rton 6to/ /'gro ba'i 'du shes rgyu ba 7 ji snyed pa'i/ /ma lus 'jig rten 'du shes 'jug nabyed kyang / /'gro ba'i 'du shes rgyu ba rab rtogs pas/ /'du shes yod myin 'du shes med mi 'gyur/ /de dag lus kyis yongs su dag gyur cig9 /de dag yid kyang yongs su dag pa yin / /de dag ngag gis shin tu bsdams byas shing / /de dag yid kyis yongs su dag pa yin/ /de dag bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa dran/ /ma byon sangs rgyas de dag rjes su sems/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang //de dag rjes slob chos rnams ston pa byed/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ye shes mkhas pa 1 rnamasal/ /chags pa med pa'i thugs kyis ji 11lta bur/ /byang chub don phyir phrin las bsgrub 12mdzad pa/ /de dag 'jig rten phan phyir yongs su bsngo/ /mchog gi blo dang tshul khrims ldan pa'i blo/ /bden pa'i blo dang gzhan du mi 'gyur blo/ /yang dag blo dang rnam par dag pa'i blo/ /de 'dra'i blo yi 1nadam pas yongs su bsngo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par bskyed pa zhes bya ba ste yongs su bsngo ba gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 1 yongs su bsngo ba bzhi pa thams cad du 15rjes su song ba zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson par byed pa'i tshe/36—15

dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ 'di ltar yang dag pa'i mtha' thams cad 1rjes su song zhing dngos po thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang /'gro ba thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi〈mirjes su song ba dang / zhing thams cad kyi rjes su songs ba dang / chos thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / nam mkha' thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / dus gsum thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / spyod pa'i sgra thams cad kyi rjes su song ba de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad du rgyas par khyab par gyur cig /'das 4)pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i rgyur gyur 5cig /ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i 9rgyur gyur 0nicig /da ltar byung ba'i dus kyi 'jig rten gyi 2khams nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa/ lha rdzas dang / lha rdzas ma yin pa'i rim gro 'byam ri'oklas pa dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan gyi 1 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyan rnam par bkod 31pa'i rgyur gyur 12cig /blo bdag nyid che ba la mos shing shin tu yangs pa'i don du bsgribs pa 15med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rgya cher yongs su bsngo ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad sems bskyed pas rgyas par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang midabus med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / nam mkha'i dbyings 'byam tshaklas pa la rab tu 36—16

gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud dang / las gzhan dang gzhan gyis shin tu bsgrubs pa'i phyogs 'byamamagyo)klas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med par rnam par rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi khongs mtha' yas pa dang mi/ sangs rgyas kyi dmyigs pa la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams du ma dang / 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs 'byams klas pa dang / sa mtshams myed pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'khor dang snrel zhir rgyu ba'i (ge'ajig rten gyi khams mngon par grub pa dang /spyi'u tshugs su rgyu ba'i phyogs kyi 'khor gyi rgyud kyi 5'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 6klas pa dang / sems kyi 3)'khor mtha' dang dbus med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam (ni kyiklas pa shin tu bstan pa thams cad ma lus pa de dag na phyi /bzhugs shing 'tsho 7ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul yang dag par ston nya1pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings su rtsa ba ma rnyed pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su gzung bar bsgrub 12pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs nya yang dag par ston pa dang ge/ sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa ye shes 'byam tshaklas pa'i mngon par shes pas tethugs su chud pa/ rab tu brjod pa rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pas rab tu byung ba/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi rjes su song ba tha mi dad pa'i chos kyi dbyings gzhi mnyam pa 1 la rab tu zhugs pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i lus su gcig pa/ chos thams cad kyis 1narab tu zhugs pa med pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la lha/yang dag par ston pas na 3 phyir ldog 21pa med pani / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snyemangon par bsgrub 3 7pa la 36—17

mkhas pa thugs su chud pas thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis shin tu 'phags pa/ bsgribs 37pa med pa'i byin gyi rlabs zhukyis phyir mi ldog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas yang dag par byung ba'i phyir chags pa med par gzigs pa'i bdag nyid che ba can bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la me tog gam/ spos sam / phreng ba 'am/ byug pa 'am/ gdugs sam/ rgyal mtshan nam/ ba dan nam/ rin po che 'am/ me mar gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'am/mchod rten la 'ang ri rung ste/ dmyigs pa tshad med pas sbyar ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i ra tshogs thams cad kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dang gang bskyed 6)kyang rung ste/'khrug pa med pa'i sems dang rtse gcig tu gyur pa med ri)ripa'i sems dang /g.yo ba med pa'i sems dang / rmongs pa med pa'i sems dang / myi sgul ba'i sems dang / gnas med pa'i sems dang / myi gnas pa'i sems dang /srog med pa'i sems dang / myi g.yeng ba'i sems dang / zhi ba'i sems su byas ten/ 'di ltar yongs su bsngo zhing / 'di snyam du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di chos kyi dbyings shin tu bstan pas 'dus 9pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad comakhyen pa'i byang chub kyis 'dus pa'i mying mang po dang / tshig dang nges pa'i ngag mtha' yas pa dang / dus tha dad par mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang 11/ phyi ma'i mthar thug 12pa'i bskal par byin gyis brlabs7rtepa'i sku che'i tshad dang / mtha' dang dbus med par shin tu bstan pa'i sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 36—18

byang chub kyis tsho)rgyas pa dang / chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings yongs su gang ba'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 5dus ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par ston pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi spos kyi gdugs tshad med pa ciyongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi rgyal mtshan tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi ba dan tshad byu ༷med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi gzhal med khang tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi dra ba 5tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi sku gzugs tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi 'od tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi 'od gzer 6tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung 7 ribar gyur cig /spos kyi sprin tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi gdan tshad myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi 'chag sa tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi gtsug lag khang tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi zhing tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi ri rab tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi chu klung tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi shing tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi na bza' tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi pad mo tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /spos kyi pho brang tshad med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /me tog gi gdugs dpag tu med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/36—19

tshul de bzhin du me tog gi 1)pho brang gi bar du dpag tu named pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /phreng ba'i gdugs grangs med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/ phreng ba'i pho brang gi bar du grangs med pas niyongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /byug pa'i gdugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/ byug pa'i pho brang gi bar du bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /phye ma'i gdugs mtshungs pa myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/ phye ma'i pho brang gi bar du mtshungs pa med par geyongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /na bza'i gdugs kun tu mtha' yas pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces 5bya ba nas/ na bza'i pho brang gi bar du kun tu mtha' yas pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /rin po che'i gdugs kun tu mu med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/ rin po che'i pho brang gi bar du kun tu mu yi myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /mar me snang ba'i gdugs 3rigazhal du myed pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /ces bya ba nas/mar me snang ba'i pho brang gi bar du gzhal du med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /lhab lhub kyi gdugs brjod du med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas/ lhab lhub kyi pho brang gi bar du brjod du med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /nor bu rin po che'i gdugs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du medalo)pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig ces bya ba nas3 rme/ nor bu rin po che'i pho brang gi bar du brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa yongs su 'byung bar gyur cig /de bzhin du nor bu rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che'i ba dan dang / nor bu rin po che'i bla re dang / nor bu rin po che'i dra ba dang /36—20

nor bu rin po che'i sku gzugs dang / nor bu nyurin po che'i 'od dang / nor bu rin po che'i 'od gzeram dang / nor bu rin po che'i sprin dang / nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang / nor bu rin po che'i 'chag sa dang / nor bu rin po che'i gtsug lag khang dang / nor bu rin po che'i zhing dang / nor bu rin po che'i ri rab dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgya mtsho dang / nor bu rin po che'i chu klung dang / nor bu rin po che'i shing dang / nor bu rin po che'i na bza' dang ske/ nor bu rin po che'i pad mo dang / nor bu rin po che'i pho brang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur cig /dmyigs pa re re la yang grangs med pa'i rgyan rnams 5)kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i gtsug lag khang dag kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i rta babs dag kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i zla gam dag kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i ④rin po che'i pu shu dag kyang 3kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i rin po che'i skar khung 6rnam pa tha dad pa kun nas gnas par gyur cig /rin po che'i kha dog rnam par dag pa grangs med pa kun nas gnas par gyur cig /grangs med pa'i rgyan rnam 7pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa thams cad dang / dpe na med pa dag kun nas gnas par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du shem lus par sangs rgyas kyi rim gro dang / rgyan rnam pa 'di lta bus rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ma lus par stobs bcu'i sar 'byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad shes par bstan pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad ma 36—21

lus pa la chos kyi snang ba bsgribs 1pa med pa skye bar gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad gdul naba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ma lus par yongs su bsngo bar gyur cig /'pho ba med pa'i chos nyid du dus thams cad ma lus pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir nam mkha'i dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dang 'dra ba'i sems tshad med pas zhing thams cad yongs su rgyas par gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad kyis sangs rgyas mthong ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rab tu 'bul bar gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad kyis theg pa chen po shin tu grub pa dang / chos thams cad ma lus pa la mngon par chags pa med par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa la gnas pas/ kun nas gnas par gyur cig /spyod pa mtha' yas pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la yongs su spyod par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la pa'ajug par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'gyur bar shog shigazi /sems can thams cad kyis 6thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag ma lus par rkyen du 'gyur bar shog shig /ci nas kyang bdag med pa'i chos kyi dbyings las chos thams cad 'da' bar mi 'gyur bar nadage ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad la 9bsnyen bkur 1 yongs su spyod pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /chags pa med pa la 'jug pa'i 1 phyir chos thams cad la 15yang dag par zin par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi 1 grogs gcig tu 'thun pa 7yang dag par zin par gyur cig /36—22

byang chub sems dpa'i 3)spyod pa thams cad smon lam yongs su rdzogs pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig bsgribs tshan pa med pa khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i chos snang ba thams cad yang dag par zin par gyur cig mtha' dang dbus myed pa la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /sems tshad med pas yongs su rgyas par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /mi gnyis pa'i snang ba grub pas byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dang spobs pa dang / gzungs kyi sgor 'jug pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po shin tu bstan pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul la mkhas pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /skye ba dang rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang / 'khor lo bskor ba dang /mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / nye bar gshegs pa bstan pa dang / mchod pa dang rim gro sa dang / sems can gdul sgrub la 'jug pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus gsum du byon pa mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad ma lus pa'is skye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bas 7)yang dag par zin par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par bla na myed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su das pas nazin par gyur cig /bskal pa 'byam 9glas pa mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad ma lus par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'brel ba rgyun mi 'chad pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /'jig rten du skye ba'i yul 1 thams cad ma lus 11par thams cad du skye ba 36—23

shin tu bstan pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig sems can gyi khams thams cad ma lus par byang chub sems dpa'i 1 kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas79yongs su sbyin par bya bas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /sems can gyi nyon mongs pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / bag chags thams cad ma lus patre rnyog pa med pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par zin par gyur cig /sems can gyi dbang po 'byam 4klas pa thams cad ma lus par mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad kyi mos pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa thams cad ma lus par nyon mongs pa med cing yongs su dag pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang ske/ gdul sgrub thams cad ma lus par dus la ji ltar 'bab pa bzhin du kun tu bstan pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ma lus par 'gro ba thams cad sprul pa lta bur khong du chud pas yang dag par zin par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad ma lus par sangs rgyas byung ba thams cad kyi bstan pa bzung 6zhing bsrung bas yang dag par zin par gyur cig ces sems bskyed cing 7/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag dmyigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis 8yongs su bsngo ste/ las kyis 9ni rnam par sbyin pa la yongs su rtog par mi byed/ rnam par sbyin pas ni las la yongs su rtog par mi byed de/ chos kyi dbyings rtog pa med pa la yang dag par 'jug go/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa med 1 )pas gnas pa yin no/ /chos nyid g.yeng ba med pa 11la'ang rab tu brtson pa yin no/ /de ni chos thams cad la yang dad pas yang dag par 'jug ste/ chos gang rang bzhin 36—24

gyis yongs su grub par byed pa 'am/ rnam par byed pa de dag gang yang mi mthong ngo / /chos nyid dbang po med pa'i mthar thug pa la yang yang dag par 'jug ste/ chos kyi dbyings lta ba po med par yang tshosnarab tu shes shing chos thams cad shes pa po med par yang parab tu rtogs so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa risarab tu shes pa/ chos thams cad kyi rkyen gyi laganas khong du chud pa'i/ chos thams cad lus pas6)med par rab tu mthong ba/ chos thams cad 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin par rjes su lta ba/ 'jig rten 'gyur ba thams cad sprul pa lta bur rjes su rtogs pa/ chos gcig la sems can thams cad du rjes su mthong ba/ chos kyi dbyings myi gnyis par rab tu 7)rig pa las kyi dmyigs pa dang nye bar len pa la mkhas pas ma btang ba 'dus byas kyi khams 'dus ma byas su mngon par bsgrubs 8pas zhig par mi byed pa/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams 'dus byas su sgro gdags pa thams cad kyis rnam par mi rtog pa/ chos thams cad rab tu zhi ba la gzhol ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par bsgrub 9pa/ thams cad mngon par bsgrub 1 pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab /1par bya ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ chos rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par shes pa rmongs pa med par chos nyid la brtson pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba nam mkha' lta bur 12thams cad yongs su bsngo ba/ bsod nams kyis rgyas par 'gro bas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du zhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos kun nas mi rgyu ba/ myig la rab rib med pa/ ye shes kyi 12snang ba rab tu thob pa/ thabs mkhas pas yongs su bsngo ba'i ngang tshul can de ni nyu4ci nas kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 1536—25

byin gyis brlabs 1pa dang / ci nas kyang zhing thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad nye bar blang bar ༷'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du bsod nams kyi zhing dam par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi ded dpon du thog mar bye'agro ba dang / ci nas kyang snang ba'i dkyil 'khor skye dgu mthams cad la 'char bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyisa'agechos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang yon tan thams cad kyis yesems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par sbyong bar 7'gyur ba/ de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ste/ de de ltar yongs su bsngo bas sangs rgyas kyi rigs yang dag par 'dzin pa yin/ sems can gyi rigs yongs su phyin par byed pa yin / zhing gi rigs rnam par spyod pa 8yin/ chos kyi rigs 'gal bar mi byed pa yin/ las kyi rigs yongs su shes pa yin/ myi gnyis pa'i rigs mnyam par byed pa yin/ phyogs kyi rigs su khyab par 'gro ba yin/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rigs la yang dag par rtog pa yin/ shin tu mos pa'i rigs rab tu sgrub 9pa yin/ dbang po'i rigs shin tu snang bar byed pa yin te / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 1 yongs su bsngo ba bzhi pa ste/ thams cad du rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'o glu/ /de la 1 gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bsngo bar byed de/ de de ltar 1lhabasngo bas 36—26

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i phyir thams cad du rjes su song ba'i lus kyi las rab tu 'thob 1bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rnam par bstan pa bsgribs 5pa med pa'i phyir thams cad kyi narjes su song ba'i ngag gi las rab tu 'thob bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bstan cing gzung ba'i phyir thams cad du rjes su song ba'i yid kyis las rab tu 'thob bo/ /sems can thams cad 5rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i phyir thams cad kyi chi6)rjes su song ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu 'thob bo chos thams cad la stiyang dag par 'jug par bya ba'i phyir thams cad du rjes su song ba'i / chos khong du chud pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /sems can thams cad kyi bsam gupa tshim par bya ba'i phyir thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i gzungs dang spobs pa thob par bya ba rab tu 'thob bo/ /spu'i sbubs gcig tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 1)gzung bar bya ba'i phyir thams cad du rjes su song ba'i chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa rab tu 'thob 1 bo/ /sems can gcig gi lus su sems can thams cad kyi lus yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i phyir thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i lus la 'jug pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /bskal pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba la 'jug pa'i phyir thams cad kyi 1 rjes su song ba'i bskal pa'i grangs la 'jug pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /skad cig gcig gis de bzhin gshegs 12pa 'byung ba thams cad mngon sum du bstan pa'i phyir / thams cad 1 rjes su song ba'i skad cig la 'jug pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 1 rdo rje'i 7rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs gekyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di 36—27

dag smras so/ /'jig rten mtha' dang dbus med gang la yang / /de dag gnas 'cha' gang yang yod pa myin/ /sems can phan pa'i don las phyir mi ldog /mi rab 1de dag ye shes 'di 'dra'o/ /zhing rnams la yang gnas par mi byed de/ /phyogs rnams la yang de dag gnas mi 'cha'/ /tshe zhudang chos kyis rlom sems mi byed de/ /'jig rten dag na ri rnam par rtog mi byed/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na ji 4yod pa'i/ /'gro ba de dag ma lus kun bsdus shing ske/ /dngos po dngos med chos la dbang bsgyur 45'jug /de dag thams cad ma lus dus su bsngo/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi chos blangs shing / /'jig rten 'di la rnam par rtog mi byed/ /ji ltar 'jig rten de bzhin7chos rnams te / /de ltar 'jig rten sgron ma rnam par dag /ji snyed las rnams yang dag com pa gang / /rab dang 'bring dang de bzhin tha ma ge rnams/ /de dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mkhyen pa 9rnams/ /ji snyed bzhugs la yongs su bsngo ba byed/ /de dag yongs su bsngo ba'i mthar phyin pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog skyarjes bslab bya bslabs pa 11rnams/ /ye shes dam pa rjes su sems byed cing / /mi yi 12dam pa'i chos 1 rnams rab tu 'thob/ /sems can phan pa'i don du rtag zhugs shing / /'gro ba kun tu 'jig rten sgron ma bzhin/ /phyogs rnams kun tu ma lus gyur cig ces/ /dge 1 thob de dag yongs su bsngo ba byed/ /de dag sems can rnam par rtog mi byed/ /chos la'ang rnam par rtog pa gemi byed de / /'jig rten gyis kyang rlom sems myed nyi pa yin/ /'gro ba kun nas phyir yang mi ldog 1 go/ /brtan pa de dag zhi rab rab tu zhi18/ /de dag mya ngan 'das pa'i spyod yul thob/ /sems can rgyud na'ang 19mi spyod ma yin te/ /'di 36—28

'dra'i ye shes dam pa khong du chud1)/ /de dag nam yang rtog dang rnam rtog med//rnam par sbyin la'ang bde dag gnas mi 'cha'/ /'jig rten thams cad rgyu dang bcas pas na/ /chos rnams rgyudzaXmed par yang lta ma yin/ /de dag spyod yul 'di 'dra thob pa ste/ /de la rtog dang rnam par rtog pa myed/ /blo mchog de dag 'gro kun kha lo sgyur④/ /ye shes tshul la mkhas pas yongs su bsngo/ /thams cadamachi5)rjes su song ba zhes bya b.lo6)ste/ yongs su bsngo ba bzhi pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/sa bam po gnyisaskosapa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba lnga pa 9)bsod nams myi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag1 /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sgrib nya7pa'i las thams cad las bag 12yongs su bya hu ba'i phyir bshags pa dang 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'am/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 〉thams cad dang /'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi 8dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bas 30rjes su yi rang ba 3 tshodang 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'am38/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la nan tan du byas pas phyag bya ba dang / 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'am/ sangs rgyas kyi 1)chos thams cad la brtson pas sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba gdab pa dang /'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'am/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mi zad pa gang 36—29

la1ske/ byang chub sems dpas nabartson par bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'byam —skuklas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag la yang dag par 'jug par byed pa 'am/ gang yang 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i cadage ba'i rtsa ba de dag la rjes su yi rang bar 5byed cing / 6dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la gnas par byed pa 'am/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang 7/ ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos kyi na'akhor lo bskor bas sems can mtha' dang dbus med pa dul bar gyur pa 9de dag la rjes su yi rang ba 1 chodang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas khong du chud par byed pa 'am/ gang yang 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang po 11thugs bskyed pa nas bzung 1geste / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la yang dag par byung bar gyur pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar gyur pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa yang dag par bstan pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad dang rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa'i ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi 1 rjes su yi rang ba 'amanya / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bstan pa yang dag par bzung thub nas nye bar bzung ste/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i lobar du dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed yang dag par bsgrub 1 par 'gyur ba 'am1 / sangs rgyas la dmyigs 19pa'i bsam pa 'byam 2 klas pa brjod du med pa dang / rang gi 31dmyigs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bstsags na pa de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgribs 2 pa myed par dmyigs par 2 mthar phyin par byed par 2536wa 30

yang rung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par phye ba tshad med cing 'byam 37klas pa/dmyigs pa rgya chen po grangs med pas bstsags tsho pa de dag thams cad 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / gang mos par byas pa —dang / gang rjes 4)su yi rang ba 5dang / gangs6yongs su rdzogs par byas pa dang / gang yongs su grub par byas pa dang / gang spyad pa dang ske/ gang thob par byas pa dang / gang sems pa 7dang / gang rtsom 8pa dang ske/ gang mthu dang ldan par byed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis gang ji snyed du sngon 9 gyi 'das pa'i dus thams cad 'byam 1 klas pa'i dus la 'jug pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams shin tu bstan pa grangs las 'das pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan byung ba dang / gang ji snyed du de bzhin nyid kyi go 11skabs thams cad kyi sngon gyi mu'i bskal pa'i mthar gyur pa/ sa mtshams med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyis thugs su chud pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pas rnam par shes pa / byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyis yang dag par bzung ba dag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su dag pa byung ba dang / gang yang las dang rgyu 'thun pa'i 'bras bu 'am/32 gang yang spyod pa las yang dag par byung 15ba 'am/ gang yang sems can bsgral 1 bar bya ba'i tshogs rnam par bstan pa 'am/ 15gang yang shin tu mos pa rnam par dag pa'ams/ gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1 kyis shes par bya ba 'am/ gang yang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul ba yang dag par bstan pa 'am/ gang yang byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams su rnam par rig 18pa 'am/ gang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin 19las 36—31

'jig rten las 'das pas byung ba 'am/ gang yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa 'byam 17sa pas byung du ba 'am/ gang yang mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis byung stib 'am / phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par mngon par nga'atshang rgya ba rgyun chad pa 9med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 6tshul thams cad shin tu bstan pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis 7klas pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas 8)gtugs pa 'jig (9)rten gyi khams thams cad 'byam 3 klas pa ma 'ongs pa'i dus mtha' yas pa'i rigs sumanyu1 bstan pa ma 'ongs pa'i lam gyi 1 rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa grangs med pa /tsho brjod pa/ma 'ongs pa'i dus rgyun chad 14pa med cing sa mtshams kyi mtha' 0med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis 1'amangon par bsgrubs pas 1 thugs su chud pa/ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi skad cig rgyun chad 18pa med pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang /'jig rten gyi khams dang / bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 17pa thams cad mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyis mngon par 'tshang rgya ba tshad med par gyur 3 pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus sa mtshams 21med cing ris na su mi chod pa dag tu ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rna chos kyi gi4dbyings thams cad du khyab par gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan dang rgyan yongs su dag pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bre ba 25du ma dang / spos kyi rgyan yid du 'ong ba nilhadang /ldan pa thams cad dang / me tog thams cad kyi rgyan gyi char rab tu 'beb pa rme/na bza' thams cad kyi rgyan gyi sprin sna tshogs yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rnam pa tha dad pa'i mdzod de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyan gyi 28byin gyi na rlabs kyis 36—32

rnam par bres pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi 1)rgyan rab tu brgyan par bya ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa ②tha dad pa brjod du med pas rab tu brgyan cing grub pa/ grogs bsam gyis mimi khyab pa rnam par dag pas yongs su bsgrubs pa/de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i byin gyi rtsa)rlabs kyis rgyan gyis pa rnam par dag pa rnams 'byung ci'i bar 'gyur ba dang / gang yang ma myurabyon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par na'atshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mig 'jig rten las 'das pa thun 9rimong ma yin pas rnam par mthong ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i 7mthu chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu myong bar 'gyur ba chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur khong du chud pa/ chos thams cad kyi mthu sprul pa lta bus rnam par dag pa/byang chub sems dpa'i 1 las 'byam 1 klas pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song bas rnam par dag pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pak+ṣ-i lha/ sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba/ yang dag par rgyu ba/ sangs rgyas kyi 'od 7bla na med pas snang bar byas pabo/ rgya che ba sna tshogs patsha/ tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams yang dag par gnas par 'gyur ba dang / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par / tsharab tu byung ba shin tu grub pa rnam par dag pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa /8tha dad pa kun nas yon tan can bsngags par bya ba/ tshad med pa dri zhim po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtha' yas pa19/ shing tshad myed pa dang ldan pa/36—33

rgyan grangs med pa can/ gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong 1ba'i sgra grangs med pa yod pa/ mtha' yas par yang dag par ston pa/rjes su spyod pa'i grogs tshad med pa dang ldan pa / yon tan sna tshogs zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan 5pa/ spos thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phreng ba thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phye ma thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ na bza' thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rgyal mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ba dan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/blirin po che sna tshogs kyi snam bu kun tu bting bas brgyan pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi stegs bus brgyan pa/ gser gyi dra ba grangs med pas kun tu g.yog 5par brgyan pa/ chu klung grangs med pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ grangs med pa'i sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pas brgyan 6pa/ rol mo brdung ba dang dgrol ba'i tshogs grangs med pas yid du 'ong ba 7rnam par dag pa de dag dang / de bzhin du ma lus pa thams cad rab tu bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan dang rgyan 8yongs su dag pa gang ji snyed pa/ gang dang gang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rab tu mkhyen pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa zhing gi gnas su gyur pa thams cad phyogs kyi 'khor mtha' yas par shin tu 9bstan pas phyogs bcur rnam par bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 1 klas pa 11las rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 32mngon par 'dus byas pa/ nam mkha'i khams dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyis yongs su bsdus pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs 1lhagazhan dang gzhan gyi rjes su song bar rab tu gnas pa/ las 1 rnam pa tha dad pas shin tu byung 36—34

ba'i 'jig rten gyi 1khams brjod du med par shin tu bstan pa/ 'jig rten gyi na'abyung gnas nam mkha'i gos gtogs dpa/ zhing gi rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa brjod du med pa 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang cadabus med pa'i chos kyi dbyings pa kyis shin tu bstan pa/ de ltar ma lus pa thams cad yongs su bzung ste / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan 6la 'jug pas 3rgyan rnam par dag pa thams cad dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad ji skad du bshad pa dang / ji skad du bstan pa dang na / ji skad du brjod pa dang 9/ ji skad du gsal bar byas pa dang /ji skad du smos pa dang / ji skad du smras pa dang / ji skad du bslabs nya pa dang —/ ji skad du bkrol 11ba dang / ji lta bur brtags 12pa dang / ji lta bur rnam par bkod pa de dang de dag du de bzhin gshegs pa skyes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dge ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 12bdag nyid che ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yangs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde bar bskyang ba sadang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing zil gyis 15mi non pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing zad mi shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing shin tu che ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing myi 'phrogs sapa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'od gsal ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mthun pa myed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu snang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab tu snang ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par brgyan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 36—35

tu brgyan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing shin tu rnam par tsho)phye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mchog dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gtso bo dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing phul dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dam pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gya rnam pas dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rmad 9du byung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gabla na med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mnyam pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dra ba med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dang / de ltar yongs su bzung 5ste/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan 6rnam par dag pa gang ji snyed pa'i rgyan rnam par dag pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rnam pa 7)'di lta bu'i rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang rina'adas pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 9sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan ji snyed pa de dag thams cad yang dag par gnas par gyur cig /grub par gyur cig /rnam par dag par gyur cig /yongs su dag par gyur cig /yang dag par grub par gyur cig /rab tu byung bar gyur cig /rab tu brgyan par gyur cig /kun tu brgyan 1 par gyur cig / byang bar 31gyur cig /byin gyis brlabs 12par gyur cig /'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu ji lta ba de nyunyebazhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'ang 14ma lus par skabazung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas sagatugs pa thams cad ma lus par de snyed kyi rgyan gyis yongs su brgyan par gnas par gyur cig /36—36

sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ma lus par dus gsum thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gis1)yon tan rnam par phye ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan dang gan/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bdag nyid che ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing blta na myi ngoms gepa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yangs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis myi khyab ④pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtshungs pa med pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa 5ji snyed pa de dag gi rgyan 6gyis rnam par dag par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' yongs su rdzogs pa 7rjes su 'jug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams la rab tu 'jug 8pa/ kun tu spyod pa mang 9ba/ sems can gyi khams rtogs par bya ba nya khong du chud pa/ chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa rab tu rtogs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings la 'jug pa rmongs pa myed pa/ sangs rgyas 11rjes su dran pa rab tu thob pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos rjes su dran pa'i tshul can tshad myed pa'i dge 'dun rjes su dran pa la rab tu zhugs pa/ gtong ba la shin tu mos pa/gtong ba'i rjes su dran pa rab tu thob pa12/ ye shes kyi 'od gzer 1lhadang ldan pa'i chos kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can chags pa 1 myed par 15lta ba dmyigs su med sapa las rab tu byung ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 1 gnas su gyur pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dam pas thog mar 'gro ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 18dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi 19rjes su song ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yul gyi 'od gzer rab tu 'gyed pa/bdud kyi las thams cad rnam par sbyangs pa/ sems can 51gyi khams thams 36—37

cad kyi rang bzhin khong du chud pa/ phyin 1 ci log myed pas yang dag par byung ba / dge ba'i rtsa ba dang smon lam la gti mug myed pa sha stag gis yongs su gang bar gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i tshul can de lta bu'i spyod pa la nazhugs pa de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa dge ba'i rtsa ba rnamatshungs pa myed pa can rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi phrin palas la gzhol ba/ sangs rgyas kyi 5byang chub snang ba rab tu thob pa/ mun pa myed pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang ldan pa/chos kyi dbyings thams cad lus gcig gis 6khyab par byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po yang dag par 7ston pa/ ye shes chen po khong du chud pas 8)thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi spyod yul dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa'i tshig rab tu dbye ba/ mngon par bsgrub 9pa la mkhas pa/ zhing thams cad kyi rjes su song ba gnas med 1 par sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na gnas pa/nam mkha'i dbyings su mos pas myi gnas pa'i yid dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rnam par phye ba'i bsam pa can/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnyam par gzhol ba 11la mkhas pa/thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing la gnas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs /shes par bya ba la mkhas pa/ chos grangs myed pa bstan cing bshad pa la 'jigs 1 pa myed pa/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i rjes su song ba/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chos 5bstan pa tshoyongs su 'dzin pa/ sgra bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par dbye zhing mngon par bsgrub 1 pa la mkhas pa18/ grangs myed pa'i skad 36—38

rnam pa tha dad pa shes pa/ bla na myed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i sa khong du chud pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rjes su song zhing chags pa myed par spyod pa/ nyon mongs pa myed pa'i chos kyi tshul la chos su rtogs 1pas gnas pa myed pa/ sems bskyed (2)pa yangs pa shin tu rnam par bsgoms pa rab tu thob pa/ ye shes gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyud 5skul mkhas pa/ don gcig nas gcig tu bstan pa rab tu grub pa/ de lta bu dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag yongs su brgyan par gyur cig /yongs su gang bar gyur cig /rnam par mdzes par gyur cig /rjes su dong bar gyur cig /kun tu gnas par gyur cig / bsgoms par gyur cig /5shin tu bsgoms par gyur cig /sbyangs par gyur cig /shin tu sbyangs par gyur cig /zhi bar byed 6par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing re re'i phyogs re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' 7tshad myed pa na/grangs myed pa 9bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzhal du med pa/ mu myed pa/ sa mtshams myed pa/ dpag tu myed pa/ brjod du med pa/1 brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du myed pas yongs su rgyas par gyur cig /phyogs gcig ji lta ba de 11bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ ma lus pa lus pa myed pa/ lhag ma myed pa thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' 'di lta bu'i tshul can gyis yongs su rgyas shing yongs su gang bar gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ste/ tshul de lta bus sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / tshul de lta bus 'byung ba thams cad dang / tshul de 12lta bus sems can 1 gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / tshul de lta 36—39

bus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub dang / tshul de lta bus smon lam thams cad dang / tshul de lta bus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sangs rgyas skyes pa mthong ba dang / myi 'bral ba dang / tshul de lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i ༄1 sku tshe tshad myed pa dang / tshul de lta bus thogs pa myed par / chos kyi dbyings thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ phyir myi ldog pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ji ge sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i byang chub sems dpa' yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi skye ba thams cad kyis ma lus par gang bar byas pa'i chos kyi dbyings yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ma lus par shin tu byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / thams cad mkhyen par 5'byung bar bgo skal 6med par 7yongs su bsngos pa dang / nam mkha'i khams tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba'i sems kyi sa dang / yongs su bsngo ba'i tshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su zhugs pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba mnyam pa nyid las kyi rnam par smin pa thams cad las rnam par grol zhing shin tu mos pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba'i khyad par mtha' yas par 'brel bar byas pa dang ske/8 yongs su bsngo ba'i tshul chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi rjes su song bas yongs su bsngo ba'i tshe bdag la mi rtog go/ /bdag gi lus la 9 rnam par mi rtog go/ / sangs rgyas la mi rtog go/ /1 sangs rgyas kyi chos la rnam par mi rtog go/ /zhing la mi rtog go/ /zhing gi yang dag par spyod 11pas rnam par dag nyinapa la rnam par mi rtog go/ /sems can la 1 rnam par mi rtog go/ /sems can 36—40

gdul ba la nyu)rnam par mi rtog go/ /las la mi rtog go/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa la rnam par mi rtog go/ /sems pa 5)la chags par mi byed do/ /bsam pas kyang mngon par chags par mi byed do/ /rgyu chud gzon par mi byed do/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu chud gzon par mi byed do/ /dngos po nye bar len par mi byed do / /dngos po'i ci nochos la chags par yang mi byed do/ /'khor ba'i rnam pa tha dad pa gcig tu mi byed do/ /zhi ba 3rnam par brtags 5pa med pas rlom sems mi bskyed 45do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 7de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyis bsnyems〈8par mi byed do/ /chos gang gis kyang chos la gnas par mi byed do'atsho/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag nye bar stobs so/ /khong du chud par byed do/ /yongs su bsngo'o/ /yongs su smin par byed do/ /mnyam par byed do/ /sgrub 1 bo/ /mtshan mar mi byed do/ /dmigs par mi byed do/ /mi 'jal lo/ /mi rtog go/ /rnam par mi rtog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar yongs su bsngo ba ni 'das pa da nga ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su dran pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad nga/ yin/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yang dag par 'jug pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad myi zad pa yin/zhing rnam par dag pas yongs su bsngo bas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/sems can gyi khams rnam par dag pa la rnam par dpyod pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pa la zhugs pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/ nam mkha'i khams ltar tshad myed pa'i sems la yongs su sgom 11pas dge ba'i 32rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la shin tu mos 36—41

pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi las la brtson pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin/ dus gsum rab tu 1)rnam par 'byed pas dge ba'i rtsa ba myi zad pa yin te/ de ni 5)sems can gyi khams thams cad la sems can myed par rab tu rtog cing yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos thams cad la srog myed par khong du chud cing yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos thams cad la byed pa myed par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes shing yongs su bsngo'o / /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la gang zag myed par sems shing yongs su bsngo'o / /chos thams cad nyon mongs pa myed ripar rab tu rtog cing yongs su bsngo'o / /chos thams cad kyi rten pa yang dag par mthong shing nya5yongs su bsngo'o / /dngos po thams cad la myi gnas pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes shing yongs su bsngo'o/ /zhing thams cad la yang dag par myi gnas pa nyid du shes shing yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la myi gnas pa nyid du lta zhing yongs su bsngo'o/ /dmyigs pa thams cad la dmyigs su myed pa nyid du shes pas mthong zhing yongs su bsngo'o/ /de de ltar yongs su bsngo bas gzhing gang yang kun nas nyon mongs pa dang bcas par myig lam du 7snang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kun tu lta yang sems can gang yang myi mthun pa mthong bar myi 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa'i tshe chos gang yang yang dag par myi mthong ngo / /ye shes kyi 'jug pas gang la yang 'jug pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad la yang rab tu gnas te/ de yang shin tu shes so/ /bsod nams kyi stobs tshad myed pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus chos thams cad gang bar shin tu shes so / /sems can thams cad tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams 36—42

cad du 'gro ba la yang dag par spyod do/ /de'i sems bskyed pa re re zhing yang sems can brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa 37stobs bcu'i sar yang dag par 'grub snobo/ /des gsems can thams cad bsod nams thams cad kyisatshul yongs su gzung zhing thob par bya ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa bsod nams thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang ldan pa/ thams cad rab tu sgrub bo / /de yo byad ci 'dod pa phun sum tshogs pas/ bsod nams kyi mdzod yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang ldan pa yin no/ /de zigang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang 6de dag tu zhing thams cad rnam par sbyong zhing 'gro'o/ /de gang dang gang du spyod pa de dang 7de dag tu sems can brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med pa ri rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ bsod nams kyi stobs kyis yongs su bzungs9)ba la rab tu gzhog cing / yang dag par spyod do/ /de ltar yongs su bsngo ba de la rnam pa de lta bu'i 1 tshorgyu mthun pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na gzugs myed pa yin/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi zil gyis 1 myi non pa'i bsod nams can yin/ bdud thams cad kyis gzi brjid myi zad pa yin/phyir rgol ba thams cad kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba mi 'phrogs 12pa yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yid yang dag par rtogs 1 pa dang ldan pas/ smon lam shin tu che ba dang / sems rab tu yangs pa yin/ sems bskyed pa gcigate gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad myed par 'gro ba yin/ ye shes kyi stobs mtha' yas pas/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul yongs su shes pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad la shin tu dad pa yin/ ye shes mtha' yas par shin tu 'jug pa la rab tu gnas pa yin/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas 15pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon par 36wa 43

bsgrub 17pa'i mthus nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas par chos kyi dbyings shin tu yangs pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 45)'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba lnga pa/ bsod nams myi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba ste/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ mi zad pa'i mdzod bcu rab tu 'thob bo/ /bcu gang zhe na/ skra'i su /sbubs gcig tu sangs rgyas grangs myed pa 'byung ba la 'jug pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas pamatshogelta ba'i gter mi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob rigacibo/ /chos thams cad gcig tu rab tu gzhol ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / ye shes kyi ⑦phyir/chos la 'jug pa'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob 3)bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos bstan pa yongs su gzung 9)zhing chud mi huX zos par 11bya ba'i phyir/ dran pas bzung 12ba'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob bo1 / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul dang / dgongs pa shin tu bstan pa la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir/ blo gros rnam par nges pa'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob 1 bo/ /chos kyi tshul rnam par dbye ba la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs 15pas 'dzin pa'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob tshabo/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa'i blos dus gsum thams cad khyab par bya ba'i phyir/ blo tshad myed pa'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob 1 bo/ /sems can thams cad tshim par bya bas hu)myi zad par bya ba'i phyir/ bsod nams kyi gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thobs/rkyebo/ /sems can thams cad kyi mun pa dang / rab rib dang / ling tog dang /gti mug dang / ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par bsal ba'i phyir/ ye shes dang /36wa 44

dga' ba dang / blo'i gter myi zad pa'i mdzod rab tu 'thob bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos nyid tha myi dad pa 1)rab tu bstan pas/ sems can thams cad shes par bya ba'i phyir/ spobs pa rnam par nges pa'i gter rab tu 'thob bo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 5pa rgyun myi 'chad pas / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid chags pa myed pa'i thabs skyon myed pa'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir / stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa'i gter mi zad pa rab tu 'thob ste/gter myi zad pa'i mdzod bcu po 'di dag rab tu 'thob bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'imartso)rgyal mtshan gyis5/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gying rlabs kyis/phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bsam pas mthu stobs rnyed pa de medadag ni/ /mtha' yas chos la kun tu dbang sgyur 8)cing / /bsod nams gter la 9rjes su yi rang ba1 / /de dag chags myed tshul gyis yongs su bsngo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba su dag ji snyed pas/ /rnam dag zhing rnams 'jig rten rnam sbyangs pa/ /yon tan kun dang ldan zhing 'phags pa 17rnams/ /de 'dra'i rnam dag zhing du yongs su bsngo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ji snyed bzhugs pa yi/ /tshul rnams kun la rjes su sems byed cing / /thams cad lus pa myed par nges bzung ste/ /de 'dra'i zhing ni bstan 12pa rnams kyis brgyan/ /dus gsum bskal pa ji snyed yod pa 43lhe/ /zhing gcig 'iyon tan de dag blangs 8byas kyang / /bskal pa ji snyed de dag zad 'gyur gyi/ /zhing gi yon tan bsngags pa zad myi 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ / mi yi tshamachog gis ji snyed mthong gyur pa/ /thams cad ma lus zhing gi yon tan gyis/ /ji snyed 'jig rten de dag brgyan par snang / /de dag 36—45

kun kyang rnam dag yid dang ldan/ /de dag rgyal ba'i gsung skyes sras tsho)yin te/ /yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa'i sems dang ldan/ /zhing gi phyogs rnams rab tu rgyas par byed/ /de dag lus ni mtshan gyis shin tu brgyan/ /de dag dpe ldebyad bzang pos lus kyang mdzes/ /de dag mtha' yas yang dag so sor 33shes/ /'gro ba'i rgya mtsho lamyi zad ci 5bzhin no/ /de dag spyod yul dag dang yang dag ldan / /ting 'dzin kun la gnas pa rjes su thob/ /mtshungs myed shin tu rnam par dag pa'i yid/ /thams cad phyogs rnams su ni 'od 6kyang 'gyed/ /'di 'dra'i zhing rnams ma lus bzung byas te / /nyan thos spyod yul dag la dad myed pa/ /rang rgyal thams cad shin tu spangs gyur te/ / myi yi 8)dam pas shin tu gang gyur cig /de dag de 'dra'i yongs bsngo sems ldan pa/ /gang gis ma lus 'jig rten byang chub tu/ /dus gsum rgyal bas mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ /de dang ldan par yongs su bsngo bar 9byed/ /phyogs bcu kun na 'iji snyed yod pa yi/ /bdud dang nyon mongs de dag rab tu 'joms11/ /dpal ldan mthu can gzhan gyis pham 1 myi nus/ /rnam par nges par 1 chos kyi dam pa spyod/ /de dag smon lam mthu stobs yongs pa yis1 / /yongs su bsngo ba chags pa myed gyur cing 15/ /bsod nams zad samyed de dag mdzod du zhugs/ /de ni dus gsum kun tu zad mi 'gyur/ /de dag spyod pas chos la 'jal bar byed/ /de dag byed pa myed pa'i 1 chos la zhugs/ /g.yo med chos kyang de dag rab tu shes//las 1 kyi rnam pas yongs su mi sems so/ /gzugs ni ma yin 'on kyang gzugs myed myin/ /'du shes yod myin 'du shes myed pa myin/ /dngos yod /rtem yin dngos po myed pa 2 myin/ /dngos myed 21thams cad rang bzhin khong du 36wa 46

chud / /yod pa ma yin myed pa'ang ma yin te/ / rgyu yi 1rgyud la namangon par chags myi byed/ /rkyen la'ang 'jug par de dag myi byed de / /nam yang de dag chags par myi byed do/ /'gro ba 'di na smra tshul ji snyed pa/ /de la nam yang chags par mi byed de/ /'du shes bsam pa brda 5yang rab tu shes/ /bdag myed chos kyang so sor shin tu rtogs/ /de dag sems can mi 'bral cis 6'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i chos nyid mnyam pa rab tu rtogs/ /de 'dra'i zhing dang de bzhin las kyi rnams/ /dus gsum thams cad ma lus bzung 7byas shing / /shes pas de dag de bzhin yongs su bsngo/ /las 8kyi rnam pa 9gang gis skyes 1 rildan zhing / /rang bzhin gang dang mtshan nyid gang yin dang 11/ /de na ci 'dra'i chos nyid yod pa dag /de bzhin de dag dag par yongs su bsngo/ /gang gi712yid kyis ngo bo nyid 'jal ba/ / rang bzhin byas pa med par de dag shes / /1lha'agro la 1 de dag myi gnas len pa med/ /'gro ba kun phyir 15yongs su bsngo bar gzhol/ /spyod yul ma lus thams cad bzung 16byas shing / /'od gsal thams cad rjes su sems par byed/ /ma lus de bzhin nyid kyang de dag shes / /gang gis lta ba thams cad ma lus shing / /bsam pa'i skyon bor rnam par spongs pa 1 rnams/ /rtag tu de dag dri myed kun gdung myed/ /chags myed kun gyi tshul yang rjes su rtogs/ /de dag gis ni chos rnams ma bshig ste/ / nams kyang 1 chos nyid zhig 39par 'gyur ba myed/ /chos la chags par de dag myi byed de/ /de dag 'jig rten sgra brnyan 'dra ba yin / /gang gis dus gsum 'jig rten skyes pa yi nya/ /'gro ba rkyen byung 22chos kyang rab tu shes/ /bsam pa dag dang bag chags khong du chud/ /thams cad 'jig par na byed pa 36—47

gang yang myed/ /de dag las dang las min 1rab tu shes/ /las dang rnam par 'gal bar myi byed de/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa chud myi gzon/ / rgyu las byung 2ba'i chos kyang shin tu ston/ /'di na 8sems can gang yang 'khor ba myed / /sems can 'byung bar de dag mi byed de/ /sems can rnams la gnas pa myed par smra no/ /sems can rgyud kyi brda gciyang rab tu rtogs/ /bsod nams 5mi zad pa yi 7mdzod ces bya ba ste na yongs su bsngo ba lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 7yongs su bsngo ba drug pa dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su 3rtasong ba zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal por gyur te11/ srid chen po thob nas 'tshe ba dang phyir rgol ba 12bcom ste/ rgyal po chen por grags pa dang / srid chen po'i khams la gnas shing / srid yangs pa la dbang bar gyur nas/ 'khon sna myed cing lhod 7pa med par srid la gnas pa/ chos kyi 'argyal srid 7skyong bar byed pa/chos dang mthun pa1 / chos kyi rjes su snyegs 18pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i srid chen po thob pa/ sa chen po la gdugs gcig 19tu gyur pa/ 'khor lo thogs pa myed pas skyong ba/ dri ma myed pa'i thabs thob pa/ srid pa 2 pha rol kyi sdes gtse ba 21skyed pa na/ chos dang ldan pa/ dbyig pa na myed pa dang / mtshon cha myed pas 'gro ba rnams shin tu skyong ba/ chos kyi rjes 2 su zhugs shing bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis 'gro ba sdud 25pa/ 'khor los sgyur 'ba'i rgyal por gyur pa/'gro ba thams cad la mdzod kyis shin tu stob pa de dbang phyug de lta bu la gnas shing de lta 2 bu'i chos la gnas pa/ g.yog dang 'khor mang po shin tu 36—48

'dus pa gzugs dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad lta 41bas mi ngoms (5pa/yid la kha na ma tho ba myed pa/ bsod nams rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa/zil gyis mi non pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ lus shin tu rnam par phye ba mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ blta na bzang ba tshul dang mthun pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ stobs dang ldan pa/ thub pa skyed pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ stobs chen po dang ldan pa/mthu bo che'i lus kyis bzung nub/ rnam par dag pa'i las ge dang ldan pa/bsgribs zhupa myed pa'i las rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa de/ zas yongs su gtong ba 'am/ btung ba 'am/ ro 'am bzhon 6pa 'am/ gos sam/ me tog gam/ phreng ba 'am/ spos sam/ byug pa 'am/ mal cha 'amakhya/gnas sam/ rgyab rten nam/ mar me 'am/ sgron ma 'am/ nad kyi rkyen sman namatshad)yo byad rnams sbyin pa 'am/ rin po ches gzhal ba'i snod sna tshogs bkang zhing yongs su gtong ba dang / shing rta sna tshogs dang / shing rta du ma bkang zhing tshad myed pa'i rin po che dang nor yongs su gtong ba dang / glang po cang shes sama'o)/ rta cang shes rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gtong ba dang / slong ba rnams la ci rigs su rgyal po'i stan bzang po gtong ba 'am/ gdugs gtong ba 'am/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gtong ba 'am/ rin po che gtong zhing sbyin pa 'am/ rgyan dang lhab lhub kyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba 'am/ cod pan nam / gtsug gi nor bu dag dbang phyug la spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas mtshon nya chas bcings shing btson 37ra na 'dug pa'i sems can rnams mthong nas/nor thams cad yongs su gtong ba dang / g.yog dang bdag tu bcas te byin nas / btson ra de dag nas sems can rnams yongs su thar bar byed pa 36—49

gsad par khrid 1pa mthong nas/ bdag gi lus dang srog yongs su btang ste/gsad pa de blu 2bar byed pa/ gtsug phud dang thor pag ri tu bcas pa'i mgo bo gedag kyang bslong 5bas bslangs na/ gtong ba myed pa'i sems kyis gtong ba myig tsiganyis yongs su gtong ba 'am/ rna ba dang / sna yongs su gtong ba 'am/so dang lce yongs su gtong ba 'am/ mgo yongs su gtong ba 'am/ rka ci lag yongs su gtong ba 'am/ rang gi 8lus kyang dral cing 9slong ba la khrag yongs su gtong ba 'am/ sha 1 dang rkang yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong ba la rang gi lus las snying phyung ste/ yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong zhing len pa sna tshogs la rgyu /1 ma dang mtsher 12pa dang / mkhal ma dang / pho ba rnams 1 yongs su gtong ba 'am / rang gi 1 lus las 15yan lag dang / nying salag dang rus pa bslangs 1rten dad pa'i sems kyis yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong ba la mos par lta bas pags 1 pa dang mdog yongs su gtong ba 'am/ rka 19lag las sor mo yongs su gtong ba 'am/ chos 2 'dod pa'i phyir rang gi sha dang sen mo yongs su gtong ba 'am/ chos shin tu dkon 21pa tshol zhing myes gang ba'i 'obs myi 'greng lag tag 22bdun du mchong bar na byed pa 'am/ chos bsrung ba'i phyir sdug bsngal myong ba thams cad kyang rang gi lus kyis 2 bzod par byed pa 'am/ chos tshol zhing chos kyi tshig dang / yi ge 'bru gcig gi phyir yang rgya mtsho'i 25mthar thug pa'i sa chen po yongs su gtong ba 'am/ chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug byed pa 'am / myi dge ba'i chos las sems can rnams bzlog ste tsi/ dge ba'i chos la rab tu sbyor ba 'am/ skyes bu'i mtshan gcod pa mthong nas/ sdig pa'i las de dag las sems can de dag 2 rnam par bzlog 28par byed pa 'am/ de bzhin 36—50

gshegs pa mngon par sangs rgyas par 'jig rten thams cad du sgrog cing gtsug lag khang dang pho brang gi longs spyod kyi phyir sa dang khams yongs su gtong ba 'am/rim gro bya ba'i phyir bran dang las byed pa'i myi rnams gtong ba 'am/ slong ba la rim gro bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid 'bul ba 'am/ chos la dad pas dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems rnyed nas/ rang gi lus kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la 1rim gro byed pa 'am/ bdag nyid sems can thams cad la 72gtong ba 'am sangs rgyas thams cad la rim gro bya ba'i phyir rgyal srid yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong ba rnams la meci rigs su yul dang myir bcas pa 'am/ grong khyer dang rgyal po'i pho brang ngamatshang/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong ba la bu dang bu mo dang chung ma dag yongs su gtong ba 'am/ slong ba rnams la ci rigs su khyim thams cad yongs su sbyin 5 zhing gtong ba 'am/ bza' shing gi ra ba sbyin pa 'am/ slong ba sna tshogs dang 6len pa sna tshogs dang / sems can sna tshogs dang / gang zag sna tshogs / sems 8sna tshogs dang ldan pa la phyogs tha dad pa nas 'ongs pa tshad las 'das pa'i myi dang / myi sna tshogs dang sbyin pa'i gnas sna tshogs la mchod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya 9stong du ma grangs myed pa rnams byed cing yongs su gtong ba 'am/ de sbyin pa'i 1 chodamigs pa'i dngos po thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i tshe sems 'di ltar bskyed de 31yongs su bsngo zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas/ gzugs shin tu bzung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song 12bas/tshor ba shin tu bzung ba kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas/'du shes shin tu bzung 3 ci ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su 36—51
