song bas/ 'du byed shin tu bzung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas/ rnam par shes pa shin tu bzung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas/ srid 17pa thams cad shin tu bzung ba / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas/ 'khor shin tu bzung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas longs spyod shin tu bzung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi snying po'i rjes su song bas sbyin pa shin tu bzung ba des midage ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltara'i yongs su bsngo zhe ste / bla na med par dmyigs nas bza' ba dang btung ba 'di dag 'di ltar btang ba dang / 'di ltar byin pa dang / 'di ltar chags pa med pa dang /'di ltar bcings pa med pa dang / 'di ltar nye bar btang ba dang / 'di ltar ma bzung ba dang / 'di ltar lhag par 5bsam pa dang / 'di ltar dngos po yongs su btang ba dang / 'di ltar dmyigs pa la myi gnas pa dang / 'di ltar gtong ba dang ldan pas sems can thams cad ye shes kyi kha zas snyodang ldan pa dang / chags pa med pa la 7brtson pa sems kyi zas yongs su shes pa dang /chags pa myed pa'i zas dang / dga' ba'i zas dang / zang zing myed pa'i zas dang ye shes kyi 'tsho 8ba dang / chos kyi 9brtan pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa bas 1 yongs su bzung ba'i chos kyi sku dang / ye shes kyi sku la yang dag par spyod pa dang / sbyin pa'i gnas dang snying brtse ba'i kha zas rab tu len par gyur cig ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zas sbyin pa de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' btung ba'i sbyin pa 31gtong ba'i tshe 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad chos 36—52

kyi btung ba 'thung 3)ba la brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ldan pa55/ 'jig rten pa'i skom pa rgyun chad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis 5)skom pa las myi ldog pa dang / 'dod pa'i yul gyis caskom pa las phyir 5ldog pa dang / chos kyis 6tshim pa'i dga' ba rab tu 'thob pa dang / chos kyi sku shin tu tshim pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis tshim par byed pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / shes rab rgya mtsho la zhugs pa dang / chos kyi ri rab dang ldan pa dang ske/ chos kyi btung bas ngoms par gyur cig ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po btung ba'i sbyin pa de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 7bro ba'i sbyin pa naskyon thams cad bstsal na 9rnam par dag pa skyur 9ba dang / dngar 11ba dang kha ba dang bro ba dang / tsha ba dang / bska ba sna tshogs kyi ro mchog dang ldan pa shin tu 'jam pa'i ro mchog gi rnam pa dang ldan pa/ ro sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong bstsags 1da pa dang ldan pa dang nyusnye/ khams rnams mnyam zhing 'khrug 1 pa myed par gzhog pas lus 15kyi stobs rton tshapar byed pa/ sems dga' ba 1 dad cing mos pa dang / spro ba dang gsal ba 18bskyed pa/ zhim zhing tshul dang ldan pa'i ro'i dam par gyur pa/nang gi dbang po rnam par dag par byed 19pa/ lto la bde bas yang dag par ston pa/ snyom 3 ripa thams cad sel bar byed pa/ nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa / nad med par byed pa/ rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 31ro dam pa sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs myed pa slong zhing len pa sna tshogs la sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar sa yongs su bsngo ste sems can thams cad bdud rtsi'i ros brten na pa'i sems kyis 3 ro bro ba'i mchog dang 36—53

ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha zas kyi ro thams cad kyi las yongs su shes shing / chos kyi ro'i ye shes la rab tu gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gnas pa'i mtha' 1chos kyi grong khyer du phyin te/ chos kyi ro du ma'i chos kyi nadabyings rab tu rtogs par gyur cig sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas par byed pas 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa 3dang / gdul ba la ri zhugs zhing 5chos kyi sprin gyi char 'bebs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i chos kyi 6dga' bas rgyud tshim par gyur te/ ye shes mchog gi ro la sems rnam par gzhog par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ro thams cad kyi mtshan ma la mi 'dzin pas/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la brtson pa'i sems dang ldan zhing ro'i mchog thams cad la chags pa myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad du 7rab tu 'jug pas byung 8bas chos kyi ro gcig par gyur cig /sems can thams cad/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa las phyir myi ldog cing ro mchog gi ngo bo nyid la 9byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad dbang po thams cad dbye ba'i ye shes la mngon par mkhas pas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi ro tha dad pa myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsgribs 1 pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis 11tshim par spyod cing / chos kyi 12ros yid rgyas par gyur cig ces/ de ltar ro'i sbyin pa'i tshogs la brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems can thams cad kyi ye shes chags pa myed pa'i phung po sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o / /byang chub sems dpa' bzhon pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i 36—54

rtsa ba rnams 1yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa la zhon par gyur cig /theg pa chen po rab tu thob cing 5rnam par zhig pa med pa'i theg pa dang / mchog gi theg pa dang / dam pa'i theg pa dang /mgyogs pa'i theg pa dang / stobs chen po'i theg pa dang / bsod nams dang ldan pa'i theg pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i theg pas byung ste/ yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur cig ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzhon pa'i sbyin par gtogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gos kyi sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi khrel yod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa rab tu ri ci'athob 5)par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos kyis nerab tu yog 7pa'i na phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /cha byad ngan pa thams cad rnam par bzlog par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /lus sba bar bya 9ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /lus kyis khyud na 1 lus la bde bar reg par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /kha dog dag 11par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /kha dog 'jam par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ / mdog shin tu 'jam par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /1 bde bar 'gro ba rab tu 'thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas bde bar bsnyen bkur bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /bla na myed pa'i thams cad 'amakhyen pa nyid dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ste/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dadage ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo bar byed do/ /de ltar 17byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me tog gi 1 sbyin pa byed pa'i 36—55

tshe / dri sna tshogs kyi me tog dang / kha dog rnam pa tha dad pa'i me tog dang /yid du 'ong ba'i me tog du ma 1dang / myig tu na'ong ba'i me tog dang / myi mthun pa med pa'i me tog dang / dus thams cad na yod pa'i me tog dang /lha rdzas dang myi'i me tog dang / 'od mdzes pa'i me tog dang / shin tu dri che zhing yid du 'ong bar rimadzes pa'i me tog dang / 'di lta bu'i me tog rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon du gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten rnams la 'bul ba dang / chos dkon mchog la mchod pa 4byed pa dang / dge 'dun dkon mchog la 'bul ba dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 5byang chub sems dpa' la 'bul ba dang /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / pha dang ma rnams la sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe chung ngu na 6bdag gi lus dang de ma yin pa'i gzhan bkren pa phongs pa /slong zhing len pa sna tshogs la de dang 9de dag sbyin par bya ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad chos thams cad kyi me tog rgyas pa'i sems dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi me tog rgyas pa rab tu mthong bar gyur 1 cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la dga' ba rab tu rnyed 1nas blta na myi ngoms par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems can kun gyi sems mi 'khrug 12pas blta na yid du 'ong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i las la lta zhing nye bar spyod pas lta ba yongs 1 par gyur cig/sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la lta ba dang sems ma nyams 15pas 7rjes su lta ba'i dran pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun kyi nyon mongs pa'i dug bsreg 1 pa'i phyir dug 36—56

sman bzang po nyams su myong ba lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi rgyal po chen po la 'gro ba thams cad 'god pas smon lam chen po mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems can 1kun gyi rab rib dang /ling tog dang / mun pa bstsal rinaba'i phyir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub kyi zla 'od dge ba rnam par spel ba'i phyir zla ba lta bu /rimathong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen chomathong zhing chos kyi 5rnam pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir sems can thams cad kyis rgya mcho'ire rin po che'i gling du 'jug pa mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyis bsgribs 6pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i 7rnam par dag pa rab tu 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba'i me tog yongs su gtong bar gtogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag de ltar yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' phreng ba'i sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe na dge ba'i rtsa ba de sems can thams cad blta na mdzes pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta tshon yid du 'ong ba'i 1 phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /blta na bzang ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta na sdug pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta tsho1na mngon par dga' ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta na mya ngan myed pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta na rab tu dga' ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blta na yid mi bde ba myed pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /1 sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ldan pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /bla na myed pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba rnam par dag pa thob pa'i 1 phyir/ yongs su bsngo ste / de ltaras〉byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phreng ba'i sbyin pa byed 36—57

pa'i 1dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar bsngo ste/ spos yongs su btang tshonabs bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad tshul khrims kyi spos dang ldan par gyur cig /ma nyams pa'i tshul khrims dang / ma 'dres pa'i tshul khrims dang /rnyog pa myed pa'i tshul khrims dang / 'gyod pa myed pa'i tshul khrims dang /kun nas 'khor ba myed pa'i tshul khrims dang / yongs su gdung ba myed pa'i tshul khrims dang / log par ma zhugs pa'i tshul khrims dang / mtha' yas pa'i tshul khrims dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul cakhrims dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan par gyur cig /tshul khrims kyi phung po gang dang / sangs rgyas thams cad dang ldan pa de'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa dang / sems can thams cad ldan par gyur cig cesas3de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spos kyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/6 bam po gsum 7pa/ byang chub sems dpa' byug pa'i sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ byug pa 8sbyin pas yongs su bzung 9 ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad gtang ba thams cad nya riyongs su gtong zhing / sbyin pas bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de 11bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims 12kyis shin tu rnam par dag cing tshul khrims 1236—58

kyis bsgos ①par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chags pa myed pa'i bsam pa rab tu thob cing bzod pas bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po la brtson 'grus kyi go cha bgos shing nabartson 'grus kyis bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad da ltar byung ba'i sangs 5rgyas mngon du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pas bsam gtan gyis bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i ye shes kyi rgyal po la skad cig gis rnam par dag cing shes rab kyis bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i chos kyi 'jigs pa myed pa rab tu thob 5cing chos kyis bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad yon tan thams cad kyi ye 6shes rab tu thob cing yon tan gyis bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob cing byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su bsngo 7ba thams cad kyis 8bsgos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad myi dge ba'i chos thams cad rab tu spangs shing chos dkar pos bsgos par gyur cig ces de ltar 9byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byug pa'i sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mal cha'i sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad shes rab dang ye shes chen po thob pa'i phyir/ lha rdzas kyi mal cha rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad so so'i skye bo ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi gos bgo ba'i phyir 'phags pa'i mal 11rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir bde ba'i 36—59

mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par rol ba'i cho 'phrul yang dag par mthong ba'i phyir nya)rin po che lta bu'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad legs par bkod pa'i gos bgo ba'i phyir mnyam pa myed pa'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zil kyis ma tshonon pa rnam par dag pas rgya chen po'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi bde ba dang ldan pas dge ba'i byumal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi dmyigs pa la brtson pas shin tu dag pa'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen 5gyis bskyab 6pa dang ldan pas shin tu brtan (྅pa'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas gzims pa lta bu glosagayas pas 'beb 9pa dang ldan pas seng ge'i mal rab tu thob par gyur cig ces / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dran pa 1 shes bzhin gyis shin tu bsams 31pa'i dbang po yang dag par rgyu ba dang ldan pa mal cha'i 12sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 1 yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gnas kyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad yon tan gyi gnas la brtson 1 zhing / ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas spyod yul du gyur pa dang gnas pa 15med cing rten pa med pa'i gnas nas mi g.yo ba dang ske/ gnas thams cad rnam par bsgom 7pa dang / 'jig rten gyi gnas las 1 rnam par 'das pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas la gnas pa 36wa 60

dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas yongs su zin pa dang / bla na myed pa'i gnas kyi mthar phyin pa dang / bde ba'i nyaganas la brtson pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 5gnas la shin tu gnas pa dang / bla na myed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gnas dang myi 'bral zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa la gnas par gyur cig ces/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar sems pa/ sems can thams cad la )yongs su bsngo bas yongs su skyob pa lashogeganas kyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la de ltar yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' (zhesargyab rten gyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems kyis ye shes kyi (6)rten chen po la spyod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rten la spyod pa dang / bla ma'i rten la spyod pa dang / legs par 7spyod pa'i rten la spyod pa dang / byams pa chen po'i rten la spyod pa dang / snying rje chen po'i rten la spyod pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rten la spyod pa dang /byang chub kyi sems shin tu yangs pa'i rten la spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lam gyi rten la spyod cing / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rten la spyod par gyur cig ces8)/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyab rten gyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad yon tan thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ba 9dang / shin tu dag par 'gyur ba dang / ye shes rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / lam rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / chos rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang /36—61

bsam pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / mos pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / smon lam rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / mngon par shes pa'i yon tan dang / ye shes rnam par dag par 'gyur bar 37bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di lta ste/ til mar gyi mar me 'am/ mar gyi mar me 'am/ rin po che'i mar me 'am/ nor bu'i mar me 'am/ ro'i mar me 'am/ mar me chen po 'am/ a ga ru'i mar me 'am/tsan dan gyi mar me 'am/ spos kyi ro thams cad kyi mar me 'am/ kha dog mtha' yas par snang ba'i mar me 'am/ rnam pa de lta bu'i mar me dag de yongs su gtong zhing sbyin pa byed pa na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad la 2bde ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad bsdu ba'i phyir 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ mar me'i (sbyin pas yongs su bsdus pa'i 4ridage ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la snang ba mtha' yas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten thams cad 5shin tu phra ba dmyigs par bya ba'i phyir snang ba shin tu gsal zhing dang bar negyur cig /sems can thams cad sems can myed pa'i khams yongs su shes 7 shing snang ba rab rib myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'od 'gyed pa'i lus su mngon par nabyung zhing snang ba mtha' yas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 9kyi chos thams cad la nya phyir myi ldog pa'i 11sems dang ldan zhing 'od kun tu snang ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bar byed pa dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyi 'od rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings thams 36—62

cad 'od gcig gis rgyas par byed cing / thogs pa myed pa'i snang ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i zhing du 'od zer 1rab tu 'gyed cing snang ba dpag tu myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi skar mdas 'gro ba thams cad snang bar byed napa'i 'od dang ldan zhing 'od snang ba'i skar mda'i rgyal po lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad zhing kun tu 'od 'gyed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pas byung zhing snang ba kha dog mtha' yas par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mar me'i sbyin pa rab tu gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / sems can thams cad la bde ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su bzung bas 4yongs su 'dzin to/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i 5rtsa bas yang dag par bzung 6bas yang dag par 'dzin to/ /sems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 7skal bas bgo bsha' byed do/ /sems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa bas snying brtse bar byed do/ /sems can thams cad la nadage ba'i rtsa ba'i skal ba sbyin par byed do/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa bas rab tu bzung bas 9rab tu 'dzin to/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba byin pas 1 yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa bas dmyigs 11par byed do/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam par byed do/ /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba shes pas 12rnam par dpyod pa byed de1da/ de ltar mar me'i 1 sbyin pas 15bsdus pa'i dge ba'i 4rtsa ba de ci nas kyang sems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rab tu dgod pa'i phyir/36—63

yongs su bsngo ba thogs pa myed par 'gro bas de lta ①de ltar yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nad kyi rkyen sman dang yo byad sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ nidage ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad dmyigs pa kun las shin tu langasaskogyipar gyur cig/sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rab tu thob cing lus nad med par gyur cig /sems can thams cad myi dge ba'i nad thams cad sos par gyur te/ sman lta bur gyur cig ge /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' 5)phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la rab tu gnas pa'i tshul gyis sman a ga ru de skyelta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i dug bsal ④shing 'byin cing sangs rgyas kyi sman du gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i 8)spyod pa dang ldan zhing nye bar bgrod ⑨pa'i ngang tshul can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad shin tu mi 'khrug 9pa'i chos dang ldan zhing sman gyi rgyal po lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad gso ba la zhugs shing sman gyi sdong po lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad 31mkhyen pa nyid kyi 12snang ba rab tu thob cing nad thams cad byang bar 12gyur cig/sems can thams cad bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sman gyi sbyor ba la brtson pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi sman la mkhas par gyur cig ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rmesman gyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad shin tu gso ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /shin tu bde zhing dga' ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad shin tu rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 36—64

snyun mi mnga' ba lta bu snarab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nad kyi gzug rngu thams cad bzlog 3pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'ol/ /sems can thams cad kyi lus nyams pa myed cing brtan pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad rdo rje'i ri khor 4yug lta bur gzhom 5du myi choms pa 'tshodang stobs dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad stobs thams cad kyis brtan 7cing bsam pa shin tu mtho ba nathob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bde ba'i rnam pa zil gyis myi non pa 9yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi lus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs 1 kyis brtan pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snod sna tshogs dang / bre dang lnga bre'i 11sbyin pa byed pa 'di lta ste/ gser gyi snod dang / gser 1 gyi bre dang lnga bre rin po che sna tshogs kyis 32yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste dngul gyi snod dang /dngul gyi bre dang / lnga bre 7rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su bkang ba dang /'di lta ste be+e ḍūr+ya'i bosnod dang / be+e ḍūr+ya'i tshibre dang lnga bre rin po che rnam pa tha dad pas yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste shel gyi snod dang / shel gyi bre dang ske/ lnga bre rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa tha dad pas yongs su bkang ba dang /'di lta ste mu sa ra gal pa'i snod dang / mu sa ra gal pa'i 1 bre dang / lnga bre mu tig dmar pos yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste asma gar bha'i 1/snod dang / asma gar bha'i 1'bre dang / lnga bre 5 rin po che sa byi ru dang / nor bu rin po che'i na 'od zer na snang bas yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste rin po che shi 2 36wa 65

la'i snod dang / rin po che shi )mola'i bre dang / lnga bre kha zas zhim po ro'i〈mchog sna tshogs kyis 3yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste tsan dan gyi snod dang ske/ tsan dan gyi bre dang / lnga bre lha rdzas lta bu'i gos phrugs kyis yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste rdo rje'i zisnod dang / rdo rje'i bre dang / lnga bre spos rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste snod 6sna tshogs dngos po 7rnam pa tha dad pa'i tshogs kyis bkang ba dang / bre dang lnga bre du ma sna 8tshogs bstsags par bya 9ba tshad med pa nor gyi dbyig dang /dngul dang gser phyes yongs su bkang ba de dag yon 1 5gyi gnas bsam gyis mi khyab par mos pa'i sems dang ldan pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam 11la 'bul lam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen shin 12tu dkon par sems bskyed pas/byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog thams cad la 'bul lam/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa shin tu bstan pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la 'bul lam/'phags pa'i skye bo la shin tu mos pa'i sems kyis gang zag gi rnam pa 12nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas la 'bul lam/ bla ma la 1 bsnyen bkur zhing bshes gnyen 15la rim gro 7bya ba'i sems kyis pha dang ma dag la sbyin par byed dam de dang de dag tu yon tan gyi tshogs bsags pa dang / gdams ngag dang /bslab pa dang / 'phags pa'i bstan pa la gnas par brtson pas slob dpon dang —/ bla ma dang sbyin pa'i gnas la 'bul lam/ sems can thams cad la zhe mi sdang ba'i myig gis byams pa yongs su bsgoms shing gtong ba'i sems kyis 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gcig tu nges par 36—66

zhugs pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa thams cad rtsom 1zhing tshogs chen po grangs myed pas 'gro ba thams cad yongs su myi gtang nazhing myi spang ba'i sems la shin tu gnas te/ sbyin pa'i dngos po thams cad la mngon par ma chags pa dang /yon ri )gyi gnas thams cad rab tu bzung ba'i sems la gnas pas bkren 4pa dang ske/ phongs pa'i slong ba rnams la snod sna tshogs dang bre dang lnga bre yo byad kyi tshogs rnam pas57tha dad pas yongs su bkang ba de dag 6sbyin pa dang yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad dran pa'i dbang po nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa dang ldan te / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skad thams cad gzung ba dang / blang ba dang / yid la bya ba'i dran pa rmongs pa myed cing / snod tshad myed pa'i snying po can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo rgyun 'chad pa skyed pa'i chos 8can du gyur te/snod bzang po rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'das pa dang ske/ ma byon 9pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 1 chos yang dag par 'dzin pa'i chos can du gyur 11te/ bla na myed pa'i snod rin po che lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad 12'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub dbyer myed pa la mos pas yang dag par gzung 1 zhing sangs rgyas kyi chos yangs pa'i snod du gyur cig ci /sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rgya che 1 zhing mthu che 15ba la yang dag par gzhol bas rin po che'i snod rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa shin tu brgyan pa lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye 36—67

shes mtha' dang dbus med pa 37tshad myed pa la mos pa rnam par dag cing yon tan thams cad kyi snod dang 'byung gnas su gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rinarnam par thar pa bsgribasamatshipa med pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthar 5cigatugs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi khongs su chud par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems can gyi khams thams cad ma lus par thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs la rab tu gzhag pa'i phyir phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal 45)par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i snod du gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi 4)yan lag gis chos bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur te④/ yon tan5semachog thams cad dang 497dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi snod du gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la gsol ba 'debs 1 )pa dang chos yongs su 'dri ba la smra ba'i sngon du 'gro ba'i skyes bur gyur te / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa gang bar byed pa shong ba'i snod du gyur cig ces / de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ci /stonas kyang sems can gyi khams thams cad byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i snod du 'gyur ba'i 9/2phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shing rta sna tshogs dang hunye/shing rta du ma dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing rta tshad myed pa dag nyunyesangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang / bla ma dang ske/ ston pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdang / dge 'dun dang /36—68

nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sbyin pa'i gnas sna tshogs slong zhing len pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i gang zag sna tshogs dang phongs 1)pa dang bkrenas pa slong ba dpag tu myed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sgra thos te 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpar 3yid ches pas skabs phye ste 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi smon lam dang sbyin pa'i sgra thos te 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang sems kyis bos shing bstabs pa de dag las rme risbyin zhing gtong ba 'di lta ste/ nor bu'i shing rta la rgyan gyis shin tu mdzes par byas pa sbyin pa 'am/ gser gyi shing rta la dril bu'i dra ba phyirab tu 'khor ba'i rgyan 6rin po che'i srad 7bu'i lda ldi ldebakye ba sbyin pa 'am / be+e ḍūr+ya'i 9shing rta la rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma rnam pa sna tshogs kyis shin tu spras pa sbyin pa 'am/ dngul gyi shing rta la shin tu dag pa'i gser rab tu bzang po'i dra bas 1 )g.yogs shing rta cang shes la bcas pa 11rin po che 1rtebye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas brgyan cing klubs par nyi sbyin pa 'am/gser gyi shing rta la rin po che'i dra ba dang rgyan 3 ༷thams cad phun sum tshogs 15pas brgyan cing glang po sacang shes la 1 bcas pa sbyin pa 'am/ tsan dan gyi shing rta la 38rin po che'i dam pa 19sna tshogs kyis shin tu spras te rin po che'i seng ge'i khris brgyan pa/ na cung 2 brgya phrag stong zhon pa/ rgyan 21thams cad dang rin po che sa sna tshogs thams cad kyi gdugs phun sum tshogs pa skyes bu 2 cang shes brgya stong du mas drang ba 2 sbyin pa 'am/ shel gyi shing rta la rin po che du mas kha dog rnam par 'byes parang 5shin tu mdzes par byas shing / na cung tsho 7bye ba khrag khrig brgya ri stong grangs myed pas yongs su gang ba rin po che'i bla res yog par 36wa 69

bres pa1tsho/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs kyis phyogs bzhi nas brgyan pa sbyin pa 'am/ asma gar bha'i tshon shing rta la rin po che sna tshogs du mas shin tu mdzes par byas te/ spos sna tshogs dri zhim pos bdugs dpa/ spos kyi dam pa thams cad kyi 4byug pas rab tu byugs pa5)/ me tog gi 6rgyan thams cad kyis chal 7par bkang ba/ bu mo brgya phrag stong gis rin po che'i srad bu thogs te/'khrul ba myed par drang ba 2sbyin pa 'am/ dri zhim po sna tshogs kyi shing 9rta la ras dang gos sna tshogs kyi bla re 1 ribris pa rin po che'i dra bas yog 11par khebs 12pa / spos 1 zhim po 1 riyid du 'ong ba 18rnam par dag pa/ myi mthun pa myed pa tshor na dga' ba shin tu 'thul ba samatshams kyi lha'i bus drang ba/ rin po che'i 1 'khor lo 18thams cad kyis shin tu brgyan cing mdzes par byas pa sbyin pa 'am/rin po che thams cad tshogs pa'i 'od 'byung ba'i shing rta la kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i rin po che rnam pa du ma'i 19rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dra ba'i bla re bres pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba mtha' yas pa kun nas sbyangs 2 pa/ bu dang bu mo bskyon pa spos sna tshogs kyi phye mas mtha' 21'khor shin tu sbyangs pa sbyin pa byed pa na de dag las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la yon tshad myed pa na 'bul bar dad cing sbyin pa'i gnas kyi dam pa la shin tu mos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i gnas mtha' yas pa 2 rnam par dag pas sangs rgyas la rab tu rten 2 par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gtong ba rgya chen po yongs su grub pas sangs rgyas thams cad la yongs su gtong bar mos par gyur cing 25 sems 36—70

can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa bsgribs 1pa myed pa rab tu thob cing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi smon lam dang bral te/ sangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i yon tan thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis myong 2bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad mtha' yas pa'i ye shes la shin tu mos shing sangs rgyas la yon gsol ba zad mi shes par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i ye shes kyi rgyal pos 3rnam par dag cing ye shes kyi mchog la rab tu rten 4par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul thams cad du 'gro ba thob 5ste/ gang du dga' bar 'gro bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes mtha' yas pa'i 'byung gnas 6la rab tu 'khod pa 7'grub pa'i phyir ye shes chen po la rab tu rten 8par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad 9mkhyen pa nyid kyi zhing las rnam par 1 skye ba'i chos can du gyur te bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bskyed pas 11sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mos shing sangs rgyas thams cad la mi dga' ba med 1 pa'i sems su gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems 1 kyi skad cig gcig gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad du ngal ba myed par zhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su bsgrub 1 pa lhun gyis grub par 15gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad kyi drung du phyin pas byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du shin tu rnam par phye ba'i lus la rab tu zhugs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gnas dpe 15skyed pa'i lus rab tu thob pas ngal zhing dub pa myed par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyir mi ldog 36—71

pa'i yid kyis 'gro ba dang ldan zhing lus kyi mgyogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan 1par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems kyi 5skad cig gcigs gis bsam pa dang / khams khyab par byed pas sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i snang ba dang ldan cazhing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi 5rlabs dang / khyu mchog gi nerimathu 'byin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' 7thams cad kyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'gro ba la bde bar 'gro bas rab tu brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i ye shes thams cad ma lus pa'i mthar thug par na 'gro ba thob pas shin tu myur du 'gro bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings thams cad 9tha myi dad par 'jug pa la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud thams cad du 'gro ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyir myi ldog pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang tshul shes te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod 7pa khong du chud pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob pas 'dong bar 11gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos nyid thams cad kyi rjes su song zhing chos ji lta ba bzhin du mthong bas 'dra ba 2skyed pa'i ye shes kyi tshul thob par gyur cig /ces de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mngon du gyur pa 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su 1 mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten la shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa bsgribs sapa myed par 'byung ba'i mthar phyin par yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i 36—72

bshes gnyen la shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad byas 1)pa'i drin myi gtong ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen myi gtong ba'i sems stor ba myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad skal 5pa mnyam pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen nadang don mthun par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba thams cad kyis ca)dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phan 'dogs pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen 5)la bla ma'i rim gros cher brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i 6bshes gnyen 7dang nye bar byas te/ spyad 8pa bsgrub pa'i phyir bsam pa dge ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen 9skadang mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur khol nan tan byed pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen71mthong ba rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems 'khrul 12pa myed cing nyams pa myed pa dang / 'dres pa myed cing rnyog pa sna myed pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen 1 la grol ba'i bsam pa can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad yo byad ci 'dod pa rab tu bsgrub 15pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshel lus yongs su gtong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad byams pa dang ldan zhing khon 1 myed par rim gro byed pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung 8zhing rab tu brtan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kun tu 19mthun pa yang dag par mnyan pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen 21dang mthun par gyur cig /sems can thams cad smon lam gcig pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'byung ba 36—73

dang ske/ stobs kyi mthar gtugs pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa yongs su dag pa dang mthun zhing gcig 1par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa'i naye shes mngon par shes pas shes rab bzang pos chos kyi brtson 'grus la shin tu byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad bzung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthas gtugs par khong du chud pas rig dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 6thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thogs pa myed pa'i theg pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar gtugs te theg pa chen pos mngon par spyod cing yang dag par gnas par 7gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba'i phyogs las phyir myi ldog pa'i yid dang ldan zhing 'gro ba thams cad shes pa'i ye shes 'dzin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos la ji ltar thos pa bzhin du rmongs pa med pas chos thams cad la rab tu gzhol zhing ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs 8pa'i mngon par shes pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsgribs 9pa med pa'i ye shes kyis chos thams cad la 1 'byung ba'i mthar 1thug ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1 yongs su bzung 1 ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyams pa myed pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpe myed pa lorab tu thob pas mgyogs pa dam pa'i 15pha rol tu phyin pas 'gro bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / theg pa chen pos 'dul ba la rab tu zhugs pas 'gro zhing 'ong ba phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi shing rtas 'gro ba'i mthar thug pas gti mug myed par 1 'gro bar gyur 36—74

cig /sems can thams cad bsgribs 37pa myed pa'i ye shes kyis thams cad du 'gro ba'i tshul shes shing chags pa myed pa'i shing rta bzhon pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen chosal shing rta 'bul ba dang yongs su gtong bas yang dag par bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la tshul gyi rgyud gcigs tu gyur pas bsnyen 5cing bkur ba'i neyongs su bsgrub ༷pa rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa thams cad la shin tu bslabs 8pa'i sems dang ldan pa shes rab kyis shin tu rtogs pa'i bsam pa can/ yon tan gyis rnam par dag pa'i yid dang ldan pa/ mthun par yongs su gtong ba'i bsam pa can/ dge 'dun rin po che shin tu dkon pa'i sems dang ldan pa/tshogs rin po che la shin tu mos pa'i bsam pa can/ bstan pa rab tu bzung 9ba'i yid dang ldan pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu brtan pa'i bsam pa can/rim gro byed pa dang ldan pa/ mchod sbyin chen po'i mchod sbyin shin tu byas pa/bstan pa'i yon tan chen po brjod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yon tan tha myi dad pas 'od gsal zhing rnyog 1 pa myed par dag pa ste11/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge 'dun 12dkon mchog la shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la shing rta phul 1 bas yang dag par bzung 'ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste15/ 1spyodage ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dag par gzhol bas 7yang dag par zin par gyur cig sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i skye mched las chos gzhan myed par 36—75

shin tu grub pas/ sems 1nang du gzhol bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos gcig nas gcig notu brgyud pas yang dag par bzung bas 'phags par red par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten kun gyi shes pas yid ches par bya bas grangs su bgrang bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings myi gnyis pa'i rang dbazhin shesamari pa khong du chud pas chags pa myed pa'i dbyings la 5yang dag par gzhol bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul gyis yang dag par byung bas 6cang shes kyis 7 kun nas bskor bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad dang bral bar nanyon mongs pa myed pa'i chos la spyod par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i dge 'dun so so'i skye bo myed pa'i sas bla na med pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rab tu brjod par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chags pa myed par gyur pa'i ye shes la shin tu brtson pa'i chos can du gyur te/ 'phags pa'i chos dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad khams gsum thams cad kyis gos pa myed pa'i sems dang ldan zhing tshogs kyi rgyal po dam par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi 9chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la mkhas pas legs par bcas pa'i ye shes kyi bzhon pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 1 brjod du myed pa'i 11yang brjod du med par shin tu 'gro ba'i 'gros 1 la mkhas pas sems skad cig gi/ rdzu 'phrul rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du thogs pa myed pa'i ye shes dang ldan zhing nam mkha' 1 lta bu'i lus kyi shing rta sgrub mi36—76

par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs par khyab par byed pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gro ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ma lus par gang du dga' bar 'gro zhing rgyu ba dang ldan pas lus yang ba'i khyad par rjes su rtogs pas 1rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lus yang dag par ston pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul gyi 'khor mtha' yas pa la mkhas 3par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lus 'phos pa myed par 'gro ba yang dag par ston pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul chen po'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa 0nithob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad myig 5yor lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba mngon par bsgrub 6pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la myi gnas pa'i lus rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dus la ji ltar 'bab 7par sems can yongs su smin par byed cing / 'dul ba myi gtong ba'i phyir bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 8khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yang dag par ston par gyur cig /sems can thams cad skad cig gcig gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad la chags pa myed cing bsgribs nyi ripa myed pa'i tshul gyis sems skad cig gcig 11gis phyogs thams cad du 'gro ba'i rdzu 'phrul la mngon par mkhas par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge 'dun la shing rta 'bul zhing yongs su gtong bas yang dag par bzung 2ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 1 de ltar sems 36—77

can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta la gnas pa rnam 1par dag par 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad shes pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor 2bar 'gyur ba'i ciphyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i gnas kyi 'du shes nye bar gzhag pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ rim gro cacan zhe sa dang ldan pa/bdag nyid che ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho gang chen 5mcho1re tshul la mkhas pa/ yon tan dang ye shes kyi 'byung yiganas kyi rigs dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan la rnam par sems pa / mthu chen por naskyes pa bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du 9yongs su bsgoms pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dus brjod du myed pa thams cad du spyod pa rnam par spyad pa la rab tu zhugs pa/ bdud kyi bcings pa thams cad las sems rab tu grol ba/ bdud du ma'i sde dang bdud thams cad kyi shes pa'i stobs rab tu 'joms 1 pa'i sems dang ldan pa gzhal /du myed pa'i chos la mkhas pas/snang bar gyur pa de nyan thos dang 1 / rang sangs rgyas la 15shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe / shing rta yongs su btang 7bas yang dag par bzung 1 ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i sbyin pa yongs su smin pa grub pas sbyin pa'i gnas kyi dam par yid ches par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gcig tu spyod cing myi gnyis par yang dag par spyod pas 'du 'dzi 9phyed pa la dga' bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad bsod nams kyis yang dag par bsdu ba la brtson pas 2 sbyin pa rnam par dag par byed pa'i mchog tu gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa 36—78

ba grangs myed pa'i 'bras bu rab tu 1gtong bas ye shes kyi mu stegs las 2byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog gis rnam par dag pas bsgribs da pa myed par rtogs par khong du chud par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin byed pa myed par khong du chud pas nyon mongs pa myed pa'i chos la rnam par spyod par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsod nams kyi zhing sbyin pa'i gnas 'gro ba thams cad dga' bar byas pas bsod nams tshad myed pa shin tu bstsags 4par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i gnas su byas te/ phan 'dogs pa rnam par dag pas cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas rnam par rol pa yang ridag par ston par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i theg pa mchog gi 'bras bu yongs su stobs pas sbyin pa'i gnas yon tan zad mi shes par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsod nams kyi phung po/ myi zad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i mthar thug par gyur te/ sbyin pa'i gnas don yod pa'i 'bras bu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ma thos pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshotshig dang yi ge 'dzin cing sdig pa'i chos rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sgra don yod pa ye shes kyis rnam par rig 7pas sangs rgyas kyi nachos thams cad mnyan pa la mos shing brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad las 9thos pa rjes su bsgrags 1 pa'i chos can du gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad zhags pa 'thub 11pa dgu bcu rtsa drug gi lta ba las rnam par 'das te bstan pa la gnas pa'i bya ba la mos par gyur cig /36—79

sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba 1mchog rnam par spel bar 2byed cing 'phags pa mthong ba rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'phags pa mthong zhing 'grogs pa'i bde ba dang ldan zhing ye shes kyis spyod pa'i gang zag la mos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi lta ba rjes su thos pa las byung bas/ thos pa don yod par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bstan pa la rab tu gzung cab dang yongs su bsrung ba la zhugs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ye shes kyi mkhas pa rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar bya ba'i snang ba zirab tu thob 6pas chos thams cad thos pa shin tu 'dzin pa la zhugs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i mdzod kyis dga' bar spyod cing gtong ba shin tu byed pa dang / mchod sbyin shin tu byas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 7yon tan ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs 8pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la shing rta 'bul ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi 9ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rnam par dag pa mchog dam pa phul rab tu 'thob 1 ricing ci nas kyang myi 'jigs pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs dang myi 'jigs pa rab tu thob 11par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i gnas dang len pa sna tshogs phyogs gzhan dang gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i gang zag dang / slong ba phongs 2pa dang bkren pa mang po tshad myed pa byang chub sems dpa'i sgra thos te 'ongs pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / sems bskyed pas mos shing 36—80

bstabs pa thams cad gtong bas shin tu re ba'i yid can de dag 'ongs pa mthong nas/ slong ba la rim gro bya bas myi ngoms pa'i sems kyis slong ba 'ongs pa rnams la bzod pa gsol ba'i sems bskyed de/ 'di ltar bdag nyid phyogs de dag tu 17khyod kyi drung du song ste rim gro nabya ba zhig na/ de 'di ltar khyod 'dir phyin te shin tu ngal bar gyur to/ /zhes spyi bos btud de bzod 3pa gsol bas slong ba thams cad bzod par byas rim gror byas/ ngal ba bstis 5nas ci 'dod pa sbyin pa de dag gis shin tu rim gror 6byed de/ 'di ltar nor bu'i shing rta 'dzam bu'i gling gi na chung 7bzang mo rin po ches 8yongs su gang 9ba dang / 'di lta ste gser gyi shing rta yul gyi na chung 10rin po che 11shin tu rnam par dag pas yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste be+e ḍūr+ya'i 1 shing rta chung 15ma'i 'khor 1 glu dang rol mo brdung zhing dkrol 15ba dang ldan pas yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste dngul gyi shing rta shin tu mdzes pa bud myed gzhon nu lha'i bu mo lta bus yongs su gang 17ba dang / 'di lta ste rin po che 17bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs myed pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i shing rta bud myed cang shes rin po che rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa tshul mkhas pas yongs su gang rnab dang /'di lta ste tsan dan gyi shing rta byang chub sems dpa' zhon 19par 'os pa dang /'di lta ste shel gyi shing rta bud myed bzang mo bzhin bzang ba 2 cha byad sdug gu shin tu brgyan pa gzugs mdzes pa lta nyan sdug cing myi mthun pa med pas/ yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste a sma gar ba'i ri 2shing rta dbang bskur bas yongs su gang 2 ba dang / 'di lta ste spos dam pa'i shing rta bu dang 2 bu mos yongs su bkang ba dang / 'di lta ste rin po che'i 25tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 36wa 81

shing rta nang gi bshes gnyen 1 dbyer myi phyed pas yongs su bkang ba dang / de rnam pa 'di lta bu'i shing rta grangs myed pa rnam pa sna tshogs slong mo snopa thams cad la sbyin zhing yongs su gtong bas slong ba 'dod par bya ba'i dngos po rab tu thob pas yid la bsam pa shin tu rdzogs nas slong ba de dag thams cad sbyin pa thams cad sbyin pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par bzung riste/ shin tu tshim par byas shing bsam pa rdzogs par byas nas cadaga' ba dang mgu ltab dang rangs pa dang yid bde ba skyes par byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo'o//sems can thams cad byang chub kyi shing drung du bsam gyis mi khyab cing thogs pa med pa'i shing rta'i 'khor lo 6phyir myi ldog pas 'gro ba dang ldan te/ theg pa chen po'i shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la spyod cing phyi ma'i mtha'i 7bskal pa'i mur thug par phyir myi ldog par nachos kyi shing rta cang shes la zhin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad la rnam par rtog pa'i rlom sems med cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigs kyi lam la brtson pas chos thams cad ci yang ma yin pa'i shing rta la zhin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro ba la brtson pas kun tu 'gro ba dri ma myed pa'i shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la dga' bas mos shing yang dag par 'gro ba la brtson pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa'i shing rta rjes su 'thun 9pa la rab tu gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i pa'abyung ba'i lam bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rab 36—82

tu dga' ba'i yid dang ldan zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i shing rta las3zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tshul dang 'dra tshonaba'i yul na gnas pa dang ldan pa dang / skyes bu dam pa la rten pa thob pas/sngon byas pa'i bsod nams shin tu bstsags 4pa dang / yang dag pa'i smon lam la 455shin tu brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshangs par spyod 6pa rnam par dag pa yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs 7pas 'khor lo bzhi pa'i shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa na ma lus pa'i stobs dang ye shes la brtson pas phyogs thams cad kyi ci chos kyi dbyings su chos kyi snang ba gtong ba la bslab 1 ripar gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi shing rtas 'byung ba'i pha rol du phyin pa thob ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyogs thams cad du legs pa dang bde ba yang dag par ston pas bsod nams thams cad 11dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad myed pa dang / chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i shing rta la mkhas par gyur cig/sems can thams cad 'jungs pa'i dri ma rab tu byang ste 12sbyin pa gtong bas 'byung 12ba'i shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa ma lus pas 5tshul khrims rnam par dag pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems 'khrugs pa myed par gnas pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa 'khrugs 0pa myed cing bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'byung ba'i shing rtas snying po byang chub tu 'gro bar spyod pa'i go cha 7bgos pas brtson 36—83

'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad shin tu mgyogs pa'i shing rtas snying po byang chub tu byung ste/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi shing rta la shin tu zhin zhing sangs rgyas kyi yul 1sprul pas rgyas par byed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos yongs su gtong ba la 'jigs pa med pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi don du sbyin pa gtong ba'i phyir chos kyi rgyal po'i shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi mtshan nyid dang rang bzhin gyi phyogs thams cad la rab tu 'jug pa rmongs pa med pa'i phyir smon lam la myi gnas pa'i ye shes kyi shing rta dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad theg pa chen po ma nor bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du skye zhing lus yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi shing rta la zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam skyo ba myed par yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang 2yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen pa rin po che'i shing rta la zhon par gyur cig ces cade ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 5sbyin pa'i gnas dang len pa dang slong ba sna tshogs la shing rta 6dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang mos pa dang spro ba'i yid kyi 7rnam par rtog pas byin napas yongs su bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad thams cad 9mkhyen pa'i theg pa la bzhon 0pa shin tu bsgrubs 11pas ye shes dang sems kyi 1 rnam pa mtha' yas pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i 36——84

phyirayongasasubasngo'o /—wa wa wa—wa —wa wa sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/du) bam po bzhi napa/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po glang po cang shes yan lag bdun shin tu gnas pa lo drug cu rilon pa mche ba drug dang ldan pa/ kha dog pad mo lta bu gdong rnam par dag pa/ dkar zhing dri ma myed pa/ gser gyi rgyal mtshan can gser gyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ gser gyi dra bas lus kun nas yog 5pa/ sna 6rin po che sna tshogs kyi dra ba'i rgyan du bcug pa / gser ltar blta 7rin mdzes pa dpag tshad stong gi nakhyon du ngal ba myed par 'gro ba sbyin zhing gtong ba 'am/ rta cang shes gom pa zo mdog 9bde bar 'dor zhing 'deg lha pa dang / bya ltar mgyogs pa dang ldan pa/ rngog ma lcang lor 'khril ba/ nam tsong dang mig 11par ldan pa/ mig pa'i dbyibs mtho zhing skyon myed pa gser gyi dril bu'i 15dra bas brgyan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyanadang / zla ba dang ldan pa/ glo kun nas brgyan pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi gdong 14rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa zhon 15na bde ba lus la byams pa shin tu mgyogs pa phyogs bzhir yid ltar mgyogs pa'i shugs dang ldan pa / lha rdzas lta bu'i lhab lhub thams cad dang ldan pa de lta bu'i bla ma'i 7skye bo dang ske/ bla mar bya ba 1 dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen 18dang / pha dang ma dang phongs 19pa dang / bkren pa dang na / slong ba dang len pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba dang / sems yangs pas 2 sbyin pa dang /sems la chags pa med par 2gtong ba dang / rjes su 'gyod pa myed pas yid mgu bar byed pa dang / snying rje chen pos na yongs su rgyas pa'i bsam pas 36—85

gtong ba chen po rab tu gtong zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan thams cad la rab tu brtson pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su mngon par skyes pa'i bsam pa yongs su sbyong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi rgyan 1gyis byung ste/ cang shes kyi theg pa la rab tu gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi narjes su 'gro ba'i chos kyi theg pas byung ste/ theg pa bzang po'i bzhon pa la mngon par zhon par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bsgribs 3pa med pa'i ye shes kyi theg pas snang bar gyur te / theg pa chen po la shin tu mos par gyur cig /sems can thams cad smon lam thams cad sgrol ba la rab tu 5zhugs pas brtsam pa chen po'i theg pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba mnyam par bsgrub 6pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba rab tu 'thob pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa mnyam pa nyid kyis byung 7bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i ye shes rin po ches nasangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la shin tu 'byung ba'i chos can du gyur te/ theg pa 9 rin po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi me tog rgyas pa'i 1 sems dang rgyud du gyur te /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i 1 rgyan rnam par bsags pa'i theg pas shin tu byung bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad mtha' yas pa'i theg pa myur ba 'a mngon par brtson pa'i ye shes kyi chos can du gyur te/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i 12rjes su bsam 12pa rjes su sems shing rnam 36—86

par sbyong bar tsho1)gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yang dag par bsgrub napa la mkhas pas longs spyod kyi mchog thams cad dang cang shes kyi theg pa chen po'i sbyin pa byed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam gyi mthar gtugs par mngon par gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ catheg pa shin tu mtho bar gnas zhe shing rab tu brtan pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po glang po cang shes dang rta cang shes bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa'i sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad chags pa med pa'i theg pa la mngon par bskyon 6zhing ye shes kyi bzhon 7 pa/ yongs su 'grub 8pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa bsgrib 95pa med pas 'byung ba'i mthar thug par yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor los sgyur 1 ba'i rgyal por gyur pa chos kyi dbang byed pa/ stan 11gyi sbyin pa byed cing rgyal po bzhugs 12pa'i khri stan bzang po be+e ḍūr+ya'i 1 rkang pa can seng ge'i khri la gnas pa/ gser gyi rgyu 1 dang rin po che'i dra bas blas bopa/ stan reg glun bde ba grangs myed pa du ma bting 1 ba/ nyen 1 kor spos kyi dam pa thams cad kyis shin tu dri zhim par 9byas pa nor bu 2 rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba 1rin po che bye 22ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi dra ba'i bla re bres pa/gser gyi dril bu'i dra ba 'khrol 2 ba'i sgra yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs 'byung ba/rin po che'i 'bru bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcus 25kun nas bskor te rnam par phye bas shin tu 'phags shing blta na mdzes pa/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 36—87

brgya stong grangs med pas 1kun nas blta ba/ gdugs khab rigacig gis sa chen po thams cad skyong bar dbang bskur 3ba/ rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug thams cad la dbang ba'i stan du bya ba de la 'dug cing 'khor lo thogs pa med pas bskyang 4ba dang / chis ru bya ba la rgyal po'i bka' thams cad nyams pa med par nyan pa/ dpal rnam par snang ba dang / in dra nī nel dang / nor bu rin po che'i snying pos spras pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang skar ma che phra lta bur 7rab tu brgyan pa/ rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs rmad du byung bas brgyan pa na rin po che khyad par du 9'phags pa rgya mtshos spras pa/ rgya mtsho dang / rgyal mtshan dang /bkra shis dang / bum pa sna tshogs yongs su gang ba dang / dga' ba 1 'khyil pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ 'dzam bu'i 11chu klung gi gser gyi gyim 1 bag dri ma med cing rdul dang bral bas bkab pa 1 de la 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad kyi bdag po spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bsod nams kyi stobs dang ldan pa/ byams pas dbang bskur 1 ba/ pha rol gyi 'khor bcom pa dang ldan pa/ bka' la zlog 5pa med pa 'dug na dga' ba de lta bu'i stan 16gyi rnam pa tshul de 'dra ba sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba dang ske/ de dang de dag gi rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa la khri stan 20bzang po'i rnam rna pa/ de lta bu'i sbyin pa byed cing yongs su gtong ba dang ske/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sbyin pa'i gnas kyi dam 2pa la gsol ba 'am/ skyes bu dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 2 nam/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog sam/ chos smra ba 'am/ chos la dgab pa'i 2 phyir yongs su g.yog 25pa'i sems kyis sam/ pha dang ma dang bla ma'i skye bo 'am/36—88

nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i sbyin pa'i gnas sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa tshothams cad dman/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod rten mchod pa'i phyir ram/ phongs pa dang / bkren 5pa slong ba dpag tu myed pa dag gam/ sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i phyir yang rung ste/ sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba'i tsher/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par 'tshang rgya ba'i ye shes dang ldan zhing shin tu byang chub pa'i stan 45dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bdud kyi dkrugs ༷ma dang dpung rab tu gzhom 8pa'i phyir/ chos kyi 9dbang phyug thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ri rnam pa thams cad du thub pa med pa'i lus dang ldan zhing 'gro ba thams cad la 1 dbang ba'i stan rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyis blta bar 'os 11shing sangs rgyas rnam par rol pa'i seng ge'i gdan rab tu thob 1 par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun la chos kyi dbang phyug gis skyong ba'i phyir stan gyi rgyan 1 dang 'khor rnam par dag pa brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med pa rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba tshogs chen po rnam par dag pas /khams gsum pas zil gyis myi non pa'i stan rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bskal pa grangs myed par sangs rgyas kyi gdan gyi yon tan bsngags pa mthar thug pa myed pa dang ldan zhing 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa 15stan gyis rgyas par byed pa'i byin gyi 10rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings thams cad 36—89

lus kyis 1rgyas par byed pa'i phyir gter chen po'i tsho kyitshogs kyi stan la gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad la 5chos kyi sbyin pas rim gro byed pa'i phyir/ rgyan gyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 5sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i stan rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad dang /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yang dag par ston pa'i phyir dge ba'i stan la rab tu gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par 'tshang 6rgya zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid che ba thams cad dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung 7ba yang dag par ston pa'i phyir/rin po che thams cad kyi /stan dang spos thams cad kyi stan dang / me tog thams cad kyi stan dang / gos thams cad kyi stan dang / phreng ba thams cad kyi stan dang / nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi stan dang / be+e ḍūr+ya 9)sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stan dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa 7ltar tshad myed pa'i stan dang 'gro ba thams cad ma lus par rgyan 1 gyis rnam par dag pa'i stan dang / rdo rje'i gdan thams cad la 'khod par 12gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' stan gyi sbyin pas yang dag par bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyis ma gos 1 pa'i byang chub kyi stan rab tu thob 10cing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rnam par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gdugs kyi sbyin pa byed cing dbang phyug gi lus la dgab pa'i 1shegadugs rin po che'i 4rgyan chen pos7 36—90

shin tu brgyan pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong khyad par du 1'phags shing dbang che ba'i yo byad du bya50ba/ rin po che'i rtsa ba can dril bu'i dra bas kun nas bskor ba / rin po che'i srad bus gser gyi dril bu sbyangs 5pa'i sgra 'byung ba/ rin po che'i be+e ḍūr+ya'i chaphreng ba rab tu sbyangs chosapa/ nyen kor nas rnga'i sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba/ gser gyi dra ba rnam par dag pas yigayogs shing brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dra ba brgya phrag stong gi bla re bres ④pa/ nor bu rin po che'i 'bru chos)grangs myed pas spras tho pa/ rin po che bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas sna tshogs su bres shing brgyan pa/ a ga ru dang / tsan dan dang / spos kyi dam pa sna tshogs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas/ nyen kor dri zhim par bsgos shing bdugs 1 pa/ 'dzam bu 11chu klung gi gser ltar 'od gsal zhing 12dag pa rgyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mtha' yas pas brgyan pa de bas kyang ches lhag pa'i gdugs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs myed pa dag kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa byed cing sems can gyi 1lhagatso bo mngon du gyur pa 'am/de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten brgyan pa'i phyir ram/ chos btsal ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dang 7/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 15nam/ byang chub sems dpa' chos smra ba btsun tshapar bya ba dag gam / pha dang ma 'am dge 'dun dkon mchog gam/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa 'am/ sbyin pa'i gnas kyi gang zag sna tshogs sam/ slob dpon dang bla ma dang / byang chub kyi theg pa grub pa 'am/ de la zhugs pa dag gam/phongs pa dang / bkren pa slong ba dang / len pa dag la 'bul ba dang /yongs su gtong ba dang tsho sbyin pa 1 byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di 1rte36—91

ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi g.yog nyarmepa rab tu thob ste/ dge ba'i rtsa bas nayang dag par g.yogs paras 5gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad las yongs su 'das te/ yon tan dang ye shes kyis mngon par bkab par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi rdul cadang mun pa dang yongs su gdung ba thams cad las rnam par 'das te lus shin tu bkab par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyis blta na sdug cing sangs rgyas thams cad la skumanga' ba'i ye shes kyi snying po can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos la 6log pa myed par 'jug par brtson pas ma 'khrugs pa'i chos dkar pos shin tu bkab par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi 7lus kyis sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mthar gtugs nate mngon par bkab pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten kun la stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi bla res skyob pas 9gdugs su red 1 par gyur cig /sems can thams cad khams gsum thams cad las shin tu 'phags shing chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi snying po dang ldan pas ye shes kyis rnam par snang bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i gnas dam pa la bsod nams thams cad 1kyis mchod pa'i phyir gdugs su 1 'os par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi gdugs 1 rnam par sangs rgyas pas gdugs kyi dam par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gdugs kyi sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis 1 chos la dbang ba'i gdugs yang dag par bzung skab thob par bya ba'i phyir 36—92

yongs su bsngo'o/ /gdugs gcig gis nam mkha' 1thams cad 5kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs 5pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung 6ba yang dag par bstan pa 7las phyir myi ldog pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos kyi dbyings thams cad gdugs gcig gis brgyan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /gdugs dang rgyal rnamatshan dang ba dan yid du 'ong bas 9de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku la mngon par dgab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad ma lus par gdugs kyi rgyan gyis kun tu g.yog 11par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la mos pa'i sems can thams cad dang 'gro ba'i tshogs 1 thams cad gdugs thams cad kyis ridagab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /rin po che thams cad kyi gdugs sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du myed pa sangs rgyas gcig la phul bas sangs rgyas thams cad la brjod du myed pa'i gdugs 5phul bar sems shing yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub mngon par byang chub pas 'phags pa'i gdugs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad dgab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /sangs rgyas kyi sku ji snyed 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad na 2bzhugs pa thams cad la gdugs kyis dgab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /nor bu rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gdugs dang rin po che thams cad kyi phreng ba brgyus shing klubs pa dang / spos thams cad kyi mchog gi dri zhim po'i ngad 'byung ba'i gdugs dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis rnam par spras pa'i gdugs dang / rgyan 36—93

mdzes shing rnam par dag pa'i gdugs dang / rgyan tshad med par yangs shing rgya che ba dang / gser gyi dra bas kun nas yog 1par brgyan pa/ dril bu'i dra ba kun nas sbyangs 2pa'i sgra yid du 'ong zhing snyan pa 'byung ba'i gdugs dang /ye shes bsgribs pa myed cing chags pa myed pa'i gdugs dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mngon par dgab pa'i gdugs yongs su btang geba'i phyir yongs su bsngo stene/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gdugs kyi sbyin pas yang dag par bzung 7ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la ye shes mchog gi nagadugs kyis mngon par dgab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyis kun nas yog cing 9rab tu brgyan pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang yon tan dang 1 dgongs pa dam pa rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems rin po che mtha' yas pa la dbang sgyur ba 11rab tu thob 12par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos thams cad la ye shes kyis 1 dbang sgyur 1 ba kun tu rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis mngon par yog 15par yongs su bsngo ba'i don du yongs su bsngo'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyis 17ye shes mchog gi gdugs rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs bcu'i 1 bla rer 1 bres pa'i gdugs su 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos kyi dbyings thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig 1 gis yog 2 par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /chos thams cad la 2 dbang phyug tu dbang sgyur ba'i dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /mthu chen po dang dbang chen po'i sems kyi rgyud thob par bya 36wa 94

ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /blo yangs pa dang sems rgya che ba thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /yon tan tshad myed pas 'gro ba thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i 1phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /yon tan thams cad kyis sems mngon par dgab pa'i 2phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad kyis 'gro ba thams cad mngon par dgab pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /ye shes chen pos mnyam par dgab pa thob dpar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad kyis cabasngo ba'i tshul ma lus par thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /sems dang sgrubasam pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /bsam pa dge ba dang yid kyi dbang po rnam par dag pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsngo ba chen pos mngon par dgab cing yang dag par bsdu 7ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar nayang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dang ba dan rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa'i yu ba can/ rin po che'i dril bu'i dra ba ‘ 'khrol ba'i sgra yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba snam bu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs sbyangs 1pa/ kha dog dang tshon 1 sna tshogs kyis 1 snam bus brgyan cing bsgreng ba /gser gyi dra bas 15kun nas spyangs 6shing klubs pa/ gser gyi dril bu'i sgra 'byung ba dril bu g.yer ku'i 17dra bas shin 1 tu brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong kha dog tha dad pa tshon tha dad pa shin tu mtho 19ba rin po ches 2 rnam pa sna tshogs su brgyan pa/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo zla kham 2 gyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ 'dzam bu'i 2chu klung gi gser gyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor btsug 2 pa/ 'od gzer 2 rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba/ rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan 2536—95

gyis 1thams cad kun tu yog 2pa/ rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan rnam pa du ma 'od dang ldan pas rab tu brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs bsgreng ba'i munargyan de lta bu dag 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa la 6mos pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan 7gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings thams cad 'byam naklas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'byam 9glas pa la gnas pa/ yangs pa kun tu rgyal mtshan gyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong 1 bar mos pas 11'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa dang mos pa'i khyad 1 par rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon du gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten nam/ chos dkon mchog mchod pa 'am/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la 'bul lam ri/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 1 byang chub sems dpa' rnams sam/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams sam/ 'khor gyi tshogs su gyur pa 'am/ gang zag gi rnam pa gzhan su'ang 15rung ste/ slong ba thams cad la rim gro snyebya ba'i phyir sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba na/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sbyin pas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 1 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad ye shes kyi 18rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la thub 19pa med pas dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bsod nams thams cad yang dag par bsgreng 2 ba'i rgyal mtshan can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi go 'phang da bris pa sbed pa'i chos nyid kyis chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar gyur cig /sems can 36—96

thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi chos yang dag par 'dzin pa'i chos can du gyuramanyu)te/ rin po che'i gzhi nal sangs rgyas kyi chos bris pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun la mar me snang bar gyur te/ rgyal mtshan shin tu 'phags par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i phyir/ thub pa myed pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad bdud thams cad kyis mi thub pa'i chos can du gyur te/ ye shes dang stobs kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu bsgreng bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad rgyal mtshan 4thams cad mi ltung ba'i 5snang ba can du gyur te/ ye shes mthu bo che'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan par gyur cig/sems can thams cad ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad rnam par dag par gyur te/ ye shes kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 6rab tu 'gyed pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa la brtson zhing rgyal mtsham sna tshogs rab tu bsgreng 7bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing 8brjod du med pa 9rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phyir rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan 1 dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad zhags pa 'thub 11pa dgu bcu rtsa drug gi rgyal mtshan gyis 2dben zhing sems 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur te13/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu thob 1 par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi sbyin pa dbyed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya che zhing yangs pa dang / zab mo thams cad dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ / byang chub sems 36—97

dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang 'byung ba'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa rnam par dag pa thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /1'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che 2thams cad gtong ba la mos pa dang sems can thams cad nor gyis phyug par byed pa dang / rin po che'i mdzod thams cad 'byed pa dang /rin po che'i gter 3thams cad gtong ba dang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas thams cad yongs su gtong ba dang / nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi sbyin pa byed pa dang / rin po che kun gyis sems can thams cad la khyab par byed pa dang ske/ rin po che'i tshogs thams cad rdzongs 4par mi sems pa'i yid kyis gtong ba dang / rin po che'i tshogs thams cad 'thor sgrub 'am/ rin po che thams cad yongs su gtang bar sems bskyed tshopa'i tshe/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs myed pa la rin po che byin pas yongs su bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste7/ sems can thams cad dran pa'i rgyud rmongs pa myed cing / sangs rgyas mthong ba rab tu thob 8par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pas chos dkon mchog gi snang ba rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sbyin pa dang yongs su gtong ba shin tu brtan pas dge 'dun dkon mchog yongs su 'dzin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems rin po che rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rmongs pa myed par gzhol 0bas ye shes rin po che la zhugs par gyur cig /36—98

sems can thams cad ye shes rin po che tshad myed pa yang dag par bstan par 1bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rin po che grangs myed pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i ye shes rin po che mngon par 'tshang rgya ba la brtson pas yon tan rin po che mtha' yas pa'i bsngags pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes rin po che shin tu yangs pa'i mthar thug pas ye shes rin po che bcu drug gi snyoms par 'jug pa rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes rin po che la rnam par sangs rgyas pas rin po che'i dam pas sbyin pa'i gnas kyi mchog tu gyur cig /sems can thams cad tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa myi zad pa'i mdzod kyi chos rin po che rab tu ston pa la brtson pas rin po che'i dbang po dam par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che de dag yongs su gtong zhing sbyin pa byas dpa'i tshe/sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi spyan rin po che rnam par dag cing nyams pa myed pas/ ye shes dam pa rin po che yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus dang yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad rgyan gyis 3shin du brgyan pa/ lus blta na sdug pa lus 4rnam par dag cing myi mthun pa myed pa'i rgyan gyis lus 5shin tu brgyan pa/ rin po che thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis shin tu brgyan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus/ rgyan gyis brgyan par brtson pa/ sems can thams cad la bu'i 'du shes kyis 6'jig rten gyi bde ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bde ba 36—99

thams cad stobs pa1/ dga' ba sna tshogs kyis sems can rab tu dga' bar nabyed pa de rgyan sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dag /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rgyan yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad ye shes kyi rgyan rnam par dag pas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgyan du red par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsod nams kyi rgyud kyi mtshan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / mtshan gyis 4lus shin tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsod nams brgya'i 'amatshan dang ldan pa'i lus can du red de/ lus mtshan gyis shin tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus kyi yan lag mtshan kun gyis brgyan pa dang ldan zhing lus mtshan gyis shin tu rnam 6par bris pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa/ myi zad pa'i mdzod dang ldan zhing tshig gi rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dbyangs kyi yan lag yid du 'ong zhing / rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i dbyangs 7dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshig gi tshul rnam par dag pas/ 'gro ba kun mgu bar byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis tshig yid du 'ong bar brgyan pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kun la lta bas snyoms par 'jug cing / sems kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos snang ba thams cad kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu 36—100
