thob cing / gzungs thams cad kyi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis rgyud shin tu brgyan pas/sems ye shes kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang ldan 1par gyur cig ces/ de 2ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lus kyi rgyan de dag yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang / ye shes kyi 4rgyan yongs su rdzogs te sems can thams cad kyi ris ldan nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang /dregs pa med par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbang phyug la spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas 6mngon par dbang bskur ba/ cod pan dang gtsug gi rin po che'i sbyin pa byed cing yongs su gtong ba dang / mngon par stobs 7pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa dang / ltos pa myed par yongs su gtong ba'i sems rnam par 'phel bar byed pa nadang / sbyin pas bsgos pa'i rgyud yongs su sgom 9pa dang / sbyin pa la dbang sgyur ba 1 rab tu 'jug pa dang / sbyin pa'i ye shes la rab tu slob 11pa dang / sbyin pa gtong ba'i dbang po yongs su skyed 12pa dang / sbyin pa gtong ba'i blo rgya cher byed pa'i tshe/ cod pan dang /gtsug gi rin po che yongs su btang 1 bas/ yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis 7spyi bo nas skadabang bskur bas/ dbang po thams cad la shin tu dbang bskur sabar gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi gtsug gi pha rol tu phyin pa 36—101

thob pas1/ spyi bo 2gtsug tor can gyi mgo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun gyi yon tan gyi spyi bo'i mthar phyin pas/ ye shes rin po che mchog gis sems can thams cad yang dag par sdud par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun gyi laspyi bos phyag bya bar 'os shing / ye shes rin po che 5mchog la yang dag par gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi skyed 6pa la dbang sgyur 7ba rab tu thob 8ste/ ye shes kyi cod pan shin tu bcings par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten kun gyis blta bar mi nus pa'i chos can du gyur te/ ye shes kyi nor bu 1 rin po ches mgo rab tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad spyi bor gyur pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rnam par blta 11ba'i chos can du gyur te/spyi bo shin tu btsun pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes rin po che ru rgya mtsho'i snying po rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing stobs bcu'i rgyan cod pan gyis 1 mgo rab tu brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'dod pa'i khams kyi dang po nas bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms 15pa'i phyir/sa'i dam pa la gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i mthar thug ste/ chos kyi ye shes kyi spyi bo rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu zil kyis myi non pa'i snang ba rab tu thob ste/ rgyal po'i mchog dam par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po cod pan dang gtsug gi rin po che yongs su gtong ba'i sketshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad kyis ye shes mchog gi 'byung gnas rnam par dag pa dang / ye shes kyi cod pan dang / nor bu rin 36—102

po che rab tu thob pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang 1byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos btson rar nabacug cing btson chas ribacings pa'i sems can sdug bsngal ba/ sdug bsngal gyi khyim gyis bskor ba/ shing sgrog dang lcags sgrog dang / ltung gi bcing bas labacings par/ lus lcags thag gis btagasas pa/ bsdams 7pa shin tu rgyu ba'i 8lus can mi bde bas lus shin tu mnar ba/ skyabs 9skyed par ltung ba/ bkres pa dang skom pas nyen pa/gos med pa mun pas yog 1 cing khebs pa/ shin tu rke ba/ brla lcags sgrog 11gis bsgrogs 12pa de lta bu dag mthong nas15/ byang chub sems dpa' 1 snying rje can dang / rgyal po myig bzangs kyis 5ji ltar byas pa bzhin du bdag dang /'khor du bcas lanor thams cad dang bcas par yongs su btang ste/ byin nas btson ra de nas sems can de dag yongs su thar bar byed do/ /des btson 1 ra de nas sems can de dag thar bar byas nas 1 kyang nor gyi sbyin pa thams cad mngon par byin nas sman dang / sman pa dang 9sngags kyi rnam pas lus nad med par byas te/ bde ba dang yid dga' ba la rab tu bkod 2 nas/chos rin po che thos par byas te/ dga' ba'i gtam gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba la bkod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las myi nyams par byed do/ /de de ltar sems can btson ra nas bkye bas/ yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad sred pa'i bcings pa dang / zhags pa las shin tu grol bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes mthong ba'i pha rol tu phyin cing 'khor ba'i rgyud shin tu chad par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bag la nyal ba shin tu 36wa 103

bcom ste/ kun nas 'khor ba dang / rnam par bral bas ma rig pa'i mun pa dang rab rib dang / ling tog rnam par bstsal 1cing / rab rib myed pa'i ye shes yang dag par mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad na'agro ba kun gdon par bya ba'i ye shes kyi mthar thug par gyur te/ khams gsum pa'i bcings pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa myed pa'i sar ye shes bsgribs 5pa myed pa mthong ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob cing nyon mongs pa'i bcings pa thams cad shin tu shigs ( par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rlom sems kyi g.yo ba rnam par rgyu ba thams cad yang dag par gzhom pa'i phyir g.yo ba myed pa'i ye shes la yang dag par gzhol zhing g.yo ba dang rlom sems kyi 7bcings pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad khams gsum thams cad tu chags pa med par gnas shing 'dod pa'i 2dri ma thams cad dang bral te/ 'dod pa'i bcings pa thams cad rnam par spangs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsam pa sangs rgyas thams cad la btang 9bas lhag pa'i bsam pa 1 shin tu grol bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyis klas 1 pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa dag tu sems chags pa myed pa dang / grol zhing bcings pa myed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul 1 ba dang / theg pa chen po la dgod par bya ba'i 1 phyir rnam par rgyu zhing byang chub sems dpa'i 15mngon par shes pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'dong bar gyur cig ces/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad btson 36—104

ra dang / btson ca nas tabakye bas yang dag par bzung naba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad shin tu grol zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang sems can la la zhig srog dang bral 4ba'i phyir gsad du khrid 5pa sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa gzhan dang / gzhan gyis myi bzad cing 'dar ba bcing ba 6lngas bcings pa/ skye bo brgya phrag stong gis kun nas bskor cing 'dzam bu'i megling du gtogs pa sna tshogs nas/ bshal zhing bkri ba naganyen bshes 9kyi rgyud dang ske/ mdza' the )bo'i rgyud thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa/ ral gris gtsab cing gshegs77pa/ gsal shing bsgreng ba 1 la bskyon pa/ lus thams cad kun nas glegs te/se/ me 'bar ba'i nang du dor ba 'am/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa 1 myi bde ba thams cad kyis myi 7bde bar bya ba/ gtse ba tshasna tshogs thams cad du bsgre 3 ba zhig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mthong bar gyur na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de gsad 1 par bya ba de'i don du lus yongs su gtong ste/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' mi pham 19pa dang / rgyal po khyad 2 ripar du 1'gro bas ji ltar byas pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan rnams kyang sems can gsad na pa blu 2 ba'i don du lus thugatong zhing / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad nyams su len pa de bzhin du 25rab tu gtong ba byed cing tshig 'di skad du 2dzismra'o / / khyed kyis da myi bde ba 'di dag 28bdag la gyis shig /lus 'di yongs su gtong gis 29nga'i srog gcadang par gyis shig /nga la ni ci byas so cog 1kyang mi nyan da pa myed kyisari lha/ khyed kyis myi 'di la jim bya bar 'dod pa de las grangs 36—105

med pa'i 'gyur 1du sdug bsngal gyi rnam pas gtse ba 'thams cad kyis myi bde ba sna tshogs su gyis shig ces te/ 'di ltar bdag gis gsad 5par bkri ba mthong yang bdag gi 4lus dang srog gis myi blu 5ba ni/ bdag la tshul dang mi 'dra'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag gis ni sems can thams cad la dmyigs te/ 'gro ba thams cad bsrung ba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 6du sems bskyed 7do/ /snyam nas bdag gi lus dang srog yongs su btang ste/ gsad napar bya ba de blus nas dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo'o/ /sems can thams cad gzhan gyis gtse ba'i sdug bsngal nye bar byung bas lus dang srog shin tu mi 'phrogs 1 par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad las thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub stobs bcur lung bstan pa'i gnas rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ngan song thams cad kyi lam 11las yongs su 'das te/ 'jigs pa thams cad las rab tu thar bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings su zhugs pas 'tsho ba thams cad kyi skabs rab tu rnyed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su bzung 1lhabs/ dgras 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i las dge ba thams cad spyod pas ral gris gtsab 1 pa lta bu'i myi bde ba thams cad las 'das par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub kyi shing dam pa'i drung du phyin cing / 'jigs pa myed par 15bdud kyi sde tshethams cad rnam par 'thor 8bas bag tsha ba dang / 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bla na myed pa'i chos kyi 'jigs 36—106

pa myed pas rnam par dag cing khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i nga ro 'byin pas 'khor gyi 'jigs pa dang / bag tsha ba thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i las la yang dag par spyod cing /'gro ba thams cad kyi nang na bsgribs 1pa myed pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i seng ger 2gyur cig /sems can thams cad skye bo kun yongs su skyong ba'i sems dang ldan zhing / 'gro ba kun tu 'jigs pa myed pa'i khang par zhugs capar gyur cig ces/ de ltar gsad 5par gyur pa dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rang gi lus dang / srog btang ste/ blus zhinas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i btson ra'i sdug bsngal kun spang ba 7dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba myi spang naba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la mgo las gtsug phud dang / thor pag tu bcas pa bslangs 9na/ rgyal po gtsug na rin po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' yan lag dam pa shin tu 'phags pa 1 dang /de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis ji ltar byin 11pa de bzhin du / des slong ba de dag mthong nas/ gtong bar mos pa'i tshig dge bas thor pag dang / gtsug phud du bcas 1 te khyer cig ces stobs shing 1 / kye tshur sheg bdag gi samago las gtsug phud dang / thor pag tu bcas pa long 15shig ces nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i gling na btsun pa khomyi'i dam pa desal/ yid rtse gcig 1 tu byas te/ yid ma 'khrugs pa dang / yid ma 'dres pa dang / las gzhan la mi sems pa'i yid dang / 'jig rten las /'phags pa'i yid dang / rab tu zhi ba'i yid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yid 36—107

dang ske/ dag pa'i yid dang /1 drang ba'i yid dang / rigs 5pa la brtson pa'i yid kyis gtsug phud dang / thor pag tu bcas pa 5de slong ba la gtong ba'i tshe/ gtsug phud dang / thor pag tu bcas par mtshon gyis phog 4ste/mgo las phab nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 5te/ rim gro dang bcas pa'i lus kyis sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar nas/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung 6ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi spyod pa rjes su dran pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / dga' bas 7rnam par spel 8ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / chos kyis yongs su rgyas pa'i yid kyi dbang po 9dang /sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas dengs par mi 'gyur ba'i yid kyi dbang po dang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba skye ba'i mtshan nyid dang / tha dad par khong du chud pa dang /tshor ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 1 pa de dag thams cad myi rtog 11go/ /zhes bya bar rab tu shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad dang / rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu nyanagyur pa'i gtong ba'i sems dang / sems 1 thams cad 1 mkhyen pa nyid du d+kubaskyed pa las phyir myi ldog pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa salhag pa'i bsam pa'i rnam pas thob pa / gzhan gyi dring myi 'jog pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan pa'i tshul la gnas te/ gtsug phud dang / thor pag du bcas pa mgo las rdzog ste/ yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i gtsug gi mchod rten du gyur te/ gtsug tor 18bltar mi snang bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad skra shin tu phra ba dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam 36wa 108

par bstsal 17cing / skra rdo rje nag po'i dam pa lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad skra stug cing skra mtshams legs pa dang / skra snum par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mgo 2legs pa las shin tu legs par skyes pa'i skra rab tu 'jam 5)pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad skra dga' ba 4'khyil pa ltar g.yas phyogs su 'khyil cing dpal gyi be'u dang / bkra shis kyi skra 5dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 0nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par 'das shing sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang ldan pa'i skra thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba thams cad/ rgyas par rang gi skra las 'od gzer 7rab tu 'gyed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi dbu shin tu rnam par dag pa 8ltar skra shin tu mdzes par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems mnyams 9shing ske/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu skra dang dbu 1 lta bur mdzes pa dang ldan pas spyi bo la gzhag pa'i mchod rten du 'os pa'i skra dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi dbu ltar chags pa myed pa'i skra mdzes par skyes pas/mun pa dang / rdul 1 myi chags pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gtsug phud dang / thor pag tu bcas pa yongs su btang bas yang dag par bzung tsho 2ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis 1lhas lta bur shin tu zhi ba'i sems yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu'i mthas gtugs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po slong ba rnams la ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba byed pa dang / rgyal po 36wa 109

zla 'od dang de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa gzhan dag gis gtong ba'i myig yongs su sbyangs pa'i sems dang / ye shes kyi myig yongs su sbyangs pa'i blo dang / chos kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa'i yid kyi gnas dang / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas /mngon du gyur pa'i yid kyi rnam pa dang / mngon par shes pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i yongs su bsngo ba dang / ye shes kyi skye mched la yang dag par btang ba'i sems dang / dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' dang / mnyam par byas pa'i sbyin pa dang / gtong ba'i sems dang /zhe sdang ba med pa'i mig gis dad pa myi zlog 2pa'i dbang dang / slong ba rnams la phan 'dogs pa'i sems dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan la gzhol bas byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po dang / byams pa dang / snying rje yongs su bsgoms 3pa dang / dbang po drug shin tu bsdams pas slong ba rnams la myig byin 4pa de bzhin du de yang mig yongs su gtong zhing chos de lta bu la 5zhugs pa'i sems kyis slong ba dang / 'dod pa dag la sbyin pa byed cing mchod sbyin gyi don la 'jug pa dang / chos kyi mthu shin tu bskyed 6pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi dga' bar blta 7ba dang / bag myed pa'i sred 8pa rnam par zlog par byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dga' ba dang / 'dod pa sna tshogs mthong bas rang gi dga' ba khong du chud par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba myong bar byed pa dang / ci bslangs 0pa'i dngos pos kha myi stongs 1par byed pa dang / myi gnyis pa'i sbyin pa rjes su srung ba dang / rlom sems myed pas shin tu sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba dang / slong ba rnams kyis dngos po ci bslangs pa sbyin par byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar 36—110

yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyi myig tu gyur 1te/ myig gi dam par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi mdzod shin tu yangs pas nyams pa myed napa'i myig tu gyur cig /sems can thams cad snang ba myi 'phrogs pa dang ldan zhing sha'i myig rnam par dag pa yongs su grub par gyur cig /sems can thams cad shi ca'apho dang /skye ba shes shing lha'i myig rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'dong zhing chos kyi myig rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gtong sgrub thams cad rnam par ston pas shes rab kyi myig thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi 6spyan dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chags pa myed pa'i myig gi mthar thug ste/ kun tu lta ba'i mig dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sems can gyi khams yongs su shes shing / rab rib med pa'i mig dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu mnga' ba'i de bzhin gshegs par phyin pas bsgribs pa med 7pa'i myig dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myig yongs su gtong ba na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshad kyi myig gi chos sems can thams cad yongs su bsngo ba la nye bar 'god do// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/8 bam po lnga 9pa/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar rgyal po khyad par du 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' mdud pa med pa'i 1 spyi gtsug gis 11yongs su btang ba bzhin du slong ba nye bar 'ongs pa la byang chub 36—111

sems dpa'i spyod pa blang ba'i 1sems dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su rinarigs dang ldan par byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs su byung ba'i sbyin pa'i sems dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rjes su dran pa'i spyod pa la brtson pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu mthun par skyes pa dang / dbang po dang / ye shes dang / yon tan gyis shin tu btsun pa dang / khams gsum ma dag cing snying po med pa la snying por rab tu rtogs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' blta ba rab tu thob pas/ rang gi lus la chags pa med pa'i sems dang / gnas 5med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rjes su dran par gnas pa dang / dul 6ba dang zhi ba'i sems dang /dbang po'i rgyu ba shin tu zhi ba dang / 'gro ba'i mya ngam 7thams cad nas sems can nagadon par sems pa'i 9ye shes 'byung ba'i shes rab 1 chodang / bsod nams kyi 'byung gnas dang / rgyud ched du brjod pa rgya mtshos 11gtong ba'i sems yangs par byas pa dang / don la rnam par nges pa'i chos dang /mgon po thams cad kyi lam du 'jug pa dang / chos kyi dbang phyug la ye shes kyis spyod 12pa dang / rang gi lus snying po med pa las 1/snying po blang ba'i 4blos yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rna ba dang / sna yongs su btang bas yang dag par bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad chos thams cad 15kyi sgra rnam par rig par bya ba la chags pa myed pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyis sgra thams cad skad ji lta ba bzhin du shes par bya ba'i phyir bsgribs sapa med pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snyan 1 dang 36—112

ldan pas thogs pa myed pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rna ba'i skye mched shin tu bsgoms pas rna ba rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rnam par shes pa zhi ba 1skye ba'i phyir bsgribs na pa med pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgasung khong du chud pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsgribs 4pa myed pa'i chos rnam par rig 5par bya ba'i phyir gnas myed pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyir rgol ba 6'jig par byed pa'i 47shes pa la myi phyed pa'i 2rin ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rna ba shin tu dag pa la dbang sgyur bas 9)kun tu 'jug pa'i rna ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snyan rab tu thob 3 par bya ba thob pas lha'i rna ba rab tu thob par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 11rna ba yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi/ rna ba rnam par dag pa'i phyir yongs su bsngos nas/ sna rnam par dag par yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad legs par mthong ba'i sna dang / dpe byad bzang po'i sna dang / mtshan bzang po'i sna dang / shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i 32sna dang / rnam par dag pa'i sna dang ske/ rim gyis gzhol ba'i sna dang / mdzes pa 15'phags pa'i sna dang /dgra thams cad rab tu 'dul ba'i sna dang / ngo 14blta na sdug pa'i sna dang /de bzhin gshegs pa masangs rgyas kyi shangs rab tu 'thob pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o / /sems can thams cad ngo la mi sdug pa med pa dang chos thams cad kyi 36—113

ngo dang 1/ chags pa med pa'i ngo dang / blta 2na sdug pa'i ngo dang / mi mthun pa myed pa'i ngo dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo dang / kha na ma tho ba myed pa'i ngo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta bu'i ngo dang ske/ kun nas blta dba'i ngo dang / yid du 'ong zhing tshad med pa'i ngo dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rna ba dang / sna yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la yongs su bsngo ste/ ci nas kyang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis casangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shin tu 'dus par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shin tu shes par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis pasangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la shin tu 'jug par 'gyur ba dang ske/ ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad shin tu mthong bar 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyisam sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 7sgo khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad shin tu zil gyis myi non pa'i yongs su dag pa 'thob 8par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis smyosangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la snang ba rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang ske/ ci nas kyang sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nya byin gyis brlabs pa'i lus dang ldan par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba 36—114

de dag yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyid 3)pa zil gyis myi non pa'i sa la gnas te/ u dum bas skar ltar shin tu dkon par sems pa'i sems rnam par dag pa dang / dgatong ba myi zad cing 'byam rtsoklas pa dang55ci/ ngad 6)cing klung sprugs 7te gtangs8chiba'i sems dang ske/ yongs su gtong ba'i blo mtha' yas pa dang / dul ba dang / yongs su dul ba'i yid kyis gtong ba'i dbang po dang / gtong ba thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i (ḍa1mthar thug pa'i 3 )thams cad mkhyen pa'i smon lam dang 'gro ba thams cad bde bar byed pa'i gtong ba'i 'bras bu dang / gtong ba chen po dang ske/ shin tu gtong ba dang / rab tu gtong ba dang / mchog tu gtong ba'i sems kyis rang gi lus dang / yan lag dang / gdong gis kyang phan 'dogs pa dang / myi smon 11par gtong ba'i sems kyis rnam pa de lta bu'i chos la rab tu gnas te ji ltar rgyal po me tog so dang / glang po'i rgyal po mche ba drug pas so ji ltar byin pa de bzhin du rang gi 32lus dang / kha nas so yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun gyis mchod rten du mchod par 'os 1 par gyur te/mche ba dkar zhing rno ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rab tu thob pas so mnyam zhing thags 'bazang bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la legs par zhugs shing / dul ba'i sems kyis nye bar spyod par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gdong gi dkyil 'khor blta 415na sdug cing sakha'i nad dang so rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha dang 1 so dpe myed pa 18rnam 36wa 115

par dag cing / bzhin dran pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad so bzang po'i gseb nas spos zhim po'i tshomachog grangs med pa yid du 'ong ba'i dga' ba bskyedam pa'i ngad 'byung bas yongs su dag cing so bzhi bcu tshang ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad shin tu dul ba'i so rab tu thob cing bkra shis dang / dga' ba 'khyil pa dang / pad mo sna tshogs kyis mdzes par bris pa'i so dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gdong gi dkyil 'khor nas tshad med pa'i 'od gzeras )snang ba byung 5ribs 'od zer 6bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mtha' yas pa rab tu 'byung ba'i so dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha zas la ma chagasame/ ma zhen cing kha na ma tho ba med par spyod pas sbyin pa'i naganas dam pa'i mthar thug par gyur te/so'i thags legs shing 'bras chan 95kha phye ba lta bur gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i dam pa lung ston cing so'i gseb kun nas 'od 'phro ba kha dog mtha' yas pa'i snang ba 'byung ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' 1 so'i sbyin pas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can ma lus par 11thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par bskyed 1 pa dang / chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyis chos 1 thams cad shes pa ngarnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang dbyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la lce bslangs dzin ji ltar rgyal po bzhin bzangs tsho1 dang —/ byang chub sems dpa' 1 phyir mi ldog pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis kyang skye ba'i skye mched rnam pa sna tshogs dag la gnas shing tshe rabs 9bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa 2 de dag tu yongs 36—116

su btang bar gyur pa de bzhin du des kyang slong ba de dag rgyal po la 'os pa'i seng ge'i gdan dag la bkod cing slong bas mos pa'i sems kyi 1)yid du 'ong zhing 'jam pa'i ngag dang / byams pa la spyod pa'i sems kyis rang gi ༷lce gtong ba'i tshe/ gshe ba med pa'i sems 5)dang / rma 4med pa'i sems dang /nyams pa med pa'i sems dang / rigs chen po'i rigs dang ldan pa'i sems dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs su 'byungs457ba'i sems dang / byang chub kyi sems la dgod cing gzhag pa'i sems dang / rgyud 'khrug46)pa med pa'i sems dang /mthu stobs chen po'i shugs kyi sems dang / lus la ma chags pa'i sems dang / tshig tu pebarjod pa lashogachags pa med pa'i sems su byas 9te/ pus mo'i 1 tsholha nga sa la btsugs nyu1shing bdag gi kha nas lce phyung 32ste/ lus thams cad la slong ba dbang byed du bcug nas/ tshig 1lhamanyen zhing 'jam pa dang / yid du 'ong ba dang ske/ byams par spyod pas tshig tu brjod cing / ci nas kyang khyed dga' zhing yid bde ba dang / mgu zhing rangs par bdag gi lce long 3 la gang du dgos pa 1gede'i dgos pa sgrubs 7shig ces nas/ de lce sbyin zhing yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ lce yongs su btang 1 bas/ yang dag par bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad tshig 18gi tshul thams cad kyis shes par byed pa'i phyir lce shin tu yangs sna pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad yang dag pa 2 ji lta ba bzhin gyi tshig bden pa gnyis su bya ba med pa dang ldan par gyur te/ gdong gi dkyil 'khor khebs pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad 21kyi cho 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag par ston 36—117

pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du khyab pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ro bro ba'i mchog shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / ldan zhing shin tu srab 1pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun gyi tshig shes pas the tsom nagacod pa'i phyir nges pa'i tshig gi dbyangs —rimatha' yas pa yod 4pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lce'i mdzod nas 'od gzer pa bye ba khrag khrig brjod du med pa'i yang ri tshobarjod du med pa 'gyed pa'i phyir snang ba mtha' yas pa 'byung 7ba'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad rnam par nges pa'i spobs pa'i tshogs mi zad pas ston cing brjod pas tshig shin tu nges par skorabarjod pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad spyod pa kun brjod pa tshad med pa'i mdzod kyi lce dang ldan zhing 'dul ba'i 9mtha' dang mnyam par sems can kun gyi tshig thams cad dang / smra ba thams cad rnam par 'grel pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad spyod pa rjes su brjod 1 pa'i tshig gi 11rgya mtsho thams cad la rab tu zhugs pas dbyangs kyi tshogs dang / tshig gi rnam par shes pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad spyod pa thams cad 12mngon par brjod 1 pa'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob cing chos thams cad kyi tshig thams cad shin tu ston pa'i lce dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du dmyigs pa'i smon lam la rab tu brtson pa de lce yongs su btang bas/ yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis bsgribs k+ṣa pa med pa'i ye shes chags pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su 36—118

bsngo'o / /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi dam pa/ mgo lta bu'i ye shes la 'jug cing / sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i mgo byang chub khong du chud par byed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi mchog tshul gyi mgo dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par lta ba dang /ye shes rnam par dag pa'i mgo la yang dag par lta ba dang / bsgribs 1pa myed pa'i mgo yongs su sgrub napa dang / sa dam pa'i mgo rjes su lta ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi ye shes dam pa mgo lta bu ri'adod cing tshol ba dang / khams gsum pa thams cad kyis bltar med pa'i ye shes kyi mgo'i dam pa yang dag par sgrub zhipa dang / phyogs thams cad du phyin pa'i ye shes kyi rgyal po'i mgo la mngon par mos par byed pa dang chos thams cad la dbang byed pa 5zil gyis myi non pa'i mgo yongs su grub par byed cing / de lta bu'i chos la spyod par brtson nepa'i byang chub sems dpa' 7sangs rgyas kyi rigs thams cad kyi yongs su gtong ba'i tshul la bslabs 8pa/ sangs rgyas la mos pa skyes pas dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu thob pa/ slong ba mtha' yas pas 1 dga' bas yongs su rgyas pa'i sems dang ldan pa yid kyi dbang po shin tu gsal ba/ rgyud rab tu dang zhing 11sems dang yid shin tu dang ba1 / sangs rgyas kyi chos la dga' ba'i snang ba thob pa/byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa shin tu rgya che ba/ rgyun mi 'chad par sems pa/gtong ba chen po gtong ba shin tu gtong ba da/ gtong ba'i yid dang ldan pa 1 dbang po shin tu dga' bas nye bar brtan pa'i chos can lhag pa'i bsam pa yangs shing dge la rgya che bas sbyin pa gtong bar mngon par 'dod pa15/ laji ltar byang chub sems dpa' ye shes mchog dang / skyes bu dam pa ka shi'i rgyal po 36—119

dang ske/ de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan grangs med pa dag kyang mgo yongs su btang 1bar gyur pa/ de ltar mgo gtong ba'i tshe / mgo yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi dbu rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /spyi gtsug bltar dmi snang ba dang / skye mched zil gyis ma rinon pa dang / zhing thams cad du mngon par 'phags pa dang / bum pa rgyas pa dang / dga' ba 'khyil pa dang / skra dang mgo'i 'od dang 'od gzer sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad rirmad du byung ba dang ske/ dpal gyi be'us brgyan 6pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbu dang ldan pa dang ske/ ye shes kyi mgo rtogs 7par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi mchog tu phyin pa'i mgo dang ldan pa dang / mgo rnam par dag pa dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mgo yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ste/ de 8ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mgo yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyis chos kyi mchog yongs su rdzogs pa dang / ye shes kyi yan lag dam pa rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po slong ba rnams la dang ba'i 1 lag pa thog mar 'gro ba dang / phan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang / chos spyod pa la brtson par 'gro zhing ldog pa dang / rin po che'i lag pa thog mar 'gro bas lag pa gtong ba dang / spyod pa don yod par ribyang chub sems dpa'i lam la spyod pa dang / lag pa gshin tu brkyang zhing gtong ba'i sems ma 'khrugs slopa dang / rim par spyod pa'i tshul shin tu nges 36wa 120

pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rtsal gyis spyod cing lag pa yangs pa/gtong ba la mos pas lag pa yongs su gtong ba dang / tshul gyi gzhi chen po rab tu brtan pa la spyod pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa'i yid dang ba 1dang / tshor bas ma nyams pa'i blo dang ba dang / 'gro ba ma yin par 'gro ba 'a/sa phyir log pa'i 'gro bas byang chub tu 'byung bas/ 5de ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtson pa dang / rgyal po dga' ldan ridang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan tshad myed pa dag kyang skye ba'i skye gnas sna tshogs dag na gnas shing lag pa yongs su gtong bar gyur pa de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems yangs shing rgya che ba tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mthong bar gyur pa/ chos kyi rgyud kyi sgo rnam par phye rib/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par gtong 5riba'i lag pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'dzin pa'i smon lam can/ sems bskyed pa rdul med pa dang 6'grogs pas kun nas bskor ba med pa/ ye shes dang chos kyi lus rgyun mi 'chad pa/ mi shigs 7mi chod pa'i lus dang ldan pa/ bdud kyi las thams cad kyis mi skul ba / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nye bar brtan pas sems spel ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spyad 9pa dang gcig 1 tu gyur pa'i gtong bas byung ba de 11slong ba la rka lag gi sbyin pa byed cing yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du dmyigs te/ rka lhalag yongs su btang 1 ba yongs su byin pa 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa de dag 'di ltar sems can thams cad la g.yongs su bsngo'o10/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 36wa 121

'dis sems can thams cad rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa thob cing rin po che'i lag pa dang ldan par gyur cig /de dag rin po che'i lag pa des sems can thams cad /sbyin pa'i gnas kyi 'du shes rab tu thob ste/ phan tshun gyi lus la rin po ches 'thor bar 2gyur cig /mngon par 'thor bar 5gyur cig /rab tu 'thor bar cagyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du khyab pa'i rin po che'i rgyan gyi 5sprin gyis 6sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur cig /sems can de dag thams cad kyang phan tshun du zhe sdang ba myed pa'i sems dang ldan zhing phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig /de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rjes su dong zhing 'jigs pa med pa la gnas te/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i phyir thams cad lag na rin po che thogs pa dang / lag na spos thogs pa dang lag na gos thogs pa dang / lag na gdugs thogs pa dang /lag na phreng 7ba thogs pa dang / lag na me tog thogs pa dang / lag na phye ma thogs pa dang / lag na lhab lhub thogs pa dang / lag na me tog mtha' yas pa nathogs par gyur te9/ kun nas sgo dang ldan pa'i thabs la gnas shing /sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par brtson pa'i sems dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu 'gro ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i lag pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad yang dag par 'dzin pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gyi lag pa mtshan bzang po dang ldan pa'i lag pa dang /'od gzer 1 gyi mdzod mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gtong ba'i lag pa dang ske/ 'gro ba thams cad lag mthil gcig 12gis yog 1 par byed pa'i lag pa dang ske/ dra bar 'brel cing sen mo zangs ltar 'dug pa'i lag pa dang /36—122

sangs rgyas kyi phyag shin tu yangs pa dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa byed par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad la rab tu zhugs pa'i sems bskyed pa dang /khas len pa'i ngang tshul dang / slong ba thams cad la 1mngon par mos shing 'dod pas dga' ba dang / spro ba dang dang ba nachen po rab tu thob pa dang /slong ba 'bod par ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang /rgyud kyi tshul gcig gtu gyur pas rka 5lag yongs su gtong ba byed cing 'gro ba thams cad kyi byang chub tshol ba'i rka 6lag yongs su gtong 7bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar thams cad gtong ba'i don du yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsam pa dang / sems dang yid du ldan pa byang chub kyi sems kyis rab tu dga' ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mngon par dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tshor bas dengs par mi 'gyur ba'i sems dang ldan pa/slong ba thams cad la mngon par mos pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ len pa thams cad la zhe mi sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gtong ba'i lam du 9rab tu zhugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gtong bas sbyin par bya ba'i rjes su srung ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa rgya chen pos btang 1 ba shin tu gtong ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sems rgyun mi 'chad 11pa dang ldan pa / bdag gi lus la 12phangs par mi lta ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ de ji ltar 36—123

byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / rgyal po yid bde bar sems pa dang / de ma yin pa'i 17byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan grangs myed pa dag kyang skye ba'i skye gnas de dang de dag la gnas shing khrag yongs su gtong bar gyur pa de ltar slong ba rnams la rang gis lus kyi khrag gtong ba'i tshe / khrag yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de ca'adi ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad chos dang ye shes kyi lus dang ldan zhing byang chub sems dpa'i lus phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rdo rje'i snying po dang 'dra bar dge sbyong gi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus nyams pa myed cing dag pa dang ldan te lus la rma med par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten kun 5gyis mi 'phrogs sgrupa'i sems dang ldan zhing sprul pa lta bu'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'od dang ba'i lus nyams pa myed pa dang ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mi gnas pa dang ldan zhing chos kyi dbyings su mngon par skyes pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gzhan thams cad 7la rim gro byed pa'i lus dang ldan zhing / rin po che lta bu'i 'od yod pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'chi ba med pa'i dbyings su chos kyi skyid pa la dbang sgyur ba'i lus dang ldan zhing ske/ ye shes dam pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun kyis blta na don yod par skyes pas rigerin po che rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'o)lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten kunam〉gyi gtse bas 36—124

gos pa med cing bar snang gi rang bzhin gyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig ces/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi lus las 1khrag gi sbyin pa 2byed pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi 3theg pa dang / theg pa chen po la rab tu gzhol ba'i sems kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag cayongs su bsngo'o/ / dag pa'i 5yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /yangs pa'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /tsi dga' ba'i 7yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /rangs pa'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /spro ba'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /zhum pa med pa'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /bde ba'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /dang ba'i yid kyis yongs su bsngo'o/ /mgu ba'i yid dang rab tu dga' ba'i yid dang / yid bde zhing rangs pa skyes pas / dge ba'i rtsa ba de 8yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gtong ba'i sems gzhal du myed pa'i dga' bas 9rnam par 'phel ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang mkhas pa'i skye bos bsten pa'i zla myed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 11dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dam pa 1 'jig rten gyi dri ma bstsal 1 ba dang / slong ba thams cad kyis zad par 1 mi nus pa'i nang gi lus nye bar blangs pa'i yongs su gtong ba dang / yon tan rin po ches yang dag par blangs pa'i 'dage ba 'byam 7klas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yi dam gyis 1 nye bar blangs pa'i sbyin pa'i tshogs chen po dang ske/ slong ba thams cad kyi yid 1 kyis 'dod par bsam pa 19btang yang 'gyod pa myed pa'i sems dang sbyin pa 2 la dmyigs pa'i dngos pos shin tu brtags 21pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa'i rten dang / len pa 22rnams la sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i sems nyams pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad 36wa 125

mngon du gyur pa pha 1lta bu'i 'du shes su mngon par 'dzin na pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad la mngon du gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rnam par dag pa la gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan thams cad dang / 'gro ba thams cad lam mngon du gyur pa'i snying rje chen pos yongs su skyob pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub la mngon du gyur pa'i stobs bcu 4rnam par spyod 5pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i dus thams cad 6dge ba'i rtsa ba mthun paras7)yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / mi 'jigs pa thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i nga ro bsgrags 8pa dang / dus gsum mngon du gyur pa'i dus thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dus gsum thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par thug par zhe non pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang yongs su yi chad 9pa med pas mngon du gyur pa'i sems bskyed pa/ grangs med pas 1 ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' phan pa tshol ba dang / rgyal po thams cad gtong ba dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan grangs med pa dag kyang skye ba'i 12skye mched sna tshogs dag na gnas shing sha dang rkang yongs su btang 1 ba de ltar slong ba rnams la lus las ngasha dang rkang yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ sha dang rkang yongs su btang 15bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 10sems can thams cad rdo rje'i snying po ltar 'khregs pa'i yan lag dang ldan zhing mi shigs 1 pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur 36—126

cig /sems can thams cad gsog nyu7med pa'i lus rab tu thob pas gsog gem yin pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad yid kyi rang bzhin gyi /lus rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyis brgyan pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lus shin tu grub pas bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs 5pa'i stobs bcu tha mi dad cing mnyams pa dang ldan te dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus nernam par bris pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rab tu thob pas mtha' las 'das pa tshad med pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bdud thams cad kyi dkrugs 7ma rab tu 'joms 8pas kun tu khyab pa'i spyod lam dang ldan 9zhing thub pa med pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i khosangs rgyas thams cad dang lus gcig 11par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings kun tu chos kyi skus khyab par byed pa'i phyir 12chags pa med pa'i lus mngon par grub par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad shong ba'i lus dang ldan zhing byang chub kyi lus 1lhadam pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen par dmigs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ slong ba la 14sha dang rkang yongs su gtong ba'i tshe 15dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi sku mtha' las 'das pa 15tshad med pa 1 rnam par dag pa rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' 36—127

sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i rgyud la bslabs 1pa'i sems dang ldan pa 27sbyin pa thams cad byin pas spyod pa'i sems dang ldan pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa chen po thob pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu 'gro ba'i sbyin patsha grub pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 4byin pa'i rjes su bslabs geri pa'i sems dang ldan pa sbyin pa dang / yongs su gtong ba thams cad kyis 3byezad mi shes pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sbyin pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu gnas pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i las la rab tu gnas pa'i 3)sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad yid la bya bas na mngon du gyur pa'i gtong ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ slong ba thams cad rgyun mi 'chad 9par rgyu ba rab tu mchod pa'i 1 sems dang ldan pa/ de ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' yongs su skyo ba myed pa dang / rgyal po g.yo ba med pa dang —/ de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan grangs med pa dag gis kyang snying yongs su btang bar gyur pa/ de ltar slong ba 31kun nas 12'ongs pa rnams kyis bslangs shing / rang gi 1 lus las snying yongs su gtong zhing sbyin pa byed pa dang / spong ba dang / thob par byed 3gepa dang /lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par spyad pa khridang / 'gro ba thams cad rab tu dgrol tsoba'i phyir stobs bcu'i byang chub la dmyigs par byed pa dang / smon lam chen pos nan tan du byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yang dag par gnas pa dang / smon lam yongs su mi gtong bas/ sbyin pa byed pa'i tshe/dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/sems can thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin lta bus yongs su bzung nyi ba'i snying 36—128

dpal gyi be'us brgyan pa dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i ri khor 1yug thams cad ltar myi shigs shing rdo rje'i snying po lta bu'i snying dang ldan pa dang / bag tsha ba med pa'i snying dang thub par dka' ba'i snying dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs napa'i snying dang / dpa' ba'i rgyal mtshan ye shes kyi snying po can gyi snying dang / mthu bo che 5chen po dam pa'i sems kyi rgyal mtshan lagyi snying dang /'gro ba thams cad kyi gtso bo lta bur myi 'phrogs 5pa'i snying dang / mthu bo che ltar myi shigs pa'i snying po can gyi snying dang / bdud kyi las dang bdud kyi dpung dang 0bdud kyi sde 7rnam par 'joms 8pa'i snying dang / brtan pa'i snying dang ske/ gzeng mthos9 ba'i snying dang / dpa' ba'i snying dang / brtul 1 phod pa'i snying dang / myi 'jigs myi dngangs skrag par nyu1phyi 'gyur ba'i snying dang /rdo rje'i go cha 32chen po yang dag par bgos 1 pa'i snying dang / shin tu btsun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i snying dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pas byang chub snang bar gyur pa'i snying dang / byang chub kyi shing drung du 'dug nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rjes su rtogs shing rmongs pa med par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du thumangon par 'tshang rgya ba'i snying dang / stobs bcu mngon par byang chub pa rab tu 'thob pa'i snying dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying gi sbyin pas yang dag par bzung 15ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyis gos pa myed pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba'i thugs phun sum tshogs pa tshoyongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan par yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang 1 3byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po slong ba mngon par dad par byed pa'i lta ba dang gsal zhing dga' 36wa 129

bar byed pa'i mig dang byang chub dang mnyam par bya ba'i byams pa dang / ci 'dod pas slong ba phu dud du bya ba'i sbyin pa dang / rgyun myi 'chad par yid la byed pa'i gtong ba dang / lus la snying po med par rtogs pas snying po blang ba'i tsho1sems dang / dang bar 'gyur ba'i 2lus rjes su dran pa yid la byed pa dang /spyang ki 3dang / wa dang / khyis za 4bar 'gyur ba'i lus su rab tu rtogs 5pa dang spyo/ gzhan la rag lus shing lus myi rtag par yid la 'byed pa dang / lus kyi rgyus 7thams cad khong du chud pa dang / gzhan la dad pa'i sems dang de lta bu'i /chos de dag yid la bya ba la 9brtson pa de ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' legs par byin pa dang / rgyal po sdig pa bstsal 1 ba dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan grangs med pa dag gis kyang slong ba rnams la rgyu ma dang mchin pa dang / mkhal ma dang / glo ba yongs su btang bar gyur pa de ltar rgyu ma dang mchin pa dang / mkhal ma dang / glo ba yongs su btang 1 ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' rislong ba de dag la mi 'gebs pa'i mig gis lta 15zhing 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ 'di ltar bdag gi 7lus mi rtag cing 'di ltar mi gtsang na 'on kyang rgyu ma dang mchin pa dang mkhal ma dang / glo ba lta bu dag kyang slong ba dag la dgos pa ltas sbyin par bya'o zhes de lta bur yid la byed cing dga' ba'i rgyud sna dang / de ltar chos nyid shes pa'i bsam pa dang / slong ba mthong ba de 9dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ri'adu shes pa'i byin gyi 21rlubs kyis lus snying po med pa de las snying po blang bar 22'dod de/ de lta bur yid la byed cing rab tu rtogs 2 pa dang ldan pa'i 2nisems kyis rgyu ma dang mchin pa dang / mkhal ma dang glo ba de dag yongs su 36wa 130

gtong ba'i tshemanya)dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ston / rgyu ma dang mchin pa dang mkhal ma dang glo ba yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad ye shes kyi snying po'i lus dang ldan zhing lus kyi phyi nang shin tu gtsang zhing ridag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cadam nomakhyen pa'i smon lam yang dag par 'dzin pa'i phyir0ye shes kyi lto dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nang spos zhim po'i mchog thams cadas6)dang ldan zhing phyi rol tu 'od gzer ④rab tu 'gyed pas/ lta rin na bzang ba'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rimatshalagyis gzhol zhing mnyamamu )pa'i lus kyi yan lag dang ldan te/ gzhu lta bu'i lto 1dang ldan pa'i lus su gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dga' bas lus shin tu bskyed kyi pas lus chos kyi zas dang ye shes kyis gso 1 bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad dga' ba'i lus dang chos kyi lus kyis yang dag par spyod pas nyu 5zad myi shes pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa'i chos snang ba dang ldan pas gzungs kyi snying pos lus kyi nang rnam par dag par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nang gi 155bsam pa'i rgyud shin tu sbyangs pas lus yongs su dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyis ngoms tshepar byed pa'i 1 tshochos kyi sprin gyi char rab tu 'bebs pas 32de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang ye shes kyi rnal 'byor khong du chud par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyi rol gyi lus 'gro ba thams cad la ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan mdzes shing snang bar gyur pas nang gi kyi lus dag cing zhi bar gyur 36wa 131

cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 6)rgyu ma dang /mchin pa dang / mkhal ma dang / glo ba de dag rang gi lus las du slong ba rnams la 3yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi lus phyi nang yongs su dag cing bsgribs 4pa med pa'i ye shes la rab tu 'khod pa thob par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi 'byung gnas dang / rgyal po skar ma'i 'od dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dag gis kyang yan lag dang nying lag dang /rus pa slong ba rnams la yongs su btang sgrubar gyur pa de ltar yan lag dang /nying lag dang / rus pa bslangs pa ne na/ slong ba rnams la tshegatong ba'i tshe/slong ba mthong ma thag shegatu sems dga' ba dang / sems mos pa dang /sems dad pa dang / sems rab tu spro ba dang / sems 'thadarashe)pa dang /byams pa'i sems dang / chags pa med pa'i sems dang / dag pa'i sems dang ske/ slong ba rnamasamanya la rim gror bya ba'i 31sems rab tu 'thob ste/ de 32yan lag dang nying lag dang / rus pa de dag bslangs 1 pas slong ba la yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ rang gi lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag dang / rus pa yongs su btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad rus pa dang sha dang / khrag med pa'i lus dang ldan zhing sprul pa lta bu'i lus can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus la thub pa med cing zil gyis mi non pas rdo rje lta bu'i stobs kyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /36—132

sems can thams cad chags pa med cing grol ba dang / bcings pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 17lus kyis byung ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i 5stobs dang / chos su ldan pa'i lus phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dbang po tha mi dad cing gcad du med pa rab tu thob pas ye shes kyi stobs kyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi stobs dang dbang gi pha rol tu phyin pa thob pas chos kyi stobs kyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus shig shig po myed pas yan lag shin tu brtan pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun yongs su smin par byed cing 'dul ba la zhugs pas 'gro ba thams cad ji ltar mos pa'i lus dang yan lag gi byin gyi rlabs 5dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mthu bo che'i yan lag dang nying lag yang dag par zin pas pa stobs chen po dang ldan zhing ye shes la gnas pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chad cing dub pa med pa'i lus rab tu thob pas shin tu brtan par lus kyi rgyud 'brel ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mthu dang 'bartson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa'i lus kyis shin tu brtan zhing stobs dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mtha' yas pa'i ye shes kyi khyu mchog gi mthus 'byin pa'i lus dang ldan zhing chos kyi lus kyis 7'gro ba thams cad du rnam par brgyan pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha na ma tho ba myed cing blta na na don yod pa dang ldan te/ bsod nams kyi stobs kyi lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gnas med pa'i ye shes kyi mthar thug ste/ gnas pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams 36—133

cad sangs rgyas thams cad kyis41bsam pa byin gyis brlabs pa nadang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyis yongs su bzung sa ba'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad cadu 'gro ba'i lam gyi lus kyi rjes su song bas 5)'gro ba thams cad la phan 'dogs pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la phyir phyogs pa med cing mngon par lta ba'i snang bas sgo kun nas 6blta 7ba'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa la spyod pa brtsams 2)pa mthar phyin par bya ba la brtson pa'i 9brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i lus nya ༄phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes brtan par gnas pa thob pas nga rgyal dang rlom 1 pa dang / dregs pa thams cad rgyun chad 12cing rnam par dag pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa la yang dag par 1 ji lta ba bzhin du las 1 4grub par gyur pas brtul zhugs dam pa'i 7lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tsho'ajig rten du 1 skyes pa'i lus thams cad las rnam par 'das shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge bas byung ba'i 18lus su gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yan lag dang nying lag dang rus pa de dag slong ba rnams la yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes grub par bya ba dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar 19byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi lus las slong ba dag gis mdog dang ldan pa'i pags pa bslangs 2 pa'i tshe/mtshon cha thogs pa'i slong ba mthong yang dga' bar byed pa'i dbang pos slong ba 36—134

la lta zhing slong ba rnams la drin du gzo ba'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas legs par bting 1ba'i stan la slong ba rnams bkod de/ slong ba rnams la rim gro'i 8'du shes nye bar gzhog pa dang / len pa rnams la shin tu dkon pa'i 'du shes yang dag par skyed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzhir gyur pa smon par bya ba yang dag par mthong bar sems shing slong ba rnams la phan 'dogs pa'i sems kyis 7rtog cing 'dzum pa ri dang ldan par lta bas slong ba rnams la lta dezhing tshur sheg /longasabashig ces bya ba'i tshig brjod pa dang / slong ba rnams la bdag nyid ji stidaga' bar bya ba 8gtong ba de ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' dag pa'i snying popo)dang / ri dgas nya rikyi rgyal po gser gyi rtsib logs ltar mdog dang ldan pa'i pags hu1pa slong ba rnams la yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyis mi ngoms shing rnam par dag pas shin tu 'jam pa'i mdog dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rdo rje'i mdog thub par dka' nya ba'i kha dog dang ldan zhing ma 'dres pa'i kha dog dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi 1 snying po ltar dag cing gser gyi mdog dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du kha dog rnam par sbyang bas 1 chodag cing kha dog mtha' yas pa'i mdog dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dge sbyong de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gzhon pa'i kha dog gis rnam par dag cing rtog pa med cing dang ba'i kha dog dang / mdog gi mchog dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis kha dog rnam par dag cing kha dog 36—135

dang mdog gi dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe 1byad bzang pos rnam par bris shing nasangs rgyas kyi kha dog rnam par dag pas mdog dang kha dog shin tu rnam par dag 3par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kha dog dang mdog bzang po phun sum tshogs shing 'gro ba kun tu mdog gi snang ba rab tu 'gyed par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'od gzer lagyi dkyil 'khor brjod du med pa rnam par 'gyed pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan zhing mdog 'od gzer 5)gyi dra ba can dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gzugs thams cad kyi kha dog rnam par dag ste/ mdog dang kha dog shin tu snum 6 pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rang gi lus las rtsomadog dang ldan pa'i pags 8pa slong ba rnams la yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems la phyin ci log med pa/ bzhin 9'dzum pa can yid bde ba thob pa / theg pa chen po la legs par gnas pa/ grags pa 'dod pa med pa'i sbyin pa can/ snying thag nya pa nas sbyin pa la gnas pa/ gtong ba dang /11gtong ba chen po la yid rab tu 12zhugs pa/ 'jungs pa'i dri ma la mi gnas pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ phrag dog dang 'jungs 1 pa'i dri ma dang bral ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la rab tu zhugs pa/ de ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' lta ba'i brtson 'grus dang 'dzam bu'i 1 gling gi bdag po gser gyi 'od 36wa 136

dang ske/ de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tshad myed pa gzhan 1dag gis kyang sor mo 3rnams yongs su btang bar gyur pa ltar slong ba la rkang 3lag gi sor mo yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 4de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar geskabasngo ste/ sor mo byin pa dang / ci blangs 6pa'i dngos po btang bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phyag soram nithob par gyur te/ sor mo ring bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sor mo rim 3gyis gzhol par legs par grub pas sor mo zlum pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sen mo gang ba'i sor mo rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sen mo zangs kyi kha dog lta bu'i 1 sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad chos thams cad 'dzin par brtson pa'i sor mo dpe byad bzang po dang ldan zhing skyes bu dpa' bo 11thams cad mkhyen pa'i sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i phyag sor dang ldan par gyur te/ge/ dpe byad bzang pos grub pa'i sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa'i sor mo tshul dang mthun par skyes pas sor mo'i dam pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sor mo'i chos nyid kyi yan lag dang bum pa gang ba dang / bkra shis kyis rnam par mdzes pa dang ldan zhing sor mo'i rtse mo la 'khor lo yod pa'i sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i phyag sor 'phrinatshwa las kyi rnam par sbyin pa 7rgyu mthun par 15byung ba lta bu dang ldan 16zhing pad mo bzang po dang / dga' ba 'khyil pas sor mo thams cad kyi tshigs dang yan lag shin tu brgyan cing dpe byad bzang pos mdzes par rnam par phye

ba'i rgyan 1gyis brgyan pa'i sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa snang bar bya ba la brtson zhing 'od gzer 2gyi dra ba'i mdzod rab tu 'gyed pa'i sor mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sor mo shin tu mdzes pa dra ba ri legs par 'brel gepa dang ldan zhing sor mo legs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sor mo slong ba rnams la sor mo sa)yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ sems can thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba'i ⑥sems kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad sems can rnams la yongs su bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'dod pa la/ la la57zhig gis chos thos 8par bya bar bsams te༄9)/ des 'di skad du gal te khyod kyi sha dang bcas pa'i sen mo nga la byin na ni/ ngas khyod la chos bstan par bya'o/ /1 zer ba zhig yod na/ de la 'di skad du smras te/ bdag gi sha dang bcas pa'i sen mo ci bder khyer la bdag la chos bstan par mdzod cig ces nas/dzo/ji ltar rgyal po dbang phyug tu gyur pa legs par bshad pa tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' zad mi shes pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan tshad med pa chos kyi chos bzang po nyid la brtson pa/'gro ba kun tu chos kyi lo shin tu legs pa yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir sha dang /bcas pa'i sen 12mo yongs su btang bar gyur pa de ltar slong ba rnams la rang gi sha dang bcas pa'i sen mo yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phyag sen rab tu grub cing zangs kyi kha dog lta bu'i sen mo dang 36—138

ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad dpe byad bzang po'i gyoson mo rab tu thob cing mdog snum pa'i sen mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sen mo'i dam pa dang ldan zhing 'od 'tsher 2ba'i sen mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sen mo bzang po dang ldan zhing thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag sen sna rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi gos shing mtshungs pa med pa'i sen mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'od kyis snang bar bya ba la brtson zhing shin tu brgyan pa'i sen mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad nyams pa myed cing rnam par dag pa'i sen mo gang ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes che zhing yangs pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i mtshan dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i las rnam par smin pas rnam par dag cing mdzes par skyes pa'i sen mo dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'od gzer cakha dog mtha' yas pa rab tu lta'agyed pa'i mdzod dang ldan zhing mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag sen dang ldan par gyur cig ces 6de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'dod pa'i phyir sen mo dang shar bcas pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang phyag sen gyi rgyan yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyi ri kyimathar phyin par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/8 bam po drug pa/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi 36—139

don du chos tshol ba lhur len pa shin tu dkon pa'i chos tshol ba la zhugs pa la/chos gtong ba'i snagang zag la las 2me'i rlubs su lus gzhug dpar byas te/'di skad du gal te khyod mi 'greng 4bdun du brkos pa'i me'i rlubs su mchong 5phod na/ ngas khyod la chos kyi sbyin pa bya'o zhes na tsi de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra de thos nas/ shin tu dga' zhing yid bde ba dang rab tu 'dun pa'i yid skyes nas 'di snyam du sems te/ ngan song thams cad dang 8mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su blang ba 9dang yang bsngo zhing bdag gis 1 dam pa'i chos btsal dgos na/ 'di ltar me'i rlubs 1 su mchong 12ba tsam gyis dam pa'i chos rnyed par 'gyur na lta 1ri/ kye ma de ltar dkon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag kyang 1 sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal lta bu myed par mye'i 15rlubs tsam du mchong 6bas rnyed pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che'o snyam nas/ 'di ltar bdag gis myi 'greng bdun du brkos pa'i me'i rlubs su mchong 18bar bgyis19/ khyod kyis 2 bdag la sangs rgyas kyi chos bshad du gsol zhes nas de ji ltar rgyal po legs par bshad pa tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa' 51dang ske/ de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 2chen po gzhan grangs med pa dag gis 2 kyang me'i rlubs su mchong bar 2 byas pa de ltar chos kyi don du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad dang bsngo riba'i lus kyis me'i rlubs su mchong ba'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la 'di ltar yongs su bsngo rna ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las 2 shin tu phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can du gyur te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can 36wa 140

thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bde ba thams cad myong bar gyur te/ g.yang 1sa thams cad las phyir ldog 2par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jigs shing skrag pa thams cad dang bral zhing bag tsha ba med pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba dang yid bde ba dang / chos thams cad kyi rgyan rab tu thob cing chos tshol ba la brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad me gsum rab tu zhi bas gnas pa'i sems dang ldan zhing ngan song gi lam thams cad dang shin tu bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas cakyi bde ba'i rnam pa rab tu thob ste/ yid bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad me gsum dang bral zhing byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug zhi bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba'i dga' bas yang dag par spyod cing byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mnyam pa med pa la rab tu gzhol 5zhing shin tu thos pa'i chos can du gyur cig /sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rjes su shin tu 6song ba'i chos dang ldan zhing byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pas 8rnam par rol pa'i bde ba rab tu thob par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos tshol zhing me'i rlubs su mchong bas 9yang dag par bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis sgrib pa'i las dang spyod pa'i mthar phyin cing ye shes kyi me shin tu rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam pa'i chos kyi phyir sdug bsngal gyi tshor 36—141

ba thams cad bdag gi lus kyis 1bzod par byed cing dam pa'i chos brjod pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i 2lam ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la rigasal bar byed pa dang / bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi phung po 4tshogs yang dag par stsogs ga pa dang / stobs bcu la brtson par byed cing thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa yangs par byed pa dang / chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi phung po la bdag mngon du mthun par yang dag par lta zhing sems can thams cad kyi rnam par dag pa dang / rnam par byang ba yang dag par sgrub pa 6dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thams cad la rab tu 'jug pa dang / ye shes chen po la brtson zhing sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yongs su bsrung 7ba'i tshe ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' /chos bzang po tshol ba dang / rgyal po shugs chen po 'dzin pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan tshad med pa 9dag gis kyang ji ltar spyad pa bzhin du de sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa gcig 1 ma yin pa nyams su 'bab pa dang / sdug bsngal 1tshor ba'i gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs myong ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa thams cad dang phrad pa dang 12/ rang gi lus kyis nye bar len cing bzod par byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba'i gang zag sems dgatum pa can sdig pa'i las kyis bsgribs 1 pa/ bdud kyi las kyi 5byin gyis brlabs 6pa dag las sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa de dag thams cad nye bar len cing bzod par byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar dam pa'i chos shes par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad bde ba'i nan tan gyis mngon par shes pa myur ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang mi bde ba yongs su spangs par gyur cig /sems can 36—142

thams cad bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad rab tu thob 1pa la gnas pasatshan/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshor ba thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad mig yor lta bu'i bde ba rab tu thob cing sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad 'gag 5 par gyur cig /sems can thams cad ye shes kyi spyod pa'i mthar phyin te sdug bsngal gyi btson 'dir nas phyir log par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi lam 6rgyud dang / gtse 7ba thams cad las phyir log cing bde ba'i lam mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad shin tu rnam par chad 8pas chos kyi dga' ba dang bde ba'i rnam pas shin tu brtan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phan tshun du zhe mi sdang zhing byams pa rab tu thob pas sdug bsngal las grol 1 bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'khor ba thams cad na yod pa'i sdug bsngal rab tu byang zhing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bde ba'i don mthong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba thams cad kyis lus la gnod par 'gyur ba med cing 'dra ba med pa'i bde ba rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bde ba bsgribs pa med pa'i mthar phyin te/ bde ba'i khyad par thams cad rab tu thob par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi phyir sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa thams cad bzod par byed cing nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'gro ba thams cad g.yang sa las bsrung zhing thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam par thar pa bsgribs 1 pa med pa la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dam pa'i chos btsal 1 ba la 36—143

shin tu brtson pa/ chos kyi tshig dang yi ge 'khor lngas yang dag par len pa1ri/'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su btsal ba dang / rjes su dran pa la gnas pa/ chos kyi dga' bas spro zhing mos pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ zang zing med pa'i chos rab tu btsal 5ba la brtson pa/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyal po'i srid dang / skyid pa'i ljan ljin thams cad las rnam par 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyal srid dang chos kyi skyid pa la mngon par mos pa/ 'jig rten gyi dga' ba thams cad kyis ma gos pa'i yid la byed pa dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dga' bas sems shin tu spel ri ba/'jig rten gyi skyid pa zang zing dang bral ba'i yid dang ldan pa/ spros capa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas pa/ rab tu 'thob 5par mngon par zhugs pa des rgya mtsho'i mthar thug tshopa'i sa chen po grong rdal bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang /yul dang yul gru bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang skye bo du mas yongs su gang ba/bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang / skye bos rgyas pa'i khyim gyis gang ba/bza' shing gi ra ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rtse zhing dga' bar bya ba'i 7gzhi dang ldan pa/ chu klung yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs dang / grib shing dang /bza' shing mdangs dga' bas shin tu brgyan pa/ 'khrug long med cing shin tu bde 8ba/ 9gzhan gyi khams shin tu bcom pa/ bdag gi khams la nyams pa med pa/ gser dang rin po che'i mdzod dang bang ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis brgyan pa/ bu dang bu mo dang chung ma dang 'khor sna tshogs dang / chung ma'i 'khor sna tshogs yod pa/ grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang / pho brang chen po yod pa de lta bu chos kyi don 1 dang /36—144

chos btsal ba'i phyir tshig dang / yi ge'i 'bru gcig 1gi don du yang rgyal po'i srid snying po med pa las snying po bskyed cing chos la dkon pa'i 'du shes rab tu bskyed nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa 2bsgribs na pa med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rnam par dag pa tshol zhing ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen dpal dang / rgyal po khyad par dpal dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dag gis kyang ji ltar spyad 5par gyur pa de bzhin du yongs su gtang 6bar bya ba'i tshe/ sa chen po rgya 7mtsho'i mthar thug pa yongs su btang ste chos btsal bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad lag shin tu che bar gtong ba la mngon par mos shing shin tu yangs pa'i gtong 8ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gyod pa med par sbyin pa'i bdag por gyur te / gtong 9ba thams cad yongs su gtong 1 bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus dang srog dang yo byad la mi lta bas chos chol ba la shin tu brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'gro ba thams cad kyi the tsom gcad 11pas tshim par bya ba la brtson cing 2chos thob par 1 bya bas shin tu dga' bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos la yid dga' ba rab tu thob cing chos la 1 mngon par dga' bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol ba'i sems chen pos 7spyod pa dang / byang chub tshad med pa rnyed pas lus dang srog dang 'jig rten gyi skyid pa yongs su gtong bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad lus dang srog la mi lta zhing chos kyi gludaga' 36—145

ba'i mthar thug pas 1chos kyi rim gro dang sri zhu rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos shin tu dkon pas②mnyan⑧pa la brtson zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i mthar phyin cing sangs rgyas kyi byang chub snang ba rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad rab tu shes pa'i yid kyis the tsom gegyi zug rngu dang bral zhing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa mang bar gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du chos btsal sgrub dang / chos thams cad kyi don dang bde ba'i lam gyi ye shes mthong ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir yongs su 6bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 3)chen po chos kyi dbang phyug byed cing srog gcod pa spang ba 8la sems can rnams rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi grong dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs ri9 dang ske/ pho brang 'khor dang / rgyal po'i gnas thams cad kyi shen 3 tshopa dang /gsad 11pa'i gnas thams cad rnam par gcod pa dang / rkang gnyis pa dang /rkang bzhi pa dang / ri dgas 12mang po la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa byed pa dang /stod 1 pa med pa'i sems kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa dang /khon 1 med pa'i sems kyis rgyal po'i srid thams cad la gnas pa dang / sems can gyi sami bde ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad la bde bar byed pa'i sems rin po che bskyed 17pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad ni rin po che dang 'dra ba'i bsam pa rin po che rab tu sgrub pa nyurtedang /36wa 146

sdom pa gsum rnam par dag pa la bdag gnas shing gzhan rab tu 'jog pa'i tshe/srog gcod pa spangs pa dang / bslab pa lnga la sems can rab tu bzhag 1pas yang dag par bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 2)'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sems so sor thob cing srog gi dbang po gcad cadu med pa dang / tshe ring zhing shes rab rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad la 5rim gro byed pa'i tshe 6dang ldan zhing tshe 7nodapag tu med par gyur cig /sems can thams cad gzhan gyi gnod pas nasrog 'gag par mi 'gyur zhing rga shi med pa'i chos la rab tu brtson par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tshe ji srid du 9'dod cing bsams 1 par gnas pa la mkhas shing nad med pa'i lus dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal 1 pa bye ba brgyar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la zhugs te/ tshe 'gag pa med par gyur cig /sems can thams cad stobs bcu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bstsags 12pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur cing tshe'i dngo 1 'dzin par gyur cig /sems can thams cad tshe'i 14tshad 'gag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs 15pas dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sems can thams cad che1re tshad zad mi shes pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brtson zhing sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mnyes par bya ba'i dus dang mnyam par gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i chos la dga' ba 1narab tu thob cing srog gi dbang po 'gag pa med pa dang / 'phags pa'i skye 36wa 147

mched la bslab par bya ba 1shin tu bslabs 2par gyur cig /sems can thams cad mthu stobs dang / brtson 'grus zad mi shes pa rab tu thob ste/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis dbang bsgyur 4ba la rab tu 'jog pa dang / rga ba dang na ba med pa'i tshe phun sum tshogs par gyur cig ces/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ye shes shin tu rdzogs par 'gyur ciraba'i phyir srog gcod pa spangs pa dang / sdom pa gsum rnam par dag pa la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byol song gi skye gnas su gyur pa rkang bzhi pa dang / mir 'gyur ba 6rnams kyi pho mtshan gcad 7par gyur cing skyes pa'i rang bzhin dang bral bar gyur pa/ skyes bu'i dngos po gzhig par gyur pa/ nyug narum gyi dngos po la bzhag 9par gyur pa/ lus la gnod pa shin tu mi zad 1 ripar gyur pa mthong ba dang / skyes pa'i dngos po las bzlog nyu2par gyur pa/ pho smos 12gnyis ka ma yin pa'i skye gnas su gzhag par gyur pa/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas mnar bar gyur pa/ lus mi bde bas shin tu gzir bar gyur pa/ skyes par 5tshul gyis dpag pa tsam du gyur pa rten 17pa'i lus 'gag par gyur pa dang /sems can rnams kyi gnod pa'i rnam pa de lta bu dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mthong na/ byams pa chen pos sems can rnams yongs su skyob cing snying rje chen po sngon du btang ste/ 'gro ba thams cad la phan 'dogs pas 'dzam bu'i gling gi skyes pa las nyams par 'gyur ba thams cad rnam par bzlog 7go/ /rab tu rgyun gcad 1 do/ /yongs su skyob bo/ /rnam 36wa 148

par 'chadam1)par byed do/ /chos dang mthun pa'i mdzod dang / bde 2ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag kyang gtong zhing tshig 'di skad du brjod de / khyed kyis gang gi phyir sdig pa'i las rnam pa 'di lta bu'i labya bar gyur pa de'i bde ba dang /phan pa'i rnam pa thams cad ngas sbyar gyis5/ sdig pa'i las kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag tshul bzhin ma yin pa la 'jug par sems bskyed 6pas bde ba myong ba'i don du khyed ma byed cig /de ltar pha rol la sdig pa'i las 'di lta bu dag byas shing bdag gis bde ba'i 7tshor ba myong bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas ma yin te/de'i gnas med do/ /'di ltar sdig pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu la spyod pa 'di ni 8sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 9 smad pa'o zhes nas/ de ma yin pa'i mi dge ba'i chos gzhan dag byed pa mthong na yang rnam par zlog 1 par byed cing / sems can thams cad sbyin pa thams cad yongs su btang 1 bas yang dag par sdud do/ /yo byad thams cad kyis kyang mngon par sdud 1 par byed do/ /'di lta ste dben pa'i chos la yid ches par byed pa dang / dge ba'i las shin tu bstsags 15pa dang ske/ mi dge ba'i las phan tshun du byams pa'i sems kyis spyad pa dang /phan tshun du mi gnod cing mi 'tshe ba'i phyir legs par bshad pas kyang shin tu ngoms 15par byed do/ /sems can de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i tshig thos nas sdig pa'i las de las ldang ngo / /rnam par ldog go/ /mi spyod gludo/ /des de ltar bsgrubs 1 pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ste/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gsang ba sbubs na 1 'dug pa dang ldan zhing skyes bu chen po'i 19mtshan rab tu thob par gyur cig /sems can thams cad brtson 'grus dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa rnam par dag 36wa 149
