pa'i rna ba'i ye shes khong du chud pa yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus7)med pa thams cad lus kyi skyil mo krung〈migacig gis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis rlob kyang sems can thams cad la gnod pa med par byed par55)'gyur ro/ /dus gsum mtha' dang dbus50med pa thams cad la 'jug pa'i ye shes 'byam55)klas pa'i yongs su rdzogs par thoba'i cing khong dus chud par 'gyur ro/ /blo mtha' dang dbusalo)med pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / sems can thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / chos thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / skye mched yongs su shes pa'i ye shes thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' dang dbus0 )med pa hunyathams cad la 'jug cing rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa dang /sems can gyi ris dang skye gnas rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur pa thams cad nas byung ba'i sgra dang sna smra ba dang / skad 12thams cad ma lus pa la mngon sum 〉gyi ye shes rnam par dag pa dang / 'jig rten gyis khams thams cad ma lus par rnam par 15mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer 1 dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu gtong zhing mtha' dang dbus med 38pa snang bar byed pa rnam par dag pa dang /dus gsum thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ma lus par mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa dang / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar /rtabyung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dang dbus tri tshomed pa ma lus pa thams cad la skad cig gcig tu 'jug pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad ma lus pa shrī 1 la 'jug pas 'gro ba mtha' dang dbus 22med pa rnam par dag par bya ba rab tu 36wa 346

thob par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'ohu)/ /rab tu sgruba'achipo/ /rnam par dag par byed do/ /mnyam par byed do/ /mngon sum du byed do/ /rab tu rtogs par byed do/ /khong du chud par byed do/ /yang dag par sems par byed do/ /rnam par dag pa〈bathams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob paralo4)bya ba rjes su thob par byed do/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis byin gyi rlabs gekyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sum6)sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos te g.yos so//rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go rab tu ldeg gope/ /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig(8) /kun tu shig shig go/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang chos nyid rab tu thob pas lha rdzas kyi me tog gi khasprin gyi char yang nya mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi phye ma'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi gos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi lhab lhub kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi spos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi dus dang mthun pa'i tsanas3medan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi sbrul gyi snying po'i tsan dan mchog gi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang 3 rgyal mtshanatshwa dang / ba dan kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par mibab po/ /lha rdzas kyi lha'i lus grangs med 36—347

pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag brgya stongatubarjod du myed pa'i tshig dang brjod pa la rtog⑧pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yid du 'ong bar spyod pa'i chos rin po che'ikhusprin gyi char mngon par bab po//lha rdzas kyi de bzhin gshegs pas bstodasnyipa'i sangs rgyas kyi bsngagasalgepa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi legs so/ /zhes bya ba dang / lhung lhung ldegs57)kyi sgra 'byin pa dang / dga' bar byed pa'i dbyangs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /lha rdzas kyi lha'i7lus bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med cing brjod du med pas rab tu btud do/ /lha yul gyi lha nyu)grangs med pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la brtson par yid la byed cing /de bzhin gshegs pa la shin tu dad pa'i sems kyi rgyud dang ldan payi/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang mi 'bral ba'i sems kyis mngon par gnas so/ /lha rdzas kyi rol mo brdung ba dang dkrol57ba'i sgratshi/ lha'i glu'i dbyangs kyi tshul grangs medam3nyepar grags stepa de bzhin gshegs pasamachod cing yid la bya ba la brtson pa rnams kyang rab tu bsgrags sothu/ /lha rdzas las shin tu 'das pa'i 'od zer〈 nyebargya stong grangs med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tha5)gru thams cadam )rab tu snang bas khyab par byas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i sprul pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi yul grangs med pa bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i techo 'phrul rnams kyang yang dag par〈 )bstan par gyur to/ /gling bzhi pa 'di'i〈nyedaga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i dbang po rab dga' ldan gyi khang pa na ji lta ba de stebazhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang phyogs bcur rgyas par bkang 36—348

zhing chos bstan pa 'di nyid kun tu byung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed (1)kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi pha rol dag nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' lhags nas phyogs bcu bkang ste/ 'di skad zer rol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod kyis yongs su bsngo ba'i chos nyid 'di bshad pa legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cags kun kyang ming rdo rje'isargyal mtshan zhes bya ba sha stag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams55)ming rdo rje'i 'od ces bya ba dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rdo rje'i 5)dpal zhes bya ba bzhugs pa dag gis7)drung nas 'dir phyin te/ kun na yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisam 'khor gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag na tshig 'di dag she)dang / yi ge 'di dag dang / go bar bya ba 7'di dag gis don 'di nyid lhag57pa med cing chad pa med par brjod de chos 'di〈nyenyid ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang de ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams72re re'i gling bzhi pa dag gi dga' ldan gyi gnas kyi lha'i rgyal po'i 6rab dga' ldan gyi khang pa rin po che thams cad kyi brgyan aces bya ba dag tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag tshebacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyin pa mngon du mthong ba sha stag sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs pho 〉kyis 'khor 'dir phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan gyis (/snyephyogs bcur bltas 1)te 'khor thams cad la bltas nas dzo )chos kyi dbyings la rnam par blta ba dang / don dang tshig dang yi ge la rab tu 'jug pa dang /sems bskyed pa mtha' dang dbus ni med par yangs pa yongs su bsgomadza 2pa dang /36—349

'gro ba thams cad la snying rje chen pos 1khyab par bya ba dang / dus gsums lde)gyi sangs rgyas kyi rigs su sems yang dag par 'brel bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs 4pa'i lus yang dag par bskyed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yang dag par shes par bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bskyed pa'ang ji ltar dus la bab pa la yang dag par blta ba dang / chos kyi lus kyi rjes su song ba'i gzugs kyi lus yang dag par bstan par byed cing sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 5de'i tshe tshigs su bcad 6pa 'di dag smras so/ /de dag chos la rab tu mkhas gyur cing / /chos rgyud mtha' yas rnam par dag byas nas//chos kyi 'od byed chos la kha lo sgyur / /chos rnams rab rtogs chags pa med pa thob / /de dag chos kyi kha lo sgyur gyur 8te/ /shin tu dkon pa'i chos rnams ri9ston byed cing / /chos kyi sgo la rab tu bzhag 7bya bar/ /sems can mtha' yas phyogs su go bar byed/ /de dag chos kyi gang 11chen mtsho 'thung zhing / /chos nyid sprin char phyogs su rab tu 'bebs/ /'jig rten khams su chos nyid nyi shar cing / /sems can phan phyir chos rnams ston par 1 byed/ /de dag shin tu dkon pa'i sbyin bdag ste/ /chos kyi rnam 1 tshul shes pa 7rjes su thob/ /chos kyi snang bas rab tu sems gsal geb/ /'jigs med 'jig rten dag na tshachos rab ston1 / /shin tu dri med chos kyi sems dang ldan/ /chos kyi sgo la de dag rab tu gnas/ /chos 18rnams rgya mtshos 19de dag shin tu 'phags/ /'jig rten dag tu chos nyid rnga yang brdung 2 / /de dag shin tu dkon pa'i chos brjod cing / /chos nyid bsod nams yang dag bstsogs 1par byed/ /chos 36wa 350

nyid bsam pa yongs su dag byed cing / /chos kyi gter rnams 'gro ba kun la ston / /chos kyi khang par rgyal bas dbang bskur ba/ /chos nyid ye shes snying po'i lus dang ldan/ /chos kyi mtshan gzhi0)rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ /de dag chos nyid bzang po'i chos la gnas/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gang la bstod mdzad dang ske/ /rab kyi phul gyis gang zhig gnang gyur cing / /skye khudabang thams cad gang gis bskyed gyur pa'i/ /sbyin pa dam pa de dag sbyin patsha )byed/ /de dag chos kyi lus ldan shes dang ldan/ /'jig rten mkhas pas chos nyid sprul mdzad pas la/ /chos kyi sgron ma 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /dma' ba med par mtha' yas chos ston tome/ /de dag chos bzang dam pa sbyin byas nas/ /dge rtsa de dag rjes su sems byed cing / /'jig rten dag tu dge ba gang byas pa/ /de dag yongs bsngo'i shes dang ldan pa yin/ /rang byung 6thams cad gang gis bskyed gyur pa'i/ /dge rtsa de dag 'gro ba'i don du shes/ /thams cad rnam phye rnam par dag gyur cingamatsono/ /sangs rgyas rgyan gyisam shenipha rol phyin par byed/ /zhing gi rgyan 7)mang shin tu rgya che zhing / /phyogs rnams kun tu de la tshad med pas / /'jig rten kun tu mabasam yas rgyan ldan pa/ /de 'drar zhing rnams ma lus kun gyur cing nya1/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i ye shes ji tsam pa/ /de 'drar sems can rnam 3 dag ldan gyur nya te/ /rgyal ba'i sras po bzang po ji bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyis sems rgyan tsheldan gyur cig /de dag rnam 'phrul shin tu rnam yangs pa/ /gang gis 'jig rten ma lus rgyas gang ba/ / de yi 8spyod la 7shes rab bzang 1ri gnas par38/ /sems can thams cad ma lus 'gyur bar 39shog /ji snyed 'jig rten ma lus gang yang rung / /phyogs su rgyal ba kun gyis sangs 36—351

rgyas pa/ / kun kyang7kun tu bzang po ci7bzhin du/ /legs spyod dam pa mchog tu'i ldan gyur cig /yon tan rgyun⑧rnams ji snyed gang yang rung / /rgyal sras gernams dang rgyal bas thugs chud pa'i/ /yon tan gang la phyematha' dang dbus7)med pa'i0)/ /yon tan de 'drar sems can kun gyur cig /gang yang rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan palo9)rnams/ /'jug pa kun la bslab rtsi )pa kun bslabs pa/ /rnam 'phrul thams cad yang dag ston pa71rnams/ /phyogs rnams thams cad rgyas par 'dod gyur cig /sems kyi skad cig gcigarwashegis rang byung 32rnams/ /'dren pa sems can kun dang mnyam mthong ste/ /chos rnams thams cad ma lus bsdu byas shing / /spa 8rtse gcig tu mi mgon sdudasnyigyur cig /'jig rten 'di na 'gro ba gang rgyu ba/ /gang rnams mi yi dam pas mkhyen gyur pa/ /de dang mnyam pa 3nathams cad ma lus pa'i/ /'jig rten mkhyen la mchod pa byed gyur cig /spos kyi rgyud dang de bzhin me tog dang / /gos kyi rgyud dang de bzhin gdugs rnams kyis/ /chos dbyings ma lus rgyas par dgang tu byas shing / /'jig rten kun tu yid kyis 'gengs gyur cig /sangs rgyas mtshan gyi rnam pa bsam nyurteyas pa/ /skra rtse gcig tu thams cad bsdu ba yis//lhag ma med par lam rnams kun bsdus shing / /'jig rten sgron la phyag 'tshal gyur par ru 〉shog /rgyal ba de dag kun la phyag 'tshal te/ /thams cad lus kyi57tshul gyis 'dud byed cing / /phyogs rnams kun tu rgyal ba kun bstod5)pas/ /phyi ma'i bskal ri nyekun zad par byed gyur cig /sems can snyed kyi yid kyi rnam pa yis/ /rgyal ba gcig la'ang mchod pa byed gyur cig /ji ltar rgyal ba gcig mchod de bzhin du/ /skyes dbang ma zhu:lus kun la'ang mchod gyur cig /36—352

de dag mchod pa'i yon tan rjod7byed pas/ /'gro bkukun tu bskal pa zadasagyur kyang / /skyes bu 'dul ba dpe zla med pa yis/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i mthar thug med gyur cig /'gro ba kun na bskal mang ji snyed pa/ /de snyed bskal par spyad pa spyod byed cing / /rgyal ba gcig la rim grochu)bya bas kyang / /bskal pa thams cad ma lus zad gyur cig /rgyal ba gcig la ji tsam brjod gyur pa/ /rgyal ba kun la'ang bskal pa de snyed de/ /bskal pa'i grangs kyis mthar thug ma gyur cig /rgyal ba'i spyod pas skyo ba med gyur cig /ji ltar chos dbyings rnam par dag pasnyidang / /ji tsam rgya chen yongs su mtha' yas pa /de snyed rgya chen me tog bzang po 6)rnams/ /thub tshimang sems can snyed la 'bul gyur cig /dri zhim ldan pa'i de bzhin phye ma dag /gtsang zhing rnam dag rnam pa51sna tshogs la/ /'gro ba kun na dperwa zla dmyigs med pa/ /de 'dras rgyal balgemachod pa byed gyur cig /zhing rnams du ma sems can mnyam pa yi/ /rgyal ba gcig la gdugs rnams 'bul byed cing / /rgyal ba kun la'ang de bzhin dgab 8bya bas/ /rgyal ba rnams la gdugs mchod byed gyur cig /byug pa dam pa mchog tu gyur pa 8rnams/ /'gro ba 'di na gang la dpesamed pa//de yis sangs rgyas mchod byed spyod pa yis/ /bskal mang sems can mnyam pa zad gyur cig /de bzhin byug dang spos〈 7kyi phye ma dang / /me tog bdug pa na bza' spos rnams dang / /rin chen lhab lhub mchod pa mtha' tunyeyas pa'i/ / rim gro skyodzasnyab med par byed gyur cig /'jig rten sgron ma sems can mnyam pa dag / skad cig re rer byang chub 'tshang rgya ba/ /de dag yon tan mtha' yas rjod byed cing / /skyes bu 'dul la mchod pa byed gyur cig /sems can 36—353

mnyam pa'i 'jig rten mkhyen pa la/ /nyu sems can⑧mnyam pa'i bskal parashebagrang byas shing / /blo mchog ldanasapa mchod pa byed pa ni/ /rgyal bas bshad kyang zad par ma gyur cig /rgyal ba rnams la 'di 'dra'i mchod byed cing / /sangs rgyas rnam ge'aphrul kun tu 'gengs byed pas/ /bzang dang ldan pa'i spyod la gnas bcas shing / /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad mthong gyur cig /'gro kun dge ba56)ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur7de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji she)bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /'jig rten thams cad ma lus sems can rnams/ /ji snyed rgyal ba kun gyis shesathugs chud pal/ /kun kyang mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags51pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po 1 de bzhin gyur par〈geshog /phyogs rnams ma lus kun tu ci byas pa/ /skyes bu dam pa de ltar yongs su bsngo/ /rdo rje'ipha rgyal mtshan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa/ / yongs bsngocadam pa mchog dang phul yang yin / /de bzhin zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /rgyu bzhin kun kyang khong du chud byas te / /sems can ji snyed thams cad ma lus pa/ /de dag kun kyang kun tu bzang gyur cig /sbyin pas yongs bsngo nya ji bzhin red gyur cig /tshul khrims kyis kyang bsngo bzhin red gyur cig /brtson 'grus stobs kyis bskal par mi ldog cing / /bzod pas 'khrug 3shepa med pa'i yid gyur cig /bsam gtan gyis kyang rtse gcig yid ldan zhing / /ting 'dzin kun7)gyi spyod yul shes gyur cig /shes rab dus rnams gsum po thams cad du/ /'jig rten dag tu mthar dmyigs med gyur cig /lus dang ngag dang〈 riyid rnams thams cad kyang / /rnam pa kun tu rnam dag mkhas gyur cig /spyod pa de dag 36—354

thams cad ma lus par/ /kun kyang kun tu bzang por red gyur0)cig /ji ltar chos dbyings rlom pa'i sems med cing / /de la spros dang chags pa med pa dang ske/ /mya ngan 'das midang bsgribasa'i pa med pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems la rlom sems med gyur cig /chos mkhas 547yongs su bsngo ba gang brjod pa/ /de ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bsngo ba ste/ /mkhas pa'i spyod pa ci 3)nas 'grub 'gyur bar/ /dge ba yangs56)pa de yis yongs su bsngo/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslabs byas te(77/ /ji snyed gang yod thams cad ma lus par/ /khams58)rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdu byas te/ /ci nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug par bsngo/ /yangs pa ji snyed rgyal bas gsungs pa dang / /kun tu bzang zhes gang la gdags pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras 1)rnams gang la 3 )gnas gyur pa'i / /spyod pa dam pa de dag su 'dod pas/ /sems can ma lus thams cad bgrang bar nus/ /dus gsum sems kyang ma lus kun bgrang nus/ /gang la kun tu bzang por nyunyaming gdags pa/ /rgyal sras de yi 12yon tan mtha' med do3ge / /nam mkha'atsha8spu rtses bgrang bar nus kyang srid/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul yangasabagrang bar nusam/ /gang la rgyal sras drang srong che gnas pa'i/ /spyod pa de dag bgrang bar mi nus so/ /chos kyi dbyings tshad med pa zhes bya ba ste / yongs su bsngo ba bcu pa'o/ / rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan gyi lha yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u ste/ sum cu pa'o/she// // shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba las sa bcu pa'i le'u ste/37 bam po bcu gsum shu )pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i 36wa 355

rgyal po dbang sgyur7gyi gnas kyi nor bu rin po che dam pa'i khang pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po ②thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan nas 'dus pa sha stag kun kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi yul dang spyod yul thams cad rab tu thob pas gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi yul la 'jug cing gzhol ba'i spyod yul ma btang7ba/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba ④dang / gdul dubar bya ba'i dus dubazhin du thogs pa med pa'i byin gyi rlabs ⑦rnam pa tha dad pas ⑧bya ba thams cad yang dag par ston pa la mkhas pa⑨/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrub ⑩cing bskal pa dang zhing dang dus su spyod pa la gnas pa'i hunyergyun mi gcod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang ye shes dang rdzu 'phrul gyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs shing 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba mi zad pa la rab tu zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab dang /thabs nya thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo yang dag par tsobastan cing shin tu bsgrub pa'i rgyun mi gcod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tsobasam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa dang ye shes la rnam par rol pa'i mngon par shes pas bya ba thams cad yang dag par ston pa la mkhasalgepa / byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul dang stobs dang / dbang thams cad thob cing mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i sems skad cig yigis de bzhin 36—356

gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'dod pa la sngunanyedu 'dren pa'i gtam lagyi skyes bu dam pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ④'khor lo yang dag par gzung ba dang / sangs rgyas la mchod pa dang / rim gro ④rgya chen po bya ba'i don du mngon par brtson pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i las thams cad yang dag par ⑤blang ba mnyam pa nyid kyi rtso)sbyor bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lus kyi gzugs brnyan rab tu ⑦'byung ba chos kyi dbyings thams cad du chags pa med pa'i dbyangs rab tu sgrog pas dus gsum thams cad du gechags pa med pa'i sems dang / ye shes kyi yul rgyas par 'gengs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang nan tan yongs su rdzogs pa thams cad bskal pa brjod du med par rgyun mi chad parashoḍa)yang dag par bstan pa la yon tan bsngags shing brjod pa zad mi shes pa7)sha stag ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad mo'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad mo dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gtsang ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba dri ma myed pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyan yirnam par bkod pa tsothams cad rab tu snang bar ston pa'i snying po dang / byang chub 36—357

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes rnam par snang ba'i snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal yid du 'ong ba'i snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tsan dan dpal gyi snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me tog dpal gyi snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po me tog rgyas po ༅)dpal gyi snying po dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal lha'i 5snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsod nams dpal gyi snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsgribs du ripa myed pa'i ye shes rnam par dag pa'i cadapal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dri ma dang bral ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spobs pa 5sna tshogs rgyan 6gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer 7gyi dra ba chen po rab tu snang ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od dri ma med pa'i dpal gyi gzi 8ribarjid bzang po'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gser bzang zhing 9dri ma med pa'i dbyig gis spras pa'i gzi 1 brjid mdzes 11pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan pas rnam par dag pa'i nyusnyedapal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal gyi be'u rdo rje 'od 'phro bas brgyan pa'i snying po dang /36—358

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma'i rgyal po 'od0)rab tu snang ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i mdzod du ye shes bsgribs pa med pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dbyangs 4)kyi dkyil 'khor bsgribs 5 pa med cing nga ro snyan pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzungs kyi snying po 56)yon tan gyi 7)'gro ba thams cad kyi smon lam rinayang dag par 'dzin pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgya mtsho'i ri9)rgyan gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri rab / )dpal gyi snying po dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan thams cad rnam par dag pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 31 rnam par grol ba'i zla ba dang / de dag la stsogs 12pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa gzhal du med pa/grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtshungs pa myed pa dpag tu med pa/kun tu mtha' yas pa/lha/ mu med pa sa mtshams samyed pa/ brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po la stsogs pa'i nyugasangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs nas 17'dus pa sha stag dang /thabs gcigs/ snatu bzhugs 1/so/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po sangs rgyas kyi mthus theg pa chen po rab tu snang ba 36wa 359

zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs7so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying lapos byang chub sems dpa'i bting nge 'dzin theg pa chen po rab tu snang ba de la mnyam par bzhagasasem thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyilo)phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang mtshan rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar mthun pa sha stag gis zhal mngon par bstan te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal meto/ / rgyal ba'i (kyebu de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin theg pa chen po rab tu snang ba la snyomasaspyonapar zhugs tshepa legs so legs so/ /'di ltar rigs kyi bu khyod la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul〈nyeshin tul phra ba snyed kun kyang〈nyematshan rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar mthun pa sha stag gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'di'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs bedang / khyod nyid kyi ye shes kyi tunyekhyad par gyis byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu brjod cing yiye shes kyi sa la 'jug par bya ba dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsdu ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu dbye ba la mkhas par bya ba dang / chos thams cad la ye shes shin tu yangs par bya ba dang / shin tu legs par gnas pa'i chos rab tu bstan pa dang / ye shes tha myi dad pa rnam par sbyang ba 3nyedang 'jig rten gyi chos 36—360

thams cad kyis gos pa myed par bya ba ①dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su dag par bya ba dang / ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul khong du chud par bya ba nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul gyi bar du khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'ishes bcu brtsamashepa rab tu 'thob 0par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa ma nor bar mngon par rnam par dgod pa shin tu bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la yang dag par dmyigs par bya ba dang / zag pa med pa'i chos kyi bye brag rnam par bsgom pa dang / rnam par dbye ba shin tu rnam par phye ba'i shes rab kyi snang ba chen po la mkhas pa'i ye shes kyi rgyan thob par bya ba dang / shin tu brtags pa'i ye shes kyi sgo la 'jug par bya ba dang / gnas kyi rnam pa ci rigs su brjod pa dang / spobs pa'i snang ba dma' ba myed pakhuthob par bya ba dang / tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa chen po'ishes shin tu rtogs par bya ba dang / byang chub kyi sems la dran pa nyams pa med par bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su phyin par bya ba dang / thams cad du song ba'i blo rnam par gdon mi za ba la mkhas palorab tu thobalgepar bya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlab pasnyimadzad do/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu khyod kyis chos kyi sgosarab tu dbye ba la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes snang ba'i byin gyi rlabs7kyis rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su dag par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings shin tu sbyangs pa dang ske/ sems can gyi khams thams cad la phan gdags pa dang / chos kyi sku'i ye shes kyi lus la 'jug7par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 36—361

dbang bskur ha)ba yang dag par blang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du shin tu 'phags pa'i lus 'byung bar bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar mibya ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi tshul yongs su dag par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'is phyir spobs pa skyed bcig /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la rigezil gyis mi non par sne lus nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /thogs pa myed pa'i spobs pas shin tu ston pa nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i ye shes rnam par phye ba la 'jug pa nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /dran pa nyams pa skyed pa'i byin gyi rlabs 7)nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ / blo gros 8)shin tu nges par rtogasashepas mkhas pa nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i blo'i rjes su 'gro ba nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi stobs thub pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi 'jigs pa che zhing zhum pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub pa nyu1 mdzad do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang tha 12dad pa yang dag par nyi mkhyen pas rnam par dbye ba'i chos kyi tshul shin tu rtog par bya ba 6nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang thugs kyi rgyan shin tu rnam par phye ba 1lhamangon par bsdu tshab nye bar bsgrub pa tu mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyi chos nyid rab tu thob pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyis mngon par bsgrubs 12pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu rnam par sbyangs pa dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu sbyangs pa dang / tshogs shin 36wa 362

tu bstsags7pa dang / yongs su sbyang babashin tu byas pa dang / dran pa'i snod tshad med pa dang / mos pa rnam par dag cing 'od shin tu gsal ba dang /gzungs kyi sgo tha mi dad pasathob pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgyas ④shin tu btabasrepa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de dag na bzhugs bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi ⑥mthus so so nas /phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste'un/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i7snying po'i mgo la byug pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la reg ma thag tu de nyid kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas/byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa(/— bye/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag31 /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam 'di ni nya shin tu rnam par gdon mi za ba 3geste/ tha mi dad pa bltar 7med pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par yangs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug btso/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad du 8rgyas par khyab pa/'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis hu tshobarlabs pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de 13ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' hu)chen po rnams 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes kyi sa la yang rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /ma byonas1pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes kyi sa la yang rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes kyi sernyes la yang rab tu 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes kyi sa rnams te/ gang la bsams ni 36—363

te bdag gis de skad du smras pa de dag ni/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo ske/ /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po dngatu/ dri ma dang bral ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / 'od byed pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa gsum pa dang / 'od 'phro ba can zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa bzhi pa dang / rgyal bar dka' ②ba zhes bya ba ④byang chub sems dpa'i sa lnga pa dang / mngon sum pasnyizhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa drug pa dang / ⑤ring du song ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa dang /mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa dang / legs pa'i blo gros zhes9)bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa dgu pa dang / chos kyi sprin ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems9)dpa'i sa bcu pasnyiste/ de ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bdag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po 'di57dag mi gsung ba de lta bu ma7) mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i lam yongs su sbyong ba'i〈nyechos snang ba'i sgo 'di ni yang dag phul zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di ltaratshwanyebyang chub sems dpa'i sa rnam 36—364

par dgod pa shin tu bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gnas 'di ni bsam gyisatumi khyab pa ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisasheshes pa'o/ /de nas de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu posnye'adi dag ming tsam zhig brjod de cang mi zer bar 'dug nas/ de las rab tu phye ste masnyibashad pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khorasnyide dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po de dag gi ⑥ming tsam zhig thos lasasherab tu phye ste/ mi⑧brjod pas skom par gyur nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po ⑨de dag gi5) ming tsam zhig brjod de cang〈nyami zer bar 'dug nas(ge / de las rab tu phye zhing mi stonatshwanyepa de la rgyu ni gang rkyen ni ci zhig yod snyam pa dang / de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i 'khorasnyi'adus pa de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par grol ba'i zla ba snyizhes bya ba 'dus shing 'dug 'dugasnyiste/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor〈 tshode dag gi sems kyitshwa yongs su rtog pa sems kyis yongs su shes nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la glu'i〈pedabyangs kyis53 tshigs su bcad de don de dris so me/ /ci phyir rtog pa rnam dag cingadza rnye/ /dran dang ye shes ldan pa yis/ / sa yi5nyemachog ni brjod byas te/ /mkhas pas rnam par phye mi bshad/ / bo 'di kun nges par stertogs pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen yin/ /ci phyir khyod kyi nyes brjod de/ /rab tu phye nyab bshad mi bgyi/ /rgyal sras 'jigs med 'di dag ni/ /kun kyang shin tu nyan par 'dod/ /mkhu 7 sa yis rtedon tshul yang dag tu/ /rnam par phye ste〈ye36wa 365

bshad par nyamadzod/ /'khor 'di shin tu rnam dngasngo ste/ /le lo med cing dge dang ldan/ /dag pa'i mchog la gnas pa ste/ /yon tan ye shes ldan pa yikho/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig lta zhing / /kun kyang rim gro 4)bcas par gnas/ /sbrang rtsi ji ltar spang myin pa/ /de ltar bdud rtsi mchog kyang 'dod/ /rdo rje'i blisnying po 'jigs med 6pa/ /shes rab chen pos de thos nas/ /'khor rnams dga' bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sras la smras/ /sangs rgyas skur ba yang dag 'byung bas na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rab bstan cing ske/ /sa rgyu dam pa rnam par dbye bya ba/ /de ni rmad 'byunganganyamachog tu dga' ba yin/ /phra zhing blta dka' lde rnam par rtog pa spangs/ /sems kyi sa dang bral bas bsgrub par dka'9ri/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi zag med spyod yul te/ /'gro ba rnams kyis de thos mos par 'gyur/ /rdo rje lta bur bsam pa rab gzhagamatshaste / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog la mos byas shing / /bdag med pa yi 31sems kyi sa shes na/ /ye shes dam pa 'di bzod mnyan 1 par nus/ /ji ltar bar snang tshon ris bris pa 1lhadang / /nam mkha'i dbyings la rlung gnas ji bzhin du//de ltar ye shes zag pa med pa yang / /shin tu blta dka' bothub pas rnam par phye / /de la bdag gis 15sems ni 'di snyam byed/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dam pa bsam yas la/ /'gro ba tshagang rnams dad par nyartebyed dkon zhes/ / de yi 3shephyir na ma smras ma bshad do/ /de skad nya smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la 'di skad 3 smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'khor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'di dag la 21bsam pa shin tu sbyangs pa/ kun tu rtog pa sa yongs 36wa 366

su sbyangs pa spyad par bya ba shin tu spyod pas)/ tshogs shin tu bstsags ②pa/sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gebargya stong shin tu bsnyen bkur ba/ yon tan dang ye shes tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ the tsom rngo)dang nem nur med pa(de/ nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ mos pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa la rab tu gnas pa/gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog ⑥pa sha stag tshogs (7)pas yongs su dag pa yin gyis2)/kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis legs par bshad pa nyu)mdzod cig dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad ni rnam pa 'di lta bu'i gnas zab mo la mngon sum du gnas pa sha stag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas don 'di nyid gsal / )bar bzlas nyunyapa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la nyugetshigs su bcad de smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bla med pa/ /sa rnams rab phye rnam dgodas3)brtags pa yi/ /ye shes sbyongakhezhing byang chub thob thegebyed pa/ /mchog dang dam pa zhi ba'i chos rnams shod( sna/ /'khor 'di dag 38pa nyon mongs med pa'i mchog /mos dang bsam pa shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la spyad pa spyod07ske/ /sa 'di brtags la yid chesa' )ldan pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'khor 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu'i gnas zab mo la bsam pa shin tu5 1sbyangs pa/ kun tu rtog gi pa yongs su sbyangs pa/ spyod pa tsho geshin tu spyad shustepa / tshogs shin tu bstsags nisnyepa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu bstsags supa/ yon tan dang ye shes tshad med pa dang ldan pa/36wa 367

the tsomanyedang nemakhunur med pa/ nyon mongs pa dang bral ba/ mos pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa la rab tu gnas pa/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa sha stag tshogasa'ad )pas shin tu dag pa yang yin na/ 'on kyang sems can mos pa chung ngu'agegazhan dag gis zab mo'i rnam pa 'di lta bu bsam ⑤gyis mi khyab pa'i yiganas dag thos par57)gyur la thos nas kyang the tsoms3)dang yid gnyis su gyur na/ de dag la yun ring por gnod spupa dang / don med pa dang / mi bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas 'di lta (3 zhig tu snying brtse (nyaba'i phyir bdag 7ni cang mi zer bar 'dug pa nyid du mos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos don 'di nyid gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir tshigs su bcadarwa pa 'di dag smras so/ /'khor 'di rnam dag shes rab yangs pa ste/ /zab cing gsal ba'i spyod ldan rtog shes shing / /gzhan dring ཿtso'ajog ri rgyal bzhinapha mi g.yo/ /bsam rtog mi 'khrug rgya mtsho chen po 'dra/ /'on kyang mtshwa 7rtogs mi shes ma sbyang btunye/ /rnam shes yul nas nyu'edon la shes med pas/ thos shing ma ches phralam 2du ngan song ltungs me/ /de dag snying brtses ye shes sa ma bshad/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas yang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la gsol ba btab ge pa/ kye du nyergyal ba'i sras legs par bshad pa mdzod cig dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis rnam pa 'di lta bu bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i gnas 'di dag kyang gzhan (snyedu mi 'gyur ba dang / legs par yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ni ce'adi ltar samanyeshin tu bstan pa 'di bshad pa'i tshe chos nyid rab tu thob pas(snye/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang dgongs par 'gyur(na/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 36wa 368

kyang ye shes kyi sa 'di yongs su bsrung ba'i don du rab tu brtson par byed do/ /de yang7ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni spyod pa'i sasridang po ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par 'grub pa'i gzhi yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ yi ge dang 'bru 'grangs pa57ji snyed du bstan7pa de dag thams cad kyi0sngon du 'gro ba'ang yi ge'i phyi mo'o/ /tha mar yang yi ge'i phyi mo la thug ⑦sto/ yi ge'i phyi mo bstan pas ma khyab pa de lta bu'i yi ge dang 'bru 'grangs pa ⑧bstan pa ni gang yang med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang spyod pas rab tu 'grub pas sa0)sngon du 'gro ba'o⑩ / /rang byungarwaskregi ye shes kyi mthar5)thug par 'gyur bas/ sa'i mthar thug pa'o de bas na8/ kye rgyal ba'i sras shod cig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang yongs su bsrung ba'i phyirasabyin gyis rlobalgepa mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas don 'di nyid gsal bar bzlas yipa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la〈 1tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa dang spyod 'jug byang chub 'gyur ba yonyeyi shes sgrub //byed pa/ /spyod pa rnam dag thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras kyis legs par ( )shod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba bde gshegs kun mgon 'dren pa ji snyed pa/ /khyu mchog de kun ye shes 'byung gnas ston la dgongs pa mdzad/ /'di ni dang po zhugs pa'i shes spyod 'di (1mthar thug ste/ /rgyal ba'i chos rab gzhal yas ji snyed de dag 'byung gnas 'di / /yi ge 'grangs pa phyi mo'i rjes ()'gro sngon du de 'gro ( steltar/ /de bzhin 84sa mchog blo yi (nyeyul du tha ma thug par 'dod / /de nas byang chub sems 36—369

dpa' de dag thams cad kyi nyu1dbyangs kyi nga ro gcig tu glu'i dbyangs kyis tshigs su bcad de/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying po la don 'di nyid kyi phyir/gsol ba btab tsho pa/ blo yangs7dam pa'i phul mnga' ba/ /spobs pa mtha' yas rnam par dbye ba rtogs mkhyen pas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gsung dbyangs kyis / /kun ri4)la phan don dam pa bshad paskoranamadzod/ /dran dang dga' bas spyod dag pa/ /stobs bcu'i stobs kyis 6shugs stsogasasheyon tan ldan pa yi/ /sa yi 8)dam pa mchog gilonarnams/ /tha dad yang dag don mkhyen spyod pas shod/ /zhi sdom bsgrub 3 ripa'i yid ldan pa11/ /nga rgyal dregs dang lta ba'i nyon mongs zhir gyur pas/ /'khor 'dir the tsom nyugebral ba ste/ /khyod kyis legs par bshad do re zhig thegesdod/ /skom pa bsil ba'i chu 'dod bzhin/ /bkresalgepa kha zas nad pa sman rab 'dod pa dang / /bung ba sbrang martsi 'dod pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'khor 'di khyod kyi tshig la sdod/ /de bas shin tu 7blo yangs pas/ /rdul med rnams la sa yi hu tshodam pa 3ge'ajug pa nyurteshod/ /chags med stobs bcu'i tshogs gyur pa/ /bde gshegs spyod pa ma lus bshad par 2 rimadzod/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das shākya 21thub pa'i mdzod spu sa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer du ri 'khor gyi 'od zer nihebargya stong grangs med pa dang ldan pa byung 2gengo / /de byung nas phyogs bcu thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 9klas pa thams cad ma lus par snang bar byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad rtse zhu zil bar byas te snye/bdud kyi khyim thams cad zil gyis mnan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor snang bar byas te 6/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rnam 36wa 370

pa bsam gyis7kyi khyab pa'i mthu bstan nas/ phyogs bcu thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du chos bstanasapa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du brlabs54)pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus snang bar byas te⑤/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas/ steng gi bar snang la 'od zer stuga' 6)po'i sprin gyi dra ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa chen por byas te dzoda'adug go/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 8)mdzod spu dag nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i 'od snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer0)'khor gyi 'od zer 3 rigangs myed pa dang ldan pa dag71byung72bar gyur to/ /byung nas kyang de dag gis phyogs bcu thams cad du 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 3nyeklas pa kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi 7dkyil 'khor du chos bstan pa'i byin gyis byin du brlabasalgepa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 8'phrul pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa bstan nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed7 7'di yang snang bar byas32/ bcom ldan 'das shākya hu)thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'di 'ang snang bar byas te( bye/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po'i lus kyang 31snang bar byas nas(nyal/ steng gi bar snang la de bzhin du 'od zer stugs snyepo'i sprin gyi dra ba'i khang pa brtsegs du stepa chen por byas te 'khod do/ /de nas 'od zer5 nyestug po'i sprin gyi dra ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa chen po de dag nas 37sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis sgra'i rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di byung ge 1ngo / /mi mnyam mnyam dang mnyam pa mkha' dang mnyam pa dag /stobs bcu'i khyu mchog mthu ldan 22tshad med yon tan can//36wa 371

'jig rten kun mchog mi yinyedam pa phul gyi rnams/ /shākya〈seng ge'i chos la byin rlabasasnyedam pa mdzad/ /bde gshegs sras po 'dren pa'i byin gyis bshad par gyisage// /chos rgyal khyu mchog rnams kyi mdzod kyi dam pa phye/ / sa yi ye shes rnam phyepo)spyod mchog rab yangs pa/ /stobs bcu'i byin gyis ma thogs myur du bstan pa gyis/ /gang gi⑧rna lam bsam par chos dam7rin chen 'di/ /song bar gyur pa de dag bde gshegs byin gyis brlabs0/ /rdul med sa kun rim gyis rab tu rdzogs byas nas/ /stobs bcu ldan pa'i rgyal ba dam par 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho'i chu byung gyur cing bskal (nyepa'i myes gdungs kyang ske/ /gal te snod gyur sems can de dag 'di la nyan/ /gang rnams the tsomatshwanyeza zhing yid gnyis byed pa ni(nye/ /de dag rna bas rnam pa kun tu thos mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sa yi77ye shes lam mchog bstan par gyisasnyi/ /gnas dang rgyud dang 'phro ba rim gyis rab tu shod/ /spyod dang yul dang chos dang ye shes tshul rnams kyi / /chos kyi tshul yang 'gro ba kun la phan phyir shod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos phyogs bcur bltas nas/ 'khor thams cad de bas kyang dad paratsobya ba'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /phra la shes dka' nyi 7drang srong chen po'i lam/ /mi rtog rtog yul ma yin lta 8bar dka' / /rang bzhin zhi zhing 'gag med 'byung ba med/ /mkhas gsal shes pas khong du chud pa yin/ /ngo bo nyid stong zhi zhing sdug bsngal zad/ /rgyud las rnam grol mnyam par mya ngan 'das/ /mtha' dang dbus77med tshig gis brjod du med/ /dus gsum grol ba nam mkha' 'dra zhing mtshungs0/ /bde gshegs spyod yul zhi zhing nye bar zhi/ /smra ba'i lam rnams kun gyis brjod par dka'adunya/ /36—372

de dag sa dang spyod pa de 'dra bas①/ /smra bar dka' na bstan par ga⑧la nus//de ni bsam yas sems lam rnam par spangs/ /ye shes mngon bsgrubasabargyal ba'i spyod yul te/ /phung po skye mched khams kyis skyed pasamin/ /sems kyis mi7shes yid kyis rnam ma brtags⑥/ /ji ltar bar snang gnas kyi bya yi rjes/ /shin tu smra dka' bstan par mi nus pa/ /de ltar bde gshegs sras kyi sa rnams kyang / /yid dang sems kyisheyul gyis shes mi nus/ /'on kyang byams dang snying rjeshesmon lam gyis/ /de las phyogs tsam rim pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /bshad par bya ste sems kyi spyod yul min/ /7ye shes tshul gyis rdzogs par bya ba'o(1/ /de 'dra'i spyod yul phra zhing blta dka' cib/ /rang rig yin pas brjod par mishenus kyang / /'on kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i mthus brjod kyis8/ /thams cad mthun par nan tan gyis de bonyon/ /ye shes sa dang spyod 'jug ci 'dra ba//bskal pa bye bar zad par mi nus te/ /yang dag don dngos gzhan min gnas pa las/ /mdo tsam bshad kyis7de dag mnyan par gyis/ /mthun zhing nan tan yod par sta gon gnas(nye/ /bde gshegs byin gyis bdag gis bshad par bya / /dpel ldan 'thad la yi ge mnyam pa yi/ /chos sgra dam pa bdag gis brjod par bya/ /'di ni tshig gis brjod par shin tu dka'4)/ /de ltar tshad med bde gshegs mthu dag las/ /chu thigs gcig 'dra bdag gi )lus 'di la / /de ring zhugs kyisadza tebashad pa mnyan par gyis/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras5 gyedag/ de la〈 nyesems can dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu bstsagasal stepa spyad bsngo nyeshin tu spyodas nyapa/tshogs shin tu bsags nu)pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung (nyeb shin tu bsnyen bkur5)ba/chos dkar po shin tu bsdus pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis shin tu bzung ba/36—373

bsam pa yongs su dag pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu rgya chen po can mos pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa/ snying rje dang snying brtse ba nya)mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mngon par mos pa rnams rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mos pa dang / stobs bcu'i stobs thob par bya ba dang / mi 'jigs pa chen po du nithob par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ③mnyam pa nyid thob par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab par bya ba dang / snying brtse ge)ba dang snying rje chen po yongs su dag par bya ba 3dang / phyogs bcu ma lus par thogs pa med pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar 45)bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa thams cad thogs pa med par yongs su sbyangs par (3)bya ba dang /dus gsum thams cad skad cig gcig 2gis khong du chud par bya ba dang /chos kyi 'khor lo chen po rab tu bskor ba la khyu mchog gi mthupo)dbyung ba rgya chen po 'thob nyu par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro ba/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi 11dbang du gyur pa/ thabs mkhas pas yongs su bzung ba/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pas rab tu brtan tsho/rtepa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ sems can gyi stobs dang ske/ blo'i stobs rnam par dbye bar bya 32ba shin tu rnam par phye ba chags pa med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa rang byung rke7gi ye shes dang mthun pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la shes rab dang ye shes kyi man ngag yang dag par tshol brka/ sangs rgyas byung 12ba thams cad las gdams ngag yang dag par blangs pas / chos kyi dbyings kyis 1 tshoklas pa/nya/ nam mkha'i mthar thug nyu par gnas pa / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par skye 3 ribar 'gyur te/ sems bskyed pa de 36—374

bskyed ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po so so'i skye bo'i sa las01rab tu 'das pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa na shin tu non pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa yin/ /rigs brjod pa la kha na ma tho ba med pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi lam thams cad las phyir log pa yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam shin tu non pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid la gnas pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa la rab tu gnas pa yin/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba yin / rdzogs pa'i byang chub la shin tu gzhol bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su nges pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /chos kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu la gnas pa'i gebyang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa 5rab tu dga' ba la mi g.yo ba'i tshul gyis rab tu gnas so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rab tu dga' ba mang 6ba yin/ yid bde ba mang ba yin/ mos pa mang ba yin / rangs pa mang ba yin/ mgu ba mang ba yin/ spro ba mang ba yin/ rtsol ba mang ba yin/7) 'tshe 8ba med pa mang ba yin/ khro ba med pa mang ba yin / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag / de ltar 9 byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rjes su 7dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa 36—375

rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i khyad par rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul mi 'phrogs pa rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdamasatungag dang lus rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ sems can gyi don rab tu thob par bya ba rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la 'jug pa'i thabs rjes su dran zhing rab tu dga' ba yin/ yanga'i0'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi yul las phyir log go/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyedas)do/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi sa 3)dang nye bar gyur to7zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed do/ /bdag ni byis pa'i sa las ring du gyur to/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed5྅do/ /bdag ni ye shes kyi sa dang nye bar gyur to/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed 7do/ /bdag ni ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i co'ajigs pa thams cad rgyun chad nyunyado/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed7do/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad nya kyi gnas su gyur tong/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed nya2do/ /bdag ni77de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ba dang nye bar gyur to/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed7do/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul la〈nyeyang dag par 'byung5)ngo / /zhes 5 ༷rab tu dga' ba bskyedamanyado/ /bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyidam dang ldan par gyur to/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyedam nyedo/ /bdag ni zhu )'jigs pa dang / bag tsha ba dang sngangs pa sridang / skyitsogaya' ba thams cad dang bral lo/ /zhes rab tu dga' ba bskyed5)do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag ju nye'adi ltar 36wa 376

byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba 'di thobasnyem thag tu 'jigs pa'i rnam pa 'di dag 'di lta ste/ 'tsho ba med pas ②'jigs pa 'amakha/ mi bsngags pas 'jigs pa 'amanya/ 'chi bas 'jigs pa 'amatsho/ngan song gis ⑦'jigs pa 'am/ 'khor du bag tsha bas 'jigs pa de dag thams cad de la myed pa yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni bdag gi 'du shes dang bral bas de la bdag 'phangs ⑧par sems pa'ang med na/ yo byad thams cad la phangs par sems pa lta ga la yod del/ de'i phyir de la tu )'tsho ba med pas 'jigs pa myed do/ /de ni su las kyang rim gror〈nyabya ba chung7zad tsam yang re ba med la gzhan du na bdag nyid kyis sems can de dag la yo byad mang po thams cad kyis bsdud7par bya'o/ /snyamachadu sems pas(nye/ de'i phyir de la mi bsngags pa'i 'jigs pa med do/ /de bdag tu lta ba dang bral bas de la bdag gi tunye'adu shes myed de de'i phyir de la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa myed do / /bdag shi nas kyang gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dag dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de'i phyir de la ngan song gi (/)'jigs pa myed do/ /de5nye'adi snyam du sems te/ bdag gi5 sprebasam pa dang 'jig rten na mtshungs pa rtesu yang med na lhag pa lta ga la yod ces de'i phyir de la 'khor du bag tsha ba med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar 'jigs pa dang / dngangs pa〈nyedang bag tsha ba dang skyi g.ya' badza stemed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas lhag pa'i bsam pa ma nyams (nyeshing mi dma' bas de bas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsdu ba'i phyir rab tu brtson par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dgasu /de dad pa la dbang bsgyuramanyeb 36—377

dang mos pa mang ba dang yid ches pa shin tu rnam par dag pa dang rtog pa mang ba dang snying brtse 17ba dang / snying rjes mngon par bsgrub du pa dang byams pa chen po dang ldan pa dang / yid skyo ba med pa dang ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa'i rgyan dang bzod cing nges pa dang ldan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la ④rim gro ④dang bkur sti cadang ri mo yod pa dang nyin mtshan du mi ngoms par dge ba'i rtsa ba stsogs 7pa dang dge ba'i bshes (8phyoganyen la bsten 59pa dang / chos kyi dga' bas dga' bar gnas pa dang / mi ngoms par mang du thos pa tshol ba dang /ji skad du thos pa'i chos la tshul bzhin du rtogs nyu pa dang / gnas med pa'i yid dang 'thob pa dang bkur ste 11dang / bsngags pa la chags pa med pa dang yo byad thams cad la phangs sna par sems shing chags pa med pa nyunyedang sems bskyed pa rin po che lta bus ngoms pa myed par mngon par bsgrub pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sa la mngon par mos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la dmigs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs yongs su tshol ba dang /ba sgyu dang g.yo yongs su spangs pa dang / ji skad du smras pa de ltar byed pa dang /rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bden pa'i tshig gi skarjes su bsrung 39ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la skyon 1 du 'gyur bar myi byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa mi gtong ba dang / ri'i dbang po'i rgyal po chen po ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems mi skul tsho/sheb dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad la mngon par dga' ba med pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 36wa 378

dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lam dang ldan pa dang / mi ngoms par byang chub kyi yan lag gi tshogs rab tu stsogasam3)pa dang / rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par snogong nas gong du khyad par du du'abogs ④pa'i lam tshol ba dang sa yongs su sbyong ba'i ⑤chos kyi rnam ⑥pa 'di lta bu dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa yin te/ de byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba de la shin tu5meganas shing rnam pa 'di lta bu'i smon lam chen po dang / 3)brtson pa chen po dang / mngon par bsgrub pa chen po 'di dag mngon par sgrubasheste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ma lus pa lhag ma med pa dang tshimatha' dag la mchod cing nyu1rim gro nyi bya ba'i phyir rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa mos pa rgya chen pos rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa(nya/ bskal pa 'grangasalgepa thams cad du sangs rgyas skye ba 'grangs 8pa la rim gros dang / mchod pa chen po bya ba 1 1rgyun mi 'chad hu pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrubasngortebo/ /'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshul yang dag par gzung ba tsho byedang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub yang dag par blangs pa 1dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa yang dag par bsrung ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa / phyi ma'i mtha'i du mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs zhu pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'grangs 24pa'i (dedam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub ri 5po/ /'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams 36wa 379

'byam hu)klas pa thams cad ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad kyi dga' ldan gyi pho7brang dam pa na bzhugs pa la stsogs7te/ 'pho ba dang gshegs pa dang ske/ sku na bzhugs pa dang / skye ba dang / gzhon nu'i⑧rol pa dang /btsun ⑦mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang /dka' 57ba spyad pa dang / snying po byang chub tu gshegs pa dang / bdud gdul ba dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pashechen po ston pa'i drung du 'gro zhing mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos yang dag par gzung ba'i sbyor ba las stsogs〈nyepa thams cadarwanyegacig tu mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyis (nyeklas par rgya che ba nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i 8phur thug pa 8bskal pa 'grangs pa tsothams cad du sangs rgyas 'byung ba 'grangs pa'i drung du 'gro ba nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar gyi drung du 'gro ba rgyun mi chad tunyepa'i smon lam ()chen po mngon par sgrub du —rtepo/ /'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya57chen po shin tu yangs pa tshad med pa/ mi 'phrogs pa tha mi dad pa pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyis yang dag par bsdus pa/ sa yongs su sbyang ba'i yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag du bcas pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang / mtshan nyid dang bye brag gi mtshan nyid du bcas pa dang / 'grub pa dang / 'jig pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par gtogs pa thams cad dang / sa ji lta ba (snyebazhin dang / ji lta bur bstan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyang ba la gdams ngag dang / man ngag gi sbyin pa nunyenye bar bstan5 stepa'i sems bskyed 36wa 380

pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa ①rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i〈mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs rdzi pa thams cad du spyod pa 'grangs ④pa sems bskyed pas mngon par bsgrub pa/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrubatsonopo/ /'di lta ste / sems can gyi ༅khams thams cad ma lus pa lhag ma med pa mtha' dag gzugs yod pa dang dzorme/ gzugs skyed pa dang / 'du shes yod pa dang /'du shes med pa dang / 'du shes yod pa'ang ma yinani/ 'du shes med pa'ang ma yin pa dang 13/ sgo nga las skyes pa dang / mngal las ⑩skyes pa dang /drod gsher las skyes pa dang / rdzus te nyu1byung ba khams gsum du gtogs pa/'gro ba drug tu 'dus pa/ skye ba thams cad du turnyegatogs pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dngasnyisangs rgyas kyi chos la gzud pa bodang ske/ lam gyi rgyud 'grangs pa thams cad rgyun gcad7pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par/ rgya che ba nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa bskal pa 'grangs hunyapa thams cad dang / sems can 'grangs hunyepa thams cad du sems can gyi khams yongs su smin par bya ba la 17rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub tsho ci ribo/ /'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyimanyakhams yangs pa dang ske/ dogasngo gepa dang / rgya chen po dang / tshad myed pa dang / phra ba dang /che ba dang / snrel zhi nusnyedang / spyi'u tshugs sudza stergyu ba nyethams cad ma lus pa lhag ma myed pa mtha'adza nyadag gzhi mnyam par yang dag par 'jug pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / myig 'phrul gyi rnam pa zhu tsholtar phyogs bcu'i rnam pa tha dad pa rte36wa 381

ma lus pa'i rnam pa la 1'jug pa/ rnam par phye ba'i ye shes khong du chudashecing /mngon du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs dpa thams cad du/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'grangs par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la 'jug cing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub ri5bo/ /'di lta ste/ zhing thams cad zhing gcig tu yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba dang / zhing gcig zhing thams cad du 6)yang dag par gzhol bar 7bya ba dang / yongs su sbyang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med 5pa 'od mang po'i rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan par bya ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad bstsal 9bas/ yongs su dag pa'i lam dang ldan pa dang ske/ sems can ye shes kyi 'byung gnas tshad med pas yongs su gang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yul rgya chen po la yang dag par gzhol zhing khong du chud par bya ba dang ske/ bsam pa'i tshul bzhin du sems can rnams tshal yang dag par bstan cing shin tu tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 1 mthar thug pa 2/ phyi ma'i mtha'i sna mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs 1 pa thams cad du zhing 'grangs 15par sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba la rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub 16bo/ /'di lta ste / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 1 tshobasam pa gcig pa'i sbyor ba dang /stod 18pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bstsags 17pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 2 dmyigs pa gcig cing mnyam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'grogs shing myi 'bral ba dang /36wa 382

sangs rgyas 'byung ba ci dgar bstan pa dang / rang gi7sems bskyed pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul dang / mthu dang ye shes khong du chud par bya ba dang / ma nyams shing rjes su 'brang ba'i mngon par shes pa rab tu thob par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi tsho khams thams cad du rnam par rgyu bar bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil ri 'khor du gzugs brnyan 'byung ba yang dag par bstan pa dang / skye ba'i skye gnas thams cad du rang gi lus rjes su 'gro bar bya bsredang / theg pa chen po bsam gyis myi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad spyad parabargyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya 6)che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa⑦/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur bathug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs pa thams cad du/ spyod pa 'grangs hu )par theg pa chen po mngon par bsgrub pa la rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub nyu1bo/ /'di lta ste/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo la hurteyang dag par gnas shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las don yod par bya ba dang /mthong ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi chos gdon mi za bar 'thob nyi par bya ba dang /dbyangs brjod ma thag tu ye shes khong du chud par bya ba skodang / dad par gyur ma thag tu nyon mongs pa phyir mi ldog par bya ba dang / bsam pa sman 8gyi rgyal po chen po lta bu tsharab tu thob par bya ba dang / lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'thob hu 7par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 12spyod pa thams cad spyad pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi hu)mthar thug pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs 3 )pa thams cad du 36wa 383

phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'grangasamanyapar spyod pa thams cad50'bras bu yod pas rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrubam4)bo/ /'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dang / skra'i spubs gcig dang tha mi dad pa'i skra'i sbubs thams cad du tshe dang skye ba dang / gzhon nu rol pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par 'byungs5)ba dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang / snying po byang chub tu gshegs pa dang / bdud 'dul7ba dang mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo chen pokhubaskor ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba (9chen po bstan pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi yul dang mthu dang ye shes chen po khong du chud par bya ba dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang / skad cig gcigashoshenatu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dang / rab tu zhi bshithob par bya ba yang dag par bstan pa dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya ba gcig gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad 'phrul pas rgyas par dgang 11ba dang /dbyangs gcig brjod pas sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sems dang /bsam pa shin tu tshim par bya ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pal chen po yongs su bstan pa dang / spyod pa rnams rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba dang / theg pa chen po'i sa la chos thams cad rnam par dgod pa 32yang dag par bstan pa dang /chos shes pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyu tshedang / mngon par shes pa dang dbang gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad sprul pas rnam par dgang nyugeba'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi tsomathar thug pa/ phyi ma'i 36—384

mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa 'grangs ①pa thams cad du mngon par 'tshang rgya ②ba 'grangs ③par ye shes chen po'i mngon par shes pa ④rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par sgrub 'bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar rnam pa 'di lta bu'i smon lam chen po dang / brtson 'grus chen po dang /mngon par bsgrub pa chen po'i smon lam gyi sgo bcu po 'di dag las stsogs pa/smon lam brgya stong grangs med pa phrag〈nyebacu tshang ba0)dag /byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu ⑩dga' ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas thob (1bo /mngon par sgrub ⑩bo/ /smon lam de dag kyang mthar thug pa'i gnas bcus mngon par bsgrubacaste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / chos kyi khams 8kyi mthar thug pa dang /mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / tsosems kyi ⑩dmyigs pa'i khams kyi mthar thug pa dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'i khams kyi 3)mthar thug pa dang /tu)'jig rten gyi rgyud dang / chos kyi rgyud dang / ye shes kyi rgyud kyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dag go// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/4) bam po bcu bzhi0 pa/ de ltar smon lam chen po 'di dag sems can gyi khams kyi mtharalogang du thug pa〈 nyede'i mthar thug par gyur cig /smon lam chen po 'di dag 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gematha' gang du thug pa0stedang / nam mkha'i khams 36—385

dang chos kyi khams dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams dang /① sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i khams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams dang /sems can gyi tsho dmyigs pa'i khams dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrubalgepa'i khams dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyud dang /'a chos kyi rgyud dang / ye shes kyi rgyud kyi khams kyi mtha'adzanagang du thug pa/ de'i mthar7thug par gyur cig /'di 3)ltar sems can gyi khams mthar58)thug pa med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams dang nam mkha'i khams dngashe/ chos kyi khams dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i khams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams dang / sems can gyi hunyadamyigs pa'i khams dang / ye shes kyi mngon par bsgrub pa'i khams dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyud dang / chos kyi rgyud dang / ye shes kyi rgyud kyi khams mthar thug pa med pa de bzhin du smon lam chen po 'di dag kyang mthar thug pa5)myed par gyur te/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag kyang / mthar thug pa myed par gyur cig ces de ltar smon lam shin tu bsgrubs shing phan pa'i7tshesems dang ldan pa/ 'jam pa'i sems dang ldan pa/las su rung ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ dul ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ nye bar zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ mnyen7pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'khrugasalgepa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ glong ba7 7med pa'i sems dang ldan pa de ni legs par rtog pa mang zhing dad pa dang 3)ldan pa yin te/ de ni hu)de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa mngon par bsgrubs pa'i rgyud la yid ches pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag 36—386

par bsdu btul yid ches pa yin/ sa yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / mikhyad par du 'gyur bar la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ stobs yongs su 'grub pa la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa mi 'phrogs pa la mngon par7yid ches pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi yul mtha' dang dbusasnyimed pa〈6)mngon par bsgrub pa la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba'i rjes su 'jug pa la mngon par yid ches pa yin/ 'bras bu yongs su grub pa la mngon par yid ches pa yin te(7)/mdor bsdu (nyen byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad dang ⑨/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa dang / ye shes kyi bar du shin tu bstan pa'i byin gyi rlabs〈rtel mngon par yid ches pa yin no/ / yang de 32'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag de ltar rgya che zhing de ltar zab la de ltar dben zhing de ltar zhi ba〈rteste/ de ltar stong la de ltar mtshan ma samed cing de ltar smon pa myed lo8/de ltar chags pa med de / de ltar gos pa myed cing de ltar tshad med 3 snal sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag de ltar rlabasamanyusheche na 'on kyang byis pa so so'i skye57bo 'di dag lta ba ngan par ltung ( )ba'i rgyud dang / ma rig pa'i mun nag dang /rab rib 0thibs pos kun nas khebs pa'i yid dang / nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan shin tu bsgrengs pa'i du nyeyongs su rtog du snyepa dang / sred pa'i dra bas mngon par ye rngam5hepa'i yid la bya ba dang / sgyu dang g.yo'i thibs po la rjes su spyod pa'i sems dang / bsam pa dang phrag dog dang 'jungs pa can gyi byu nyekun nas 'khor 36wa 387

bsatulam gyi rgyud du skye ba'i kun tu 'brel pa dang / 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang ske/ gti mug la spyod pa'i las7shin tu bstsagasalgepa dang / khro ba dang khon du 'dzin pas 'bar bar babyas pa'i sems kyi me lce dang / phyin ci log dang bcas pa'i lasasnyimangon par bsgrub pa dang / 'dod pa dang sred pa'i ma rig pa dang / lta ba dang kun tu zab pa'i bag chags mtshams 'brel pa'i sems dang ske/ yid dang rnam par shes pa'i sa bon gyis 'di lta ste/ khams gsum du ming dang gzugs lhan cig tu/ skyes shing tha mi dad par byung ba'i yang skye ba'i sdug bsngal gyi myu gu mngon par skyed nido/ /mying dang gzugs de rnam par 'phel nas skye mched drug gi tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /skye mched rnams byung bas mephan tshun reg pa dang phrad cing 'dus pas tshor ba mngon par 'byung ngo / /tshor ba myong bapo )de nyid la yang dang yang mngon par dga' bas sred pa dang nye bar len pa rnam par 'phel lo/ /nye bar len pa rnam par 'phel bas/ srid pa kun tu 'byung ngo / /srid pa kun tu 'byungarwa1bas skye ba dang / 8rga shi dang /mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don78pa dang / sdug bsngalasadang / yid myi bde ba dang ske/ 'khrug gepa rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar sems can de dag gi sdug bsngal gyi phung po bdag dang bdag gi myed pa/ gsob gsog stong pa byed pa myed pa/ sems med pa rtswa (shedang shing dang ⑪/ rtsig pa dang /sgang ni )sgong dang mig yor (nyalta bu mngon par 'byung ba (3yang de ltar khong du myi chud do zhes( rnye/ de la byang chub sems dpas〈 stesems can de dag de ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang 'bral〈 nyemi myong ba mthong nas/ de'i phyir de'i snying rje chen po rgyas par 2nya'abyung ste/ sems can 'di dag ni bdag gis yongs su 36wa 388

bskyab par bya ba dag go/ /yongs su dgrol bar7bya ba dag go/ /shin tu bde bshel dgod par bya ba dag go snyam steg/ de'i phyir de'i byams pa chen posnyergyas par 'byung ngo5ge/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' snying rje dang byamasapo)pa de lta bu'i rnam pa dang ldan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i tshe/ dngos po thams cad la phangs par sems57pa'i sems yongs su spangs〈kyenas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mos pa dang / dad pa rlabasashepo che'i blos sbyin pa chen po la rab tu brtson par byed de/ de 'di ltar 'di ⑩lta ste/ nor dang / 'bru'i mdzod dang / bang ba yongs su gtang bar bya ba dag gam/ gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig hunadang / be+e ḍūr+ya〈rnyedang / rin po che shi la 3lhadang / byi ru dang /dngul dang / sa le sbram yongs su gtang bar bya ba 'amatsha/ rin po che'i rgyanasadang ske/ lhab 7lhub yongs su gtangalo tshob 'am rta dang / glang po dang / shing rta dang rkang tang /nyedang / bzhin5)pa yongs su gtang ba 'am/ bran pho dang /bran mo yongs su gtang ba 'am/ grong dang grong khyer dang / ljongs dang / pho brang 'khor dang / rgyal po'i gnas yongs su gtang ba 'ayo me+e/ bza' shing gi ra ba dang / dka' du 1thub kyi nags tshal dang / gtsug lag khang yongs su gtang ba 'am/ chung ma dang bu dang bu mo yongs su gtang ba 'am/ sdug cing yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po thams cad yongs su gtang sa ba 'am/ mgo dang rna ba dang rka ni lag dang myig dang yan lag gi dam pa dang / lus thams cad yongs su gtang ge rab 'am/ gtang bar bya ba'i dngos po de dag thams cad la chags pa myed par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la dad pa dang / mos pa'i 36wa 389

blos yongs su gtong ste/ de ltar denyebyang chub sems dpa'i sa dang por②'di la gnas pa'i tshe gtong ba chen po rab tu byed do/ /de de ltar byams pa dang snying rje dang gtong ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir yang dang yang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don yongs su tshol zhing don du gnyer to/ /de de ltar yongs su tshol zhing don du gnyer ba'i tshe/ yongs su skyo ba'i sems mi skye ste/ de'i phyir de'i7yongs su mi skyo thuba'i sems mngon par 'byung ngo / /yongs su skyo ba med pas 3)gtsug lag thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa yin/ de'i phyir de gtsug4)lag thams cad la rab tu shes pa yin tertsorme/ de de lta bu'i gtsug lag 8dang ldan pas bya ba dang myi bya ba shin tu rtogasamatshopa'i blos sems can 1 rab nyana'abring dang tha ma la dad pa'i tshul ji lta ba dang / ci 'os pas ci nus su snying thag pa nas72yang dag pa nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir brtson par byed do/ /nan tan nyusnyedu byed do/ /de'i phyir de 'jig rten shes pa yin te/ 'jig rten shes pas dus dang tshod du skoran par spyod cing ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pas tshabasam pa shin tu brgyan pas bdag dang gzhan gyi don du rab tu brtson par byed demi/ de'i phyir lha ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa yin/ sbyor ba de dag la'ang 'byung bar spyod pa tu yin/ phyir mi zlogs shing 19phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus ༷ tshodang stobs kyi ni7shugs kyang zhurterab tu thob pa yin tezhun/ de ltar de'i nisnyedaga' ba'i stobs dang shugs yongs su skyes pa 35yin/ dga' ba'i stobs dang shugs rab tu thob pas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod cing rim gro ri 'bya ba la rab tu brtson zhing bstan pa la'ang nan tan na shin tu byed do/ /de ltar de'i ni sa yongs su sbyong ba'i chos 'di lta ste/36wa 390

dad pa dang snying rje dang / byams pa dang / gtong ba dang / skyo ba med pa dang ske/ gtsugatulag shes pa dang / 'jig rten shes pa dang / khrel yod cing ngo tsha shes pa dang / dga' ba'i stobs kyi shugs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mchod cing rim grorababya ba'i nan tan yongs su skyes pa yin no/ /de dedza ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba 'di la gnas pa'i tshe lta ba rgyasho chen po dang ske/ smon lam gyi stobs kyisashesangs rgyas mang po rab tu snang bar 6'gyur te/lta ba rgya chen po dang smon lam ⑦gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas brgya phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas stong phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyas brgya 2)stong phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyasam1)khrag khrig mang po dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig stong phrag mang po dang tu —)sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 11mang po rab tu snang bar 3ge'agyur ro/ /des de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag mthong nas bsam hu pa rgya chen pos rim gro 6byed do/ /bkur sti dbyed do/ /bste stang byed do/ /mchod pa byed do/ /na bza' 1 dang bsod snyoms dang /gzims ca /dedang snyun gyi rkyen 16sman dang / yo byad dag kyang 'bul zhing /byang chub sems dpa'i bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyang yongs su 'bul lo/ /dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams la'ang 3 riyang dag par mchod par byed de31/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de ltar des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag mchod pas sems can yongs su smin par bya ba mngon par 'grubs pa yin/ de bsdu ba'i dngos 2 36wa 391

po sbyin pa dang / ngag snyanasho1)pa gnyis kyidzabashas che bas sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /de'i mos pa'i stobs dang shugs kyis bsdu ba'i dngos po gong ma gnyis kyang yongs su 'grub par 'gyur te/ ma lus par khong du chud par ni 3)ma yin no/ /de'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu las sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 55shas che ba yin te/ lhag ma rnams kyang ci tshul ci nus su yang dag par mi bsgrub 6)pa ma yin no/ /de bya ji lta ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa byed cing sems can yongs su smin par bya ba la brtson pa dang / sa yongs su sbyong ba'i chos 'di dag yang dag par blangs tem gnas pa de lta de ltar de'i 9dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos hu rmepa de dag de bas kyang shas cher shin tu byang ba dang / yongs su dag pa dang las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na/ mgar ba mkhas pas gser gyi sa le sbram/ ji lta ji ltar myer bsregs pa de lta de ltar shin tul spebyang zhing 12yongs su dag pa dang / ci dgar las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rnams ji lta ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa byed cing sems can yongs su phyin par bya ba la brtson par byed pa dang / sa yongs su sbyong ba'i nya chos kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag yang dag par blangs 3 te gnas pa de lta de ltar de'i hu9dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen pa kyi tshonyid du yongs su bsngos pa de dag shin tu byang ba dang / yongs su dag pa dang / ci nyi dgar las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /gzhan yang sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po de77nyid kyi rnam 36wa 392

pa dang / 'thob par bya ba dang / rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang /byang chub semasatudapa' dang dge ba'i bshesalgeganyen las yongs su btsal zhing yongs su dri bar bya'o/ /sa'i yan lag yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir yang ngoms myi shes par byas te/ des byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po 'di laphuganas pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / ⑤lnga pa dang / drug pa dang / bdun pa dang / brgyad pa dang /dgu pa dang / bcu pa'i rnam pa dang / thobalgepar bya ba dang / rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu mesangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen las yongs su btsal zhing yongs su〈dri bar bya'o/ /sa'i yan lag yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir yang ngoms mi shes par bya'o/ /des sa'i phyogs dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa 'grub pa dang 'jig pa la7mkhas par bya'o/ /sa'i rnam pa dang / rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa 'thob par bya ba dang rnam par bsgom pa la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa'i rnam pa yongs su sbyang brwanyal mkhas par bya'o/ /sa nas sar 'phar ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa dang sa la rnam par gnas pa la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa nas sa'i gnasalgegazhan du 'pho bar bya ba la〈nyemakhas par bya'o/ /sa nas sar yongs su sbyang ba'i khyad par gyi ye shes la mkhas par bya'o/ /sa nas sa7thob nas phyir mi ldog pa'i ye shes la mkhas par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su sbyang bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa gnanasnyipa la mkhas par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i rnam pa tsomangon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa ni sa dang po las gyen du ma 36—393
