sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes zab mo'i sgor 'jug pa bstan pa tshad med pa la 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sbyor bamanya kyitshad med pa la 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi theg pa chen po yang dag par bsgrub pa la 'jug pa shin tu bstan pa tshad med pa la 'jug go/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 5rnams kyi spyod yul ni de ltar tshad med pa ste/ de ni bskal pa brgya phrag khrag khrig dang / bskal pa stong phrag khrag khrig dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag khrag khrig nas de snyed kyi/bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis kyang bgrang bar dka'abyu ste/ sangs rgyas 5bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyod yul de bdag gis lhun gyis grub par bsgrub par57bya'o/ /rtog pa med pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med par yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes de de ltar shin tu brtags pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa dang ldan zhing rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mngon par 7brtson pa ni/thabs dang shes rab kyis 8)yongs su bsgoms pa'i lam gyi tshogs rgya chen po'i ye shes la mi g.yo ba'i tshul gyis 59yongs su gnas pa yin/ de skad cig gcig tu yang lam tsomangon par bsgrub 11pa las ldang bar mi byed de/ de 'gro yang de lta bu'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa yin/ 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang /nyal ba dang / rmi lam dag tu yang 1 sgrib pa med cing spyod lam thams cad la gnas kyang rnam pa 'di lta bu'i ye 1 shes yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral ba yin/de'i sems bskyed pa re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu r+shayang dag par bsgrub pa yang dag par 36—491

'byung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de snying rje chen po sngon du btang ba'i sems bskyed pa byung ba re re zhing yang 1/ sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi don du yongs su bsngo bas de la gang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su tshol zhing / sems can rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gtong ba 'di ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba thams cad rab tu zhi ba 'di ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang snying rje dang byams pa sngon du 'gro bas sems can thams cad la 'tshigaskosapa med pa 'di ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang gong nas gong du dge ba'i chos tshol bas mi ngoms par dam 'cha' ba ca'adi ni de'i5gebartson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ne)ye shes mngon du bya ba'i phyir / 'gyod pa med pa'i lam dang ldan pa 'di ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa mngon du gyur pa 'di ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang ye shes tshad med pa mngon par bsgrub pa 'di ni de'i thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang gong nas gong du ye shes la dmigs shing mngon par bsgrub 7pa 'di ni de'i smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o//gang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad dang bdud kyi tshogs thams cad kyis gshelam yongs su mi chod 9pa 'di ni de'i stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos thams cad la yang dag pa 1 ji lta ba bzhin du rtog pa 'di ni de'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'ol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i nyu7pha rol tu phyin pa bcu po de 36—492

dag de ltar yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi hu)yang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byin gyi rlabs ri bcu dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu ②rtsa bdun dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang /mdor bsdu na byang chub kyi yan lag gi chos thams cad skad cig skad cig tu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ④rnam par grol ba'i zla bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras ci byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa 'ba' zhig gikhebyang chub kyi yan lag thams cad skad cig skad cig tu yongs su rdzogs par7'gyur ram/ 'on te ma yin gyis mas bcu po thams cad la'ang de bzhin du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa9)/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 57sa bcu po kun la'ang byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad skad cig skad cig tu yongs su rdzogs par lta 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun po nyu sgyu'adi la ni de dag pas71lhag par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'di ni nan tan du bya ba'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ye shes dang mngon par shes pa'i spyod pa yongs su gnon pa ste/ de ltar kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la ni smon lam thams cad la lhag par dmigs pas byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la sems kyi dri ma thams cad bstsal nyu2bas gsum pa la smon lam rnam par 'phel ba dang / chos kyi snang ba thob pas/36—493

bzhi pa la lam la 'jug pas/ lnga pa la 'jig rten gyi spyod pa'i rjes su 'brangatubs / drug pa la chos zab mo'i sgor 'jug pas byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su sgrub ②pas byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad skad cig skad cig tu yongs su grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po nas bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa'i bar du byang chub sems dpas mngon par bsgrubs ④pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub ci nopa'i sbyor ba'i yan lag de dag byang chub sems dpa'i ⑤sa brgyad pa yan cad (6)lhun gyis rtso)grub par yongs su 'grub bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras / 'di lta ste/ dper na/ kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang shin tu dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams gnyis kyi du ci'ajig rten gyi khams kyi bar ni smon lam dang /thabs dang shes rab dang mngon par shes pa'i stobs dang / shugs chen po ma gtogs 97par 'dod 'dod bobargal bar mi nus so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'dres pa dang yongs su dag pa'i bar yang smon pa 11dang / thabs dang / shes rab dang / mngon par shes pa dang /ye shes kyi stobs dang shugs chen po ma gtogs par/ 'dod 'dod brgal (rtebar mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas smras pa/kye rgyal ba'i sras 'o na ci byang chub sems dpa'i (stes bdun rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nyon mongs pa'i spyod pas kun nas ⑩nyon mongs par yid ches par bya ba yin nam sko/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/36wa 494

kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nyid bzung ba yan cad7du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad byang chub tuston)yongs su bsngos pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa dang bral bar garas kyi'os pa'i tshul gyikhulam mnyam pa nyid kyis52yid ches par bya ste ye/ de tsam gyis sa bdun po rnams sushenyon mongs pa'i spyod pa las yang dag par 'das shes ni gemi bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur 9)ba'i rgyal po ni lha rdzas kyi glang po rin po che la zhon78zhing gling bzhi dag tu'ang 'gro/ mi'i sdug bsngal dang ske/ phongs 37pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa rnams kyang rab tu shes te/ 'on kyang nyes pa de dag gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /de tsam gyis mi'i lus las yongs su 'das pa'ang ma yin te/ nam mi'i lus spangs te 32tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes par gyur pa de'i tshe ni tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang na gnas shing stong gitso'ajig rten gyi khams kyang mthong / de dag tu'ang 'gro tshangs pa'i gzugs brnyan yang kun tu ston te mi zhes kyang mi brjod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po bzung ba yan cadamun byang chub sems dpa' nyugepha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la zhin 8zhing 'gro ba thams cad du rgyu ba'i tshe kun nas nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa rnams kyang rab tu shes te yang dag pa'i lam du zhugs pas kun nas nyon mongs pa de dag gis gos par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang de tsam gyi nya sa bdun po rnams la nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa rnams las yang dag par 'das shes ni 32mi bya ste/ nam sbyor ba can gyi spyod pa thams cad spangs te sa bdun po nas sa brgyad pa yongs su non par gyur te / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa yongs su dag pa la zhon 16zhing 'gro ba 36wa 495

thams cad du rgyu ba'i tshe kun nas nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa thams cad kyang rab tu shes te/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba kun las 'das pas nyes pa de dag gis kun nas nyon mongs par gyur ces mi bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni 'dod chags las stsogs0)pa'i nyon mongs pa rlo thams cad las kyang shin tu shas che bar 'da' ste0/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni nyon mongs pa can zhes kyangs /mi bya/ nyon mongs pa med pa zhes kyang mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyon mongs pa thams cad rgyu ba med pas nyon mongs pa can zhes mi bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mngon par 'dod cing bsam pa yongs su ma rdzogs pas nyon mongs pa med pa tsho zhes kyang mi bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 6)la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su dag pa'i lus kyi las dang ldan pa 3)yin/ lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su dag pa'i 8)ngag gi las dang ldan pa yin/ lhag pa'i bsam pas 9yongs su dag pa'i yid kyi las dang ldan pa yin/ de ni 'di ltar mi dge ba'i las kyi lam sna de bzhin gshegs pas smad pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa de dag las thams cad kyi thams cad du yang dag par 'das pas (1 'das pa yin/ gang 'di dag dge ba'i lam yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa de dag gi rjes su rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'brang ba yin/gang yang byang chub sems dpa'i sa lnga pa la bzo'i 12gnas dang las kyi gnas ji ltar mngon par bsgrubs pa de dag thams cad kyang lhun gyis grub par 12rab tu 'byung ngo / /de ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na slob 36—496

dpon du bya ba yin te6)/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa yan cadadza kyi byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par su'ang de dang bsam pa 'am sbyor bas ༷mnyam pa med dog/ /'di ltar yang gang 5'di dag bsam gtan rnams dang /ting nge 'dzin dag dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa dag skyodang / rnam par thar pa rnams kyang thams cad kyi (7thams cad du bsgom pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo'i tshul gyis namangon du 'gyur te/ 'on (9rikyang da dung byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa la ji lta ba 1 de bzhin du ni rnam par smin pas yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin no/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa thams cad la shes rab dang / thabs dang / bsgom pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sngon bas kyang byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /de de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par dbye ba shin tu rnam par nya1phye ba zhes bya ba la 12mnyam par gzhog ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin don shin tu bsam pa zhes bya ba dang / khyad par gyi blo gros shes 1 bya ba dang ske/ rab tu phye ba'i don gyi mdzod ces bya ba dang / chos ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par 'byedas1 pa zhes bya ba dang rtsa ba shin tu gnas pas brtan dpa zhes bya ba dang / ye shes dang mngon par shes pa'i sgo zhes bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings yongs su sbyangs pa zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan zhes bya ba dang ske/ don sna tshogs kyi mdzod 'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo 36—497

zhes bya ba la yang mnyam par gzhig ste/ de dag la stsogs7pa mngon par shes pa dang / ye shes chen po'i 2)sgo'i ting nge 'dzin sa yongs su sbyong bar7byed pa/brgya stong phrag bcu tshang ba la snyoms par 'jug go/ /de thabs dang / shes rab kyis yongs su sbyangs pa'i la ting nge 'dzin de dag rab tu thob pa dang /snying rje dang snying brtse chogeba'i mthus nyan thos kyi sa las 'das pa yin/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das pa yin/ shes rab dang ye shes kyis rnam par dpyad 0pa'i sa mngon sum du gyur pa yin/ de ltar de byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i tshe/ lus kyi las tshad med pa mtshan ma dang bral ba 7norab tu 'byung ngo / /ngag gi las tshad med pasnyimatshan ma dang bral ba rab tu 'byung ngo / /yid kyi las tshad med pa 9rimatshan ma dang bral ba shin tu rnam par sbyangs pa mi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pas snang bar gyur pa tshad med pa rab tu 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de lta go sna cibyang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i tshe'ang byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ngag dang 31yid kyi las tshad med panyurte/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa las yang dag par 'das na ji rob3nye/byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de lta'ang mtsha8yin te/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la dmigs pa'i mthur zad kyi gerang gi blos tsornam par dpyad pa 1 ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun potsha/she'adi la ni rang gi blo'i spyod yul rnam par dpyod 46pa rab tu thob pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi 'phrogs pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu du nyargyal po'i mtshan dang 36wa 498

ldan pa ni btsasalgem thag tu rgyal po'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blos rnam par dpyad kyepas ni ma yin no/ /nam nar ri rison par gyur pa de'i tshe/ rang gi blo'i mthus blon po thams cad kyi byed pa'i tshul las shin tu 'das pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' 'ang 0sems bskyed 3)ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i bdag nyid chen pos/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyisalgeganon te/rang gi blos rnam par brtags pas7)ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang gi yul gyi ye shes kyi stobs kyi0)shugs kyis/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byed pa'i tshul las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i tshe/ lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las zab cing dben la rgyu ba med pa dang ldan pa'ang rab tu thob pa yin te/ khyad par gong du btsal 5)ba'i brtson 'grus kyang yongs su mi gtong ngo / /yongs su btsal ba'i brtson 'grus des kyang yang dag pa'i mthar gnas pa la gnas te / khyad par gong ma shin tu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ yang dag pa'i mtha' 11mngon du'ang /72mi byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa gang yan cad lha du/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa drug pa yan cad8/ byang chub sems dpa'i spu'agog pa la snyoms par 'jug ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 36—499

'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni sems 17skad cig re re la 57yang 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug ste/ 'gog pa mngon du byas shesam kyini mi bya'o/ /de bas na de ni bsam gyis 4/mi khyab pa'i lus dang / ngag dang yid kyi55)las dang ldan zhes bya ba yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag6) /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas pas kyang / gnas la yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du yang mi byed pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ mi la la zhig rgya snyamatsho chen po'i gru chen por zhugs te rgal ba'i thabs la mkhas shing rlung la mkhas pa dang / chu la rinanamakhas pa ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i nyes pas mi gos so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 9)'di la gnas shing pha rol tu phyin pa'i gru chen por zhugs pa yang yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas pas kyang gnas la yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du yang mi byed do de ltar de ye shes kyi stobs dang shugs thob pa ni ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes kyi stobs dang shugs kyis mngon par bsgrub 7pa'i blo dang thabs dang shes rab kyi stobs dang shugs chen pos 'khor ba'i sgo yang ston la mya ngan las 11'das pa'i bsam pa dang yang mi 'bral 12ba yin 'khor mang pos kun nas bskor bar snang yang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems kyi dben pa yang rab tu thob pa yin/ khams gsum du skye ba yang smon lam gyi dbang gis 1lhamangon par sgrub tshal 'jig rten gyi nyes pas kyang mi gos pa yin/ zhi zhing rab tu zhi ba'ang boyin la thabs kyis kyang glurab tu 'bar te/ de ltar 'bar yang tshig par mi 'gyur ba yin/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la'ang yongs su 'jug la nyan thos dang / rang sangs 36—500

rgyas kyi sa las kyang phyir mi0)ldog pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi mthil du yang phyin la bdud kyi yul na'ang 'dug par snang ba yin/ bdud kyi lam bzhi las kyang yang dag par 'das la bdud kyi yul dang spyod yul yang yang dag par ston pa yin/ mu stegs can gyi gnas thams cad na'ang 'dug par snang la/sangs rgyas kyi mu stegs kyi gnas kyi bsam pa yang / mi gtong ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi ②bya ba thams cad dang yang ②ldan par snang la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul la yang yang dag par gzhol ba yin/ lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi 'am ci dang / mi dang mi masayin pa dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi mgon posdomathams cad las lhag pa'i rgyan dang lhab lhub shin tu bsgrub pa yang rab tu thob la/ chos la dga' ba yid la bya ba'ang mi spong ba yin/ de ltar de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan par byang chub sems dpa'imardzi)sa ring du song ba 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i lta ba rgya chen po dang ske/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas mang po snang bar 'gyur te/ lta ba rgya chen po dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis/ sangs rgyas brgya phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas stong phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyas brgya stong phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong〈phrag mang po dang / dunasangs rgyas khrag khrig mang po dang ske/ sangs 4rgyas khrag khrig brgya phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig stong du phrag mang po dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po dang /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po snang bar 'gyur ro/ /des de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag 36—501

mthong nasamanya)bsam pa rgya chen pos rim gro byed do/ /bkur ste7byed do/ /bstisastang byed do/ /mchod pa pabyed do/ /na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang /gzims cha dang snyan gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad dag kyang 'bul zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyang yongs su 'bul lo/ /dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams la yang yang dag par mchod pasabyed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o / /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la bsnyen bkur byed cing / de dag las rjes yidang rim gros nan tan du chos bstan pa nyan cing len to 'dzin tol/ /thos nas kyang ma nor ba'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / shes rab dang ye shes kyi snang bas rab tu brtson par byed cing nan tan gyis yongs su 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi mebastan pa yang yang dag par 'dzin to/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi mngon par rtogs pa yongs su dri bas nikyang mi 'phrogs59)pa yin te/ de sngon bas kyang sems can la phan 'dogs pa'i chos kyi bzod pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba yin/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sngon bas kyang bskal pa du ma dang / bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang /bskal pa stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang /7 bskal pa (1khrag khrig phrag du ma dang /bskal pa khrag khrig brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa khrag khrig stong phrag du ma dang ske/ bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mar shin tu dag cing yongs su byang bar 3geganas so/ /kye rgyal 36—502

ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ gser gyi sa le sbram de nyid rin po che thams cad kyisanyerab tu spras pa ni sngon bas kyang / rgyan gyi rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan gyisar+sānomi thub pa dang / chesakhu'od gsal zhing dang bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba 'di la rngo)gnas pa'i gethabs dang shes rab kyis khyaskubasgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sngon bas kyang ches lnga shin tu byang ba nidang /ches bya'od gsal zhing dang bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad77kyis kyang mi 'phrogs pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na nyi ma'i 'od ni skar ma'i tshogs dang zla ba'i 'od kyis mi 'phrogs shing 'dzam bu'i gling na rlan5)gyi bag yod pa thams cad kyang shin tu skem nyurtepar byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba 'di la gnas pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang sngon bas kyang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis3nye/ mi 'phrogs pa yin/phyin ci log bzhi dang ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa'i rlan gyi rnam pa thams cad kyang /yongs su skem mobla/ /de'i pha rol du phyin pa bcu las/ thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i shas che ba yin te/ lhag ma rnams kyang ci tshul ci nus su mi bsgrubalgepa ma yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi / ring du song ba zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tunyes bdun pa mdor bstan pa'o/ /de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phal cher lha'i (2rgyal po dbang sgyur du 'gyur te/ sems can rnams la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i ye shes yang dag 36—503

par bstabs (1)pa la mkhas shing mthu yod gepa ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis / yongs su dri bas mi zad pa yin/ sems can skyon med par shin tu bslab par ④bya ba la'ang mkhas pa yin te/ sbyin pa 'am/ngag snyan pa 'am/ don bsgrub pa 'am/ don 'thun pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci rtsom yang rung ste/ de thams cad ji ltar na/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ gtso bor 'gyur/ thu bor 'gyur/ phul du 'gyur/dam par 'gyur/ bla na med par 'gyur/ 'dren par 'gyur/ yongs su 'dren par 'gyur ba chogenas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la rten pa'i bar du 'gyur snyam ste/ sangs rgyas yid la bya ba dang / chos yid la bya ba dang /dge 'dun yid la bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yid la bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yid la bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa yid la bya ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yid la bya ba dang / stobs yid la bya ba dang ske/ mi 'jigs pa yid la bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yid la bya ba nas / rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral ba yin te/ de 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig tu/ ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rab tu thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin gyi rlabs shwakyang yang dag par shes pa dngasnyi/'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong snang bar bya ba dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong duma'odaganas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i 36—504

bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la rab tu 'jug 1pa dang / chos kyi sgo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su bstan pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig sribargya stong yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i /ribartson 'grus kyi rnam pa de lta bu rtsom mo/ /de yan cad 4byang chub sems dpa' 5 smon lam gyi mthu can rnams smon lam gyi khyad par gyis rnam par 'phrul te/ de dag gi lus sam 'od dmakhyakyi/ rdzu 'phrul lam/ myig gam/ spyod yul lam/ dbyangs sam/spyod pa'am/ rgyan tam/ byin gyi rlabs 7sam/ mos pa 'am/ mngon par 'du byed pa dag kyang bskal pa du ma dang / bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang /bskal pa stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma'i bar gyis kyang bgrang bar dka'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos sa'i don 'di nyid yang brtag napar bya ba dang bstan par bya ba'i 9riphyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ye shes zab mo don dam tshig gi 7rjes snyegs shing / /sa drug rtogs pa'i yid ldan bdag nyid mnyam bzhag 11pa/ /shes rab thabs gnyis zung du 'brel pa mngon par bsgrub32/ /mkhas pa 1lhas bdun sbyong ba 7dam pa yongs su gnon/ /stong pa mtshan med mi smon snying rje byams dang ldan/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i rjes 'gro sangs rgyas mchod par byed/ /shes pas shes byas bsod nams stobs kyis mi ngoms pas/ /de'i 7phyir mkhas pa bdun pa'i sa phyogs yongs su gnon/ /khams gsum mngon par sgrub mibyed shin tu dben pa thob/ /nyon mongs stobs rnams zhi zhing grol 1 ba zhi la mos/ /mig yor sgyu ma rmi lam mi 18gnyis chos spyod 36wa 505

kyang ske/ /snying rjes17las spyod ston pa mkhas pas bdun pa gnon/ /nam mkha'i bsam pas zhing rnams yongs spyod rnam mi rtog/ri/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dang ldan zhing mi g.yo chos dang ldan/ /brjod pa'i dbyangs bral 'gro ba dgar bya don du gnyer / /skad cig sems kyisas rgyal bas kun mkhyen yang dag gzhol/ /chos rnams 'di dag spyad pas snang ba thob gyur pas/ /'gro ba'i bdon 'dod sa mchog yongs su gnon ri ces bya/ /de dag sa 'di 4)gnas shing mtha' yas sems can spyod/ /bde gshegs tshad med las mkhyen rnam par dpyod pa byed//zhing dang bskal pa chos grangs sna tshogs du ma dang / /mos dang bsam pa sems dang spyod pa sna tshogs dang / /theg pa gsum po bstan pa tshad med yang dag 'jug /bdag gis sems can de dag yongs su smin bya zhes/ /de dag de ltar rnam naphye shes rab lam ldan pa/ /spyod lam bzhi por mngon par brtson zhing thabs dang ldan/ /sems kyi skad cig kun la byang chub yon tan sgrubasti/ /pha rol phyin pa bcur 'jug yongs su rdzogs par byed/ /sems skyes 'gro la yongs sngo 11de ni sbyin pa'o/ /tshul khrims nyon mongs zhi ba bzod pa mi 'tshig rtepa / /brtson 'grus de nas khyad par gong du rtsom 1 pa ste/ /lam las mi sgul de ni legs ldan bsam gtan no/ /mi skye'i rnyibazod pa rdul med mkhas pa'i shes rab mchog /da dung tshamangon 'dod sngo tshab de yi hunyesmon lam ste/ /mi thub stobs yin shin tu rtogs pa ye shes so/ /de ltar byang chub yon tan thams cad kyi skad cig ldan/ /dang por dmigs pas yon tan yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /gnyis la dri ma bstsal 19phyir gsum la bgegs bstsalams )pas/ /bzhi la lam gyis lnga la mnyam pa nyid kyis te nya/ /mi skye'i snang bas mkhas pa'i :drug po zhu rnam par 36wa 506

'phel / /bdun ponye'adir phyin55)yon tan mtha' dag kun rdzogs par/ /smon lam du ma sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub ri pa byed/ /ci phyir zhe na ye shes spyod pa 'dir grub pa/ /de ni brgyad pa yan cadadza4kun tu rnam 5dag 'gyur/ /'da' dka' phyin dka' ye shes mang po'i las kyis 'grub(ne/ /zhing gnyis bar dz+wamatshams ji ltar yongs su brgal dka' bzhin/ /bdun la spyod pa rgyal po chags med ji bzhin te/ /lam la gnas pa yin gyi thams cad brtan ma 'das/ /brgyad pa'i ye shes sa dang gang tshe ldan gyur pa/ /de tshe sems kyi yul 'das ye shes las la gnas/ /tshangs pa 'gro ba 8lta yang mi yi 9bdag nyid min/ /de bzhin mkhas pa pad mo bzhin du mi chags spyod/ /'di la gnas pa nyon mongs sna tshogs rab tu 'da'/ /de dag nyon mongs spyod med byang ba'ang thob pa min(3 ske/ /lam la gnas kyang de 'dra'i nyon mongs spyod med min/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mngon 'dod de bas zad pa min/ /'jig rten bzo dang las gnas rnam pa sna tshogs dag /mkhas pas gtsug lag rgyus 11la gnas te shes byas dang / /bsam gtan mngon shes stobs bsgoms ldan par gyur pa 12rnams/ /de bas gsal 'gyur ting 'dzin sna tshogs mngon par sgrub12/ /nyan thos rang rgyal spyod las (steyongs su 'das pa ste/ /bdun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod la 1lhamakhas pa gnas/ / sngon chad 17bsam pas yin gyi 1 'di la ye shes kyis38/ /nar (6son mthu dang ldan pa'i rgyal po'i bu bzhin no/ /shin tu zab dang ldan pas gong ( — )du rtsom byed de/ /'gog pa'i sems dang ldan yang mngon par mi byed do/ /ji ltar rgya mtshor phyin zhing 21gru chen zhugs gyur pa/ /chu tshul thams cad mngon gyur gru nurtel skyon mi 'gyurari lha/ /de dag sngon bas thabs dang shes 36—507

rab mchog dang ldan/ /shes dka' 'gro ba kun tu shes spyod yon tan mang / /sangs rgyas bye ba yang 1 du bsam pa dag pas mchod/ /gser sbram de nyid rin chen namang pos spras pa bzhin/ /'di la gnas pa'i mkhas pa'i shes rab mchog gi 'od/ /sred dpa'i chu rnams ji ltar gnyi bzhin 4)yongs su skem / /sa mchog 'di la gnas pa dbang sgyur 6rgyal por 'gyur/ /ye shes dam pa'i 'bras bu ston la mthu yod mkhas/ /'dod na brtson 'grus dam pa'i stobs dang ldan gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshang ba dag /phyogs rnams kun tu shin tu 7rimanyam par bzhag pas namathong / /yan cad59)smon lam yon tan mchog can tshad kyang med/ /'di 1 ni sa mchog bdun pa ste/ /rang rgyal71 dbang la spyod pa dang / /'jig rten kun gyis shes par dka'/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'o12/ /ring du song ba zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa'o15// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/〉 bam po ba'o brgyad 15pa/ mkhas pa'i spyod pa de 'dra dam pa thos nas/ / lha yi glu tshogs dang lha'i 1 dbang po kun dga'/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro phan brtson pa mang po/ /bde bar gshegs dang rgyal 1 sras rnams la mchod byed/ /me tog phreng ba rgyal mtshan ba dan yid 'ong / /spos dang phye ma rin chen na bza' rgyan 19pa/ /dbyig gis spras pa'i gdugs rab khrag khrig du ma/ /phreng ba'i sprin kyi dam pa'i char yang mngon 'bebs/ / lha'i bu mos 31yid du 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs/ /du ma'i sil snyan 22gar gyi mchog dang ldan byas snye/ /bde bar gshegs dang rgyal sras mchod pa'i don du/ /thub pa'i yon tan rmad du 36wa 508

byung ba rjodanyebyed/ /thams cad gzigs pa rkang gnyis khyu mchog gtso bo/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul 'gro la phan phyir ston mdzad/ /dbyangs sprin yid du 'ong ba rab tu 'byung ba'i②/ /rnga dang sil snyan sna tshogs rnams las 'di 'byung ge)/ / skra yi (brtse la bde gshegs brgya phrag stong snyed/ / gang ga 5khrag khrig bye ba'i rdul bas de mang / /zhing mchog dam pa mnyam pa med pa yidag na/ /khyu mchog rnams ni rdul bral chos rnams ston mdzad/ /spu gcig rtsesamal 'byam58)klas dam pa'i zhing mang57/ /gling bzhi du ma rgya mtsho mtsho chen kun gnas( bye/ /khor yug bye ba de bzhin hu7ri rab thams cad/ /so so'i tshul dang ldan par kun kyang snang gyur / / skra yi7)rtse mo de la 'gro rgyud drug po/ /yi dgas / byol song mi dang sems dmyal lha dang / /gnod sbyin srin po klu dang lha min mang po/ /sna tshogs las kyi yul la kun kyang spyod byed/ /rdul bral kun gyi zhing gi spyod yul kun tu/ /'khor lo dam pa'i mchog kyang de tshe 'khor gyur/ /'gro ba'i 'du shes sems dang de bzhin spyod pa/ /bde gshegs gsung gi dam pas mikun kyang bstan byas / /sems can lus la bde gshegs zhing mang sna tshogs/ /zhing la sems can rmad snyed 8lus kyang de bzhin/ /lha dang mi yi salam rgyud de bzhin sna tshogs / /mkhyen nas bde bar gshegs pa chos rnams kun ston/ /shin tu yangs pa'i zhing la 'du shes phrar gyur/ /rdul gyi mtshan ma dag la 'du shes yangs gyur/ tsho/ /de las stsogs nyusnyepa bde bar gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul/ /'jig rten kun gyi 37brjod kyang zad par mi 'gyur/ /che ba nyid dbyangs de skad du/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs su grag gyur nas/ /'khor rnams rab tu dga' zhing zhi/ /gsung ba'i mchog la lta zhing gnas/ /'khor rnams zhi bar shes gyur nas/ /36wa 509

rnam grol zla bas yang smras pa/ /sa brgyad pa yi7rnam pa dang / /de lasa'ajug pa bstan gepar mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa la rnam snyipar dbye ba shin tu 'a)byas pa/thabs dang shes rab kyis lam shin tu sbyangs pa/ tshogs shin tu bstsags pa/smon lam chen po shin tu btab pa'i stobs dang shugs ⑧can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du rlabs po)pa rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs dang shugs thob pa/ de bzhin hu )gshegs pa'itshwastestobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yid la bya ba dang ldan pa/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pas yongs su sbyangs pa'i (nyesems dang ldan pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis /snyemangon par 'phags pa/ snying rje dang snying brtse spub chen pos sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi lam tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba de chos thams cad thogatsom nas ma byung ba nyid la yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug go/ /ma skyes pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa dang / thug pa med pa dang / mi rgyu ba dang / mi ldog pa dang / dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin dang / thog ma dang tha ma 7dang dbus mnyam pa nyid dang —/ de bzhin nyid kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la'ang yang dag pa ji lta ba / bzhin du 'jug ste/ des rnam pa thams cad du sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / 'du shes dang bral zhing thogs pa med hu la nam mkha' dang 'dra zhing nam mkha'i rang bzhin du 36—510

khong du chud pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob ces bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la de lta bu'i bzod pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba thob ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i gnas zab mo shes par dka' ba tha mi dad pa mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba 'du shes kyi bgegs thams cad las phyir log pa tshad med pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis hu)mi 'phrogs pa/ dben pamo rithams cad mngon du gyur pa( )/ shin tu thob pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na/dge slong rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa sems kyi dbang dam pa'i pha rol tu bgrod par phyin ④pa mthar gyis 'gog 'a pa'i bar du mnyam par bzhag pa ni rgyu ba 6)dang sems pa9)dang / g.yo ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / 'du shes thams cad dang bral ba yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin dupo)byang chub sems dpa' yang byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba 'di thob ma thag tu ched du bya ba thams cad dang bral te lhun gyis 9grub pa'i chos nyid thob cing lus dang 3 ngag dang sems kyi rtsol bas31thams cad dang bral te shin tu dben pa'i chos nyid la gnas pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste dper na/ mi la la zhig gnyid 12kyis log pa'i rmi lam du bdag chu klung chen pos khyer ba 12snyam byed la/de de nas ci phyin tu 'bad cing rtsol ba chen po rtsom rtsom pa las de 'bad cing rtsol ba chen po de nyid kyis sad par gyur na/ de sad bem thag tu 'bad cing rtsol ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nyon mongs pa'i chu klung chen po bzhir sems can mang po dong bar shes nas 'bad cing rtsol ba yongs su rtsom mo/ /de brtson 36—511

'grus chen po 1 dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba 'di thob ma thag tu ched padu bya ba thams cadam bral ba yin te/ de'i gnyis potswargyu ba 'am/mtshan ma pa rgyu ba dag kyang ci thams cad du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes shing gnas pa ni 'dod pa la spyod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams yongs su mi rgyu ba yin⑦/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'ishes mi g.yo ba la gnas pa'i 49)byang chub sems dpa' yang sems dang 3 tshoyid dang / rnam par shes pa hu1 yongs su rgyu ba rnams thams cad kyi thams cad du yongs su mi rgyu ba yin te/ delo12sangs rgyas la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ byang chub la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ byang chub sems dpa' la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ rang sangs rgyas la yongs su rgyu ba 'am / nyan thos la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ mya ngan las 'das pa la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ dgra bcom pa la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ phyir mi 'ong ba la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba la yongs su rgyu ba 'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa la yongs su rgyu ba yang yongs su mi rgyu na 'jig rten pa'i yongs su rgyu ba yongs su mi rgyu ba lta ci smos1 / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar mi g.yo ba'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs dang shugs la gnas pa de'i chos kyi sgo'i rgyud de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis mnye bar bsgrub pa mdzad de/ de la 'di skad ces kyang bebaka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rjes su rtogs par bya ba la 'di ni don dam pa'i bzod pa'ang yin na⑩/ 'on kyang rigs kyi bu nged kyi stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs 36—512

rgyas kyi chos phun sum tshogs pa de khyod la med cing 3)/ sangs rgyas kyi chos phun ra sum tshogs pa de dag yongs su btsal ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsoms (5 shig /bzod pa'i sgo 'di nyid kyang ma btong shig tsho /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ khyod kyis de ltar zhi ba'i rnam par thar pa thob kyang / byis pa so so'i skye bo 'di dag zhi ba ma yin rab tu zhi ba ma yin te/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs yongs su rgyu bar gyur na/ de ltar rnam par rtog pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su mnar ba la soms5ni / 'di ltar yang rigs kyi bu khyod kyi 6sdon gyi smon lam sems can kyi don yongs su 'grub par bya bar btab pa dang / ye shes kyi sgo bsam gyis 7rimi khyab pa dran par gyis shig /'di 58ltar yang rigs kyi bu 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung /chos kyi dbyings dang chos kyi gnas nyid 'di ni de bzhin du 'dug pa ste/'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nyi tse 9brjod par bya ba ma yin te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad 1 7kyang rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos nyid 'di 'thob bo/ /rigs kyi bu khyod nged kyi lus tshad med pa dang / ye shes tshad med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrub 11pa tshad med pa dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa dang /dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa tshad med pa la ltos/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin du mngon par bsgrub par bya dgos so/ /'di ltar rigs kyi bu gang de ltar chos thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa de ni khyod kyi snang ba gcig pur zad de / rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos snang ba ni 'di 'dra ste/yongs su mtha' yas par song la yongs su mtha' yas par bsgrub 12pa ste/ de 36—513

snyed kyi bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis kyang bgrang bar dkasasti/ de dag thob par bya ba'i phyir mngon par bsgrub pa skyed ②cig /'di ltar yang rigs kyi bu phyogs bcu'i zhing tshad med pa (gedang / sems can tshad med pa dang ske/ chos rnam par phye ba tshad med pa ri4)ltos te/ de dag thams cad ma nor bar 45)bgrang bar gyis shig ces steyi/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la 4)sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo de dag la stsogs narapa gang gis 6)byang chub sems dpa' ye shes rnam par phye ba'i tshul mngon par bsgrub pa'i las tshad med pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa gzhal du med pa de medag nye bar bsgrub gyepa mdzad do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /khyed kyis 7yid ches pa dang / khong du chud par bya na gal te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' de mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgor gzhug pa mdzad du zin na/ de nyid de'i mtha' las brgal 7ba'i mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur 8te/ sems can thams cad kyi dgos 7pa'ang rgyun gcad 1 par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'i las gang gis skad cig 1shegacig tu mngon par bsgrubasngortepas kyang thog du )ma sems bskyed pa phyin cad ri nyas bdun pa ri 2la zhugs shing / rjes su song bamanyeyongs su rtsom pa'i bar snga ma de dag gis brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ stong gi ri 4cha dang khrag khrig gi cha dang / khrag khrig brgya'i cha dang /nu khrag khrig stong gi cha dang / khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dzigi cha dang / bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag 7stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang /36—514

dpe dang / rgyur yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas bsgrun0)pa tsam gyi bar du'ang mi chog pa de snyed du tshad med pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa las nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon cad gelus gcig gis mngon par bsgrubs shu pas spyod pa mngon par bsgrub che par gyur gyi 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lus rnam par phye ba tshad med pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mthu yongs su sdud de/ dbyangs mngon par bsgrub pa7tshad med pa dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa tshad med pa dang ske/ skye ba mngon par bsgrub pa tshad med pa dang / zhing yongs su spyad pas6ritshad med pa dang / sems can yongs su smin 77par bya ba tshad med pa dang /sangs rgyas mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba tshad med pa dang / chos kyi tshul khong du chud pa tshad med pa dang / mngon par shes pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i stobs dang shugs tshad med pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa rnam par phye ba dang / tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba'i lus dang / ngag dang yid kyi las kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod ris pa thams cad kyi mthu mi sgul ba'i tshul gyis yang dag par sgrub7)bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen por 'gro ba'i gru ni rgya mtsho chen por ma phyin gyi bar du ched du bskyod cing 'gro bar bya ba yin te/ rgya mtsho chen po la zhen ma thag tu rlung gi medakyil 'khor gyis bsnatshomebs ched du bskyod mi dgos pa yin/ des rgya mtsho chen po la nyin gcig7)gis ci chod pa de ni sngon chedapo du bskyod 7cing 'gro bas lo brgyar yang de ltar tshad med par phyin par mi nus so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lodage ba'i rtsa ba chen po'i tshogs 36—515

yang dag par bstsags nyu)pa/ theg pa chen po'i grur zhugs pa yang / byang chub sems ridapa'i spyod pa'i rirgya mtshor phyin nas/ yud tsamatshal /cig tu lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kyi sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ji tsam yang dag par gnon pa de ni sngon gyi ched du bya ba'i las kyis bskal pa brgya stong du yang yang dag par gnon 2par mi nus so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa 'di thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni thabs mkhas pa'i ye shes kyis bsgrub pa lhun gyis 46grub pa la shin tu zhugs pa'i/ byang 7 chub sems dpa'i blos thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la rnam par dpyod 3)cing 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba 9yang rnam par dpyod nya rido/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa'ang rnam par dpyod 11do/ /de 'jig rten ji ltar 'byung ba de yang rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten ji ltar 'jig pa de yang rab tu shes so/ /las nyurtagang bstsags pas 12'jig rten 'byung bar 'gyur ba de yang rab tu shes so/ /las gang bstsags mipas 'jig rten na lo'ajig par 'gyur ba de yang rab tu shes so/ /dus ji srid kyis 7'jig rten 'byung bar 'gyur ba de yang rab tu shes so/ /dus ji srid kyis 'jig rten 'jig par 'gyur ba de yang rab tu shes so/ /dus ji srid du 'jig rten nyu tshobyung nas gnas pa de'ang rab tu shes so/ /dus ji srid du 'jig rten zhig par gnas pa18de yang rab tu shes so/ /de sa'i khams shin tu chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /sa'i khams shin tu 19che ba'ang rab tu shes so/ /sa'i khams tshad med pa yang rab tu shes so/ /sa'i khams rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /de chu'i khams shin tu chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /chu'i khams shin tu che ba'ang rab tu shes so/ /chu'i khams tshad med pa'ang rab tu 36wa 516

shes so/ /chu'i khams rnam par phye brtsom yang rab tu shes so/ /de mye'i khams shin tu chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /mye'i khams shin tu che ba yang rab tu shes so/ /mye'i khams tshad med pa yang rab tu shes so/ /mye'i khams rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /de rlung gi mikhams shin tu chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /rlung gi khams shin tu che ba yang rab tu shes so/ /rlung gi khams tshad myed pa yang rab tu shes so/ /rlung gi khams rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /de shin tu phra ba'i rdul shin tu54phra ba nyid kyang raba'igatu shes so/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul yangs pa yang rab tu shes so/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul tshad med pa yang rab tu shes so/ /shin tu phra ba'i55rdul rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams gangs zhen sa'i khams kyis(7)rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /chu'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /mye'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed pas48de dag kyang rab tu shes so / /rlung gi khams kyi rdul she)shin tu phra ba ji snyed pa 1 tshode dag kyang rab tu shes sol/ /rin po che rnam par phye ba ji snyed nyanyayod pa dang 12/ rin po che'i rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed yod pa de 12dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /sems can gyi lus la rdul ji snyed yod pa de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /zhing gi lhun la rdul shin tu phra ba jitsha8snyed yod pa des dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /de sems can gyi palus che ba dang ske/ lus yangs pa dang / lus phra ba dang / lus rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /sems can dmyal ba pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed kyis kyi 7byung ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed kyis 12byung ba dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba 19ji snyed kyis ni 36—517

byung ba dang / lha ma yin gyi 'jig rten pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed kyis byung ba dang / lha'i 'jig rten pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed kyisatubyung ba dang ske/ myi'i ris su gtogs pa'i lus rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed kyis byung ba de dag kyang rab tu shes so/ /de de ltar rdul shin tu phra ba rab tu dbye ②ba la zhugs pa ni 'dod pa'i khams 'jig pa yang rab tu shes so/ /gzugs kyi khams 'jig pa yang rab tu shes so/ /gzugs myed pa'i khams 'jig pa yang rab tu shes so/ /'dod pa'i khams 'dung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /gzugs kyi khams 'du geb yang rab tu shes so/ /gzugs med pa'i khams 'du geb yang rab tu shes so/ /'dod pa'i khams chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /'dod pa'i khams che ba'ang rab tu shes so/ /'dod pa'i khams tshad myed pa'ang rab tu shes so/ /'dod pa'i khams rnam par phye ba yang rab tu shes so/ /gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs myed pa'i khams chung ba yang rab tu shes so/ /che ba'ang rab tu shes so/ /tshad myed pa'ang rab tu shes so/ /rnam par phye ba'ang rab tu shes so/ /de khams gsum rnam par dpyad57)pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa mngon par bsgrub ④pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang ldan la/ sems can gyi lus rab tu dbye ba la mkhas shing / zhing gis lhun rnam par dbye ba'i ye shes la mkhas pas skye ba'i skye mched thams cad mngon par bsgrubalo)pa la blo shin tu gtong7ste/ de ni sems can thams cad 11yongs su phyin par bya ba'i phyir sems can rnams kyi skye ba dang / yongs su grub pa ci 'dra ba de lta bur rang gi lus byin gyis rlob po//de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par bkang zhing sems can gyi mos pa ji lta ba de bzhin du rang gi lus 8mig yor lta bu'i ye shes kyi rjes 36—518

su 'brang bas skye bar bya ba'i phyir mngon par bsgrub0)ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnyis sam/ gsum mamal/ bzhi 'am/ lnga 'am/ bcu 'am/ nyi shu 'am/ sum cu'ams/ bzhi bculoge'am/ lnga bcusadag nas brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du myed pa'i bar dag rgyas par bkang ste/sems can gyi mos pa ji lta ba de bzhin du rang gi lus myig yor lta bu'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang bas skye bar bya ba'i phyir mngon par sgrub7bo/ /de de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan pasakyisangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang myi g.yoshel/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dag du yang snang bar phyin pa yin/ deshesems can rnams kyi lus rnam par phye ba dang / mos pa dang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du zhing de dang de dag dang ske/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dang / de dag tu de ltarwanyede ltar rang gi lus ston te⑩/ midage sbyong gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du dge sbyong gi kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /bram ze'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bram ze'i kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /rgyal rigs kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du rgyal rigs kyi kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /rje'u rigs kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ rje'u rigs kyi kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /khyim bdag gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dul/ khyim bdag gi kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i risalge kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /de bzhin du mtshe ma'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang ske/ dga' ldan gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'phrul dga'i 'khor gyi 36—519

dkyil 'khor dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang /tshangs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor nas 'og min gyi 'khor gyi0)dkyil 'khor gyi bar du de lta'imide lta bu'i kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /des nyan thos kyis bya'adul ba'i sems can rnams la nyan thos kyi lus dang kha dog dang gzugs ston torin / /rang sangs rgyas kyis ri zhi'adul ba'i sems can rnams la rang sangs rgyas kyi lus dang kha dog dang gzugs ston to/ /byang chub sems dpasam༅'dul ba'i sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang kha dog dang gzugs ston torka/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang kha dog dang sa/gzugs ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa ji snyed pa de dag gi sems can rnams kyi mos pa rab tu mang ba 9de dag thams cad du rang gi lus de lta de ltar rnam par phye ba yongs su ston to/ /de lus kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / 'du shes thams cad dang rnam par bral ba ste/ lus mnyam pa nyid thob pas/ sems can gyi lus rab tu shes so/ /zhing gi nyu lus dang hu1rnam par smin pa'i lus dang / nyan thos kyi lus dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lus dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / ye shes kyi lus dang / chos kyi lus dang / nam mkha'i lus kyang 12rab tu shes so/ /desarwanyesems can rnams kyi sems dang bsam pa mngon par bsgrub pa yongs su shes pas/ 'dod na sems can gyi lus tshanam mkha'i lus su byin gyis rlob bo/ /de bzhin du zhing gi lus dang / las rnam par smin pa'i lus dang / nyan thos kyi lus dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi lus dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / de bzhin 36—520

gshegs pa'i sku dang / ye shes kyi lus dang / chos kyi lus kyang nam mkha'i lus su byin gyis 3rlob bo/ /des nasems can rnams kyi sems dang bsam pa mngon par bsgrub pa yongs su shes pas sems can gyi lus rang gi lus su byin gyis rlob bo/ /de bzhin du zhing gi lus dang las rnam par smin pa'i lus dang ske/ nyan thos kyi lus dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lus dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / ye shes kyi lus dang chos kyi lus dang nam mkha'i lus kyang rang gi lus su byin gyis rlob bo/ /des (4 kyisems can rnams kyi sems dang bsam pa mngon par bsgrub pa yongs su shes pas/ lus gang dang gang / lus gang dang gang du 5'dod pa de dang de'i lus su lus de dang de dag byin gyis rlob bo/ /des 6sems can kyi 7lus rnams kyi las kyi lus kyang rab tu shes so/ /rnam par smin pa'i lus dang /nyon mongs pa'i lus dang / gzugs kyi lus dang / gzugs med pa'i lus kyang rab tu shes so/ /zhing gi lus rnams kyi /chung ba'i rang bzhin 9yang rab tu shes so/ /che ba dang tshad med pa 1 dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang /rnam par dag pa dang / snrel zhi 11dang / spyi'u tshugs 1 dang / gzhi mnyam par yang dag par 'jug pa dang / phyogs kyi dra ba rnam par dbye ba lha yang rab tu shes so/ /las rnam par smin pa'i lus rnam par phye ba'i brda 1 yang rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin du nyan thos kyi lus rnam par phye ba'i brda 15dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lus rnam par phye ba'i brda ladang / byang chub sems dpa'i lus rnam par phye ba'i brda yang 1 rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams kyi mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i lus kyang rab tu shes so/ /smon lam gyi 18lus dang 36—521

sprul pa'i lus dang / byin gyi nya)rlabs kyisalus dang / gzugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po'i rgyan gyi lus dang / 'od kyi lus dang yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang / bsod nams kyi lus dang / ye shes kyi lus dang /chos kyi lus kyang mirab tu shes so/ /ye shes kyi lus rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dpyad pa nyid kyang rab tu shes so/ /yang dag pa ji lta bsnyibazhin du brtags pa yang rab tu shes so/ /'bras bu'i sbyor bas ⑤yang dag par bzung ba dang /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par phye ba dang / theg pa gsum rnam par dgod pa dang / thun mong 6)dang thun mong ⑦ma yin pa dang /'byung ba dang mi ni'abyung ba dang / slob pa dang / mi slob pa phyosayang rab tu shes so/ /chos kyi lus rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid kyang rab tu shes so/ /'khrul pa med pa yangapha rab tu shes so/ /gnas dang brdatsha/medang kun rdzob rnam par dgod pa dang / sems can dang sems can ma yin pa'i chos rnam par dgod pa dang /sangs rgyas dang chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnam par dgod pa yang rab tu shes so/ /nam mkha'i lus rnams kyi tshad myed pa nyid kyang rab tu shes rusarte/ /thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / lus myed pa dang / nor ba med cing mtha' yas pa dang 1 / gzugs mang po mngon zhing gsal bar byed pa yang rab tu shes so/ /des lus kyi ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa de lta bu rab tu thob pas bskal pa brjod nyu4du med pa'i yang brjod du med par tshelabyin gyis brlabamatshapa'i phyir / che'i dbang rab tu 'thob bo/ /ting nge 'dzin shin tu rtogs pa'i ye shes la 'jug par 7bya ba'i phyir sems can gyi 1snyedabang rab tu 'thobasngo)bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyan du mas rab tu brgyan cing shin tu klubasam )36wa 522

pa'i byin gyi rlabs ①yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir yo byad kyi dbang rab tu 'thob bo/ /las7kyi rnam par smin pa'i byin gyi rlabs4gu/ dus bzhin du ma nor bar bstan pa'i phyir las kyi dbang rab tu 'thob bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du skye ba yongs su bstan pa'i phyir skye ba'i dbang rab tu 'thob bo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang dus gang du ci munodaga' bar mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir smon lam gyi nyastobs rab tu 'thob bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyis ridzitshorab tu gang ba yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir mos pa'i dbang rab tu 'thobs bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs /ba tu 'thob sa)bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya ri9ba yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ye shes kyi dbang rab tu 'thob bo/ /mtha' dang dbus57med pa'i chos kyi sgo snang ba yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir chos kyi dbang rab tu 'thob bo/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i dbang bcu nyu1po 'di dag thob ma thag 12nas bsam gyis nyid mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yin/ tshad med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yin/yangs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yin/ mi 'phrogs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa yin/des de lta bu'i 7rjes su song zhing de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan pas lus kyi las kha na ma tho ba shin tu med pa mayang dag par rgyu zhing 'byung ba yin/ ngag gi las kha na ma tho ba shin tu med pa yang dag par rgyu zhing 'byung ba yin/ yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba shin tu med cing ye shes sngon 10du 'gro ba ye shes rjes su 'brang ba/36wa 523

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas dbang sgyur 1ba/ snying rje chen po sngonasngo du 'gro ba thabs mkhas pas shin tu rnam par phye ba smon lam gyis shin tu mngon par bsgrubs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis shin tu brlabs pa/ sems can gyi don bya zhing sbyor ba rgyun ma chad pa/ 'jig gi rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par phye ba yang dag par rgyu zhing 'byung ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la mdor bsdu na byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba 'di thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par sdud 5pa'i phyir yang dag par rgyu zhing 'byung ngo / /de ltar des byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba 'di thob pas/ nyon mongs pa'i rgyu ba thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir bsam pa'i stobs shin tu brtan pa 3)yin/ lam dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pa shin tu brtan pa yin/ sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir snying rje chen po'i stobs shin tu brtan pa muyin / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i phyir byams pa chen po'i stobs shin tu brtan 8pa yin/ nyams pa med pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir gzungs kyi stobs shin tu brtan pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu dbye ba'imathoribye brag la mkhas pa'i phyir spobs pa'i stobs shin tu brtan pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par spyod pa'i rnam pa la mkhas pas mngon par shes pa'i stobs shin tu brtan pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba thams cad yongs su mi gtong bas smon lam gyi stobs shin tu brtan pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs shin tu brtan pa yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam pa khothams cad du mngon tu 36—524

gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 1 stobs shin tu brtan pa yin te/ de de lta bu'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pas bya ba thams cad kyang yang nadag par ston la mibya ba thams cad la kha na ma tho ba'ang med pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi sa brgyad pa ste/ mi 'phrogs pa'i phyir mi g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ / ye shes mi zlog pa'i phyir mi 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ /9)'gro ba thams cad kyis 5shes par dka' 6bas na thob par dka' 3)ba'i sa zhes bya'o/ /kha na ma tho ba med pa'i phyir gzhon nu'i sa zhes bya'o / /bsam pa ji lta bab bzhin du dbang bsgyur 49ribs skye ba'i sa zhes bya'o/ /gzod bya ba med pas7 )yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi 11rnam par dbye ba shin tu bya bas nyu2mthar thug pa'i sa zhes bya'o/ /smon lam shin tu mngon par bsgrubatshwa pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan gyis 7rnam par mi 'khrugs pas byin gyi skarlabs kyi sa zhes bya'o/ /sngon gyi mthar 37mngon par bsgrubasatshwa pas lhun gyis grub pa'i sa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub 18pa dang ldan zhing / sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi rjes su song ba/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyis shin tu gsal bar gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam dang /spyod pa dang tshul gyi rjes su song ba/ sangs rgyas kyi yul la mngon du gyur pa de ni rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis shin tu brlabs /9pa yin/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon pos rab tu bsna 27ba yin/ lag na rdo rje rtag par rjes su 'brang ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs yongs su ma btang ba yin/ lus rnam par phye ba tshad med pa 36wa 525

mngon par bsgrub7)pa yin/ lus kyi spyod pa'i stobs thams cad dang ldan pa yin/ mngon par shes pa50chen po'i rnam par smin pa yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa la dbang bsgyuramachos/ba yin/ lungasnyibastan pa tshad med pa yang dag par nod55)pa yin/ yongs su smin pa'i tshul bzhin du 'gro ba rnams la mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su ston pa yin teyi/ de de lta bu'i sa dang ldan zhing theg pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu zhugs pa shin tu rnam par dpyad pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa chen po dang ldan pa/ rtag tu rgyun mi chadam:)par shes rab snang ba'i 'od gzer 58)gtong ba/ chos kyi dbyings chags pa med pa'i lam du zhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tsalam rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa/ yon tan gyi rnam pa thams cad yang dag par ston pa/ rang gi sems bskyed 1 pa la dbang bsgyur 31ba sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' shin tu rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ bdud kyi lam thams cad yongs su bzlog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul dang spyod yul gyi7rjes su zhugs pa ni / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam kyi klas shing mu med pa dag tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis/ spyod pas77de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'ibyang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba thob pa yin zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis mngon par bsgrubs pas rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 7par de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba yin1 / sangs rgyas mthong ba larwashemachod cing bsnyen bkur ba rgya chen po yang yongs su mi gtong ste/ de bskal pa re re dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 36—526

'byamanyeklas pakhure re dag tu yang sangs rgyas du ma dang / sangs rgyas brgya phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas stong phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas brgya stong phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig du ma dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig stong phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang / sangs rgyas bye bshekhrag khrig brgya stongasrephrag du ma la rim gro byed do/ /bkur sti55)byed dol/ /bstekustang byed do/ /mchod pa byed do/ /mchod pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i rnam pa thams cad kyang yang dag par 'bul lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la bsnyen bkur byed cing 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dbye ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos snang ba nye bar bsgrub pa yang g.yang dag par len to/ /de sngonam bas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi mdzod rab tu thob pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par phye ba yongs su bris pa 99)shin tu bstan pas mi 'phrogs pa yin/de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang bskal pa du ma 3rtadang / bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma dang /bskal pa bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa khrag khrig du ma dang /bskal pa khrag khrig brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa khrag khrig stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag tu7du mar nyugeshin tu byang ba dang yongs su dag pa dang shin tu 'od gsal zhing dang bar gnas pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na / gser gyi nyusnyes le sbram de nyid mgar ba mkhas pa des yongs su zin par gyur nas 'dzam bu'i 8gling gi bdag po'i mgul lam mgo la btags na sems 36—527

can 'dzam bu'i gling pa thams cad kyi rgyan gyi nyu)rnam pa kun gyis du mi thub mi 'phrogs pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bar gyis kyang mi 'phrogs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'di dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi 'od chen po ni ye shes kyi 5)sgo shin tu rnam par phye bas sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i mun pa rab tu sel to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di lta ste dper na/ stong la dbang ba'i tshangs pa ni/ stong gi5ge'ajig rten gyi khams byams pas bkang zhing 'od kyis 45skusnang bar byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i /ri sdus mi g.yo ba 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams snang bas rgyas par bkang zhing /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba mthar gyis zhi bar byed do / /lus kyang shin tu tshim par byed do/ / de bzhin du /pha rol du phyin pa bcu las smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i shas che ba yin te/ lhag ma rnams kyang ci 8tshul ci nus su yang dag par mi bsgrub pa 9)ma yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag1 /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa mdor bstan pa'o/ /rgya cher ni bskal pa mu med pas bstan pa'i mthar thug par shes par bya'o/ /de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni phal cher stong gi 11bdag po tshangs pa chen por 'gyur tenyurnye/36—528

gzhan 3)zil gyis gnon cing / gzhan gyi zil gyis mi gnon tsho pa dang / don mthong zhing dbang thob par 'gyur te/ sems can rnams la 40nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gaston pa la mkhas shing mthu yod pa yinazhu/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par phye ba yongs su dris pas mi 'phrogs pa yin/ de sbyin pa 'am/ ngag snyan 56)pa 'am/ don bsgrub pa 'am/ don 'thun pas dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci rtsom yang rung ste/ desamathams cad ji ltar na sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ gtso bor 'gyur/thu bor 'gyur/ phul du 'gyur58)/ dam par 'gyur5)/ bla na med par 'gyur/ )ske/ 'dren par 'gyur/ yongs su 'dren 11par 'gyur ba nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la brten nya pa'i bar du 'gyur snyam ste/ sangs rgyas yid la bya ba dang / chos yid la bya ba dang / dge 'dun yid la bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yid la bya ba dang /1rte byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yid la bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa yid la bya ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yid la bya ba dang / stobs yid la bya ba dang / myi 'jigs pa yid la bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yid la bya ba nas rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du yid la bya ba dang ske/ myi 'bral ba yin te/ de 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig tuthu/ting nge 'dzin stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed /lharab tu 'thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin gyi rlabs 7kyang yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong gsum brgya 36wa 529

stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed skyodashepa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin du phra ba snyed du 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed snang bar bya ba dang ske/ sems can stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i⑧bskal pa stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rnam par 'byed pa dang / lus stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdulas shin tu phra ba snyed ④yongs su bstan pa dang / lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i parabartson 'grus kyi rnam pa de lta bu rtsom mo/ /de yan cad ⑥byang chub sems dpa'i gasmon lam gyi mthu can rnams smon lam gyi khyad par gyis/rnam paramacho8)'phrul te de dag gi lus sam 'od dam/ rdzu 'phrul lam/ mig gam/spyod yul lam/ dbyangs sam/ spyod pa 'am/ rgyan tamanya/ byin gyi rlabs/sam / mos pa 'am/ mngon par 'du 11byed pa dag kyang bskal pa du ma dag0)bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma'i bar gyis nyu kyang bgrang bar dka'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos sa'i don 'di nyid yang brtag tshostepar bya ba dang /bstan par bya ba'i phyir de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /de dag sa bdun shes rab thabs kyis lam sbyangs shing / /shin du mchog bstsags7smon 36—530

lam chen po rab btab pa/ / myi yi she dam pas byin rlabs〈gudage ba'i rtsa ldanakhuzhing ske/ /ye shes mngon 'dod mkhas pa brgyad pa yongs su gnon/ /bsod nams ye shes nyer bstsagasasnyisnying rje byams ldan zhing / /tshad med sems kyi rjes song mkha'aphudang 'dra ba'i blo/ /drang srong chen po chos thosapo)rtogs pa'i stobs ldan pa/ /myi skye ba yi ⑦bzod pa phra zhing zhi ba rab tu 'thob/ /snga nas ma skye0mi skye mtshan nyid med pa dang / /ma byung 'jig pa med cing rgyu ba med pa dang ske/ /dngos po skye 'jig med pa'i de nyidashertog med pa/ /yid dang sems kyi rgyu ba med cing nam mkha' 'dra/ /de dag 'di 'dra'i bzod ldan spros pa med gyur dzo ste pa'i/ /mkhas pa7)zab spyod zhi ba'i gnas rab thob pa yin/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal 'gro ba kun gyis 8shes par dka'/ /mtshan ma sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i 'du shes rnam par bstsalanye/ /de ltar gnas pa'i yid dang sems dang rtogs3 rīpa med/ /dge slong 'gogatsodang ldan par rnam par myi rtog5)thob/ /rmi lam chus khyer gnyidanyesad bzhin du rtsol〈rtedang bral/ /tshangs pa'i gnas kyi 'dod pa ji bzhin gnyis kyang med/ /sngon gyi byin gyis bde gshegs yang dag bskul 33 ba mdzad/ /'di ni bde gshegs dbang bskur bzod pa dam pa ste/ /nged kyi ye shes stobs yang〈tesangs rgyas chos kyi rnamasadu rte/ /de dag khyod la med kyis zhunyede la brtson 'grus rtsomasaste/ /ci phan khyod kyi nyon mongs 'bar ba kun zhi yang / /'jig rten nyon mongs myes5nyetshig de dag mi blta 'amadunya/ /sems can phan phyir spyad pa'i sngon gyi smon lam semasadu / /'gro ba mthar rgyur ye shes don zhugs shes par gyis/ /chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di myi rtog du 3rtag tu 'dug /sa 'di rgyal ba nyan thos rang rgyal kun gyi ste/ /'dis ni 'jig rten dag tu stobs bcu 36wa 531

mi brjod do0)/ /gzhan du ye shes yangs pa du dus gsum tshad kyis brjod/ /de ltar de la mtshungs med lha dang myis mchod pa/ /ye shes sgo mo rnam mang7nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i chos bsgrub ④pa rol mtha' yas gzhugasamadzad pa/ /de la sngon gyi byang chub spyod pas char myi 'gro/ /khyu mchog de dag ye shes sa mchog 'di thob nas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu skad cig gcig gis stso)rgyas 'gengs pa/ /ye shes shugs chudang ldan zhing mngon shes mchog thob pas/ /rgya mtsho cher phyin 48)gru chen rlung gis bkur ba bzhin/ /ched du bskyodas0sems bral zhing ye shes las la gnas/ /zhing rnams 'byung zhing gnas pa rnam par dpyod pa byed/ /khams rnams bzhi po kha dog tha dad yangs pa dang / /phra zhing che dang rnam par phye la yang dag 'jug /stong gsum shin tu rdul phra kun la 'jug byed de/ /khams bzhi 'gro ba'i lus rnams rnam par phye ba dang / /rgyu 7drug rin chen rnam par phye ba'i rdul phran rnams/ /rnam par phye zhing ye shes yul gyis ma lus bgrang 11/ /ye shes rnams 12bsgoms yid ldan lus rnams thams cad du// 'gro ba'i 3)don phyir rang gi 3 )lus rnams gzud pa 'byed/ /stong gsum thams cad sna tshogs gzugs kyis tsokhyab byas shing / /'jig rten mtha' yas dag tu sna tshogs lus kyang ston/ /bar snang mkha' la nyi zla rlung gis nyu tshorgyu 'gro yang / /so so'i dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan chu dkyil rab tu snang / /de bzhin mi g.yo'i chos la ye shes dam pas rgyu/ /bsam dag 'gro ba rnams la mkhas pa'i gzugs brnyan snang / /'gro ba'i bsam pa bzhin du lus kyi rnam phye ba/ / myi dang lha yi 12'khor rnams kun tu ston pa 37byed/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bde gshegs sras kyi lus rnams dang / /bde bar gshegs sku yan lag brgyad 3 ripa 36wa 532

rab tu ston/ /sems can zhing dang de bzhin las kyi rnam smin 6)lus/ /'phags lus sna tshogs de bzhin chos dang ye shes lus/ /nam mkha'i lus dang mnyam pa nyid du khyu mchog ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'gro ba tshim par bya phyir ston / /dbang bcu dri ma myed pa'i ye shes dpyod〈mipa thob/ /ye shes spyod dang las rnams snying rje 'thun pa'ang thob/ /las rnams ji snyed rgyal ba'i chos rnams yongs su bsgrub/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas shing mi g.yo ri rab bzhin/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi stobs bcu bskyod par mi nus pa/ /de dag kun ldan ④bdud rnams kun gyis57yong mi zlog⑤ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs brgya byin tshangs pas phyag kyang byal/ /lag na rdo rje'i dpung rnams rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang〈kye/ /sa phyogs 'di la gnas pa'i yon tan mtha' yas te/ /de dag bskal pa khrag khrig stong gis zad7mi nus/ /de dag sangs rgyas bye ba bsnyen bkur yang byed pas//rgyal po'i mgo la 'dug pa'i rgyan bzhin tu 3shin tu gsal37/ /sa phyogs 'di gnas byang chub sems dpa' shes ldan pa/ /stong gi hurtebadag po tshangs chen yon tan mang por 'gyur/ /theg pa gsum ston yongs su myi 'khrugs〈rtemi 'phrogs te④ / /'od bzangatsobyams pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba'i nyon mongs sel/ /skad cig gcig 7tu stong phrag bcu yi 3 7zhing rnams kyi/ /rdul khams ji snyed de snyed ting 'dzin ldan pa 'thob(snye/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can gtso bo de snyed mang po mthong ske/ /yan cad 37smon lam mchog gi zhu )rgyan can gcig min no/ /'di ni mdor bsdus rgyal sras kyisadu nya/ /sa brgyad shin tu bstan pa ste/ /rgya chem bskal pa bye bar yang / /thams cad mthar〈nyephyin myi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa ste mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'o// //36—533

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/① bam po bcu dgu pa②/ sa yishedam pa 'di bshad tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabasasnyikyis/ /tshad med bsam gyis5gemi khyab pa'i/ /bye ba'i zhing rnams g.yos par gyur⑥/ /thams cad gzigasalgepa'i sku las kyang / /'od gzerasheyid du 'ong ba bkye/ /des ni zhing rnams snang bar byas/ /sems can rnams kyang bde bar gyur⑨/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong snyed kyang / /bar snang gnas la 'khod gyur te/ /lha rdzas lhag pa'i mchod pa yis/ /gsung pa'i mchog la mchod pa byed/ / lha yi rgyal〈 7po dbang phyug dang / /dbang bsgyur hunyarnams kyang dga' bar gyur/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchod pa byed/ /de nas lha yi72bu mo stong / /dga' zhing dbang po bder gyur pas/ /sbyar legs snyan pa'i glu yi nyusnyedabyangs/ /ston pa mchod pa'i don du len/ /rol mo'i sgra dbyangs de dag las/ /drang srong chen po'i byin rlabs kyis / /'di 'dra'i sgra dbyangs stong snyed du/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs su grags7par gyur / /zhi dul rab zhi dri ma thams cad myed gyur cingasnyi/ / sa yi7)mchog dang ldan pas spyod pa legs spyod pa/ /phyogs bcur 'gro la phan par spyod pa'i khyu mchog rnams/ /mkha' dbyings 'dra ba'i yid kyi 18rgyal ba'i spyod pa ston/ / myi yi 37gnas dang lha yi 33 gnas dang klu gnas su/ /phyogs bcur bsod nams stobs kyis 4 nyergyan rnams mang po byung / /de las yang du 6)rgyal sras ye shes lam mos pa/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan bsngags ni )pa rgya chen rab tu ston/ /zhing gcig ma g.yos rdul med zhing rnams〈nyethams cad du/ /'gro la phan byed zla ba lta bu'i 'od ldan pa/ /thams cad dbyangs su 'du shes sems zhi yid rab kyis//36wa 534

so so'i7skad bzhin sgra skad brgya yang rnam par brjod/ /sems can gang rnams blo zhan sems yid dmar7gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa khyu mchog nyan thos spyod pa ston / /sems can gang rnams sems rno rang rgyal theg brtsonasho )pa/ /de la rdul med rang rgyal theg pa'i ye shes ston/ /sems can gang rnams phan sems snying rje brtsetswayid can/ /de la de dag rgyal sras spyod pa'i mchog kyang ston/ /sems can gang rnams blo mchog dam pa'i yid mos pa/ /de la mkhas pa7tshad med sangs rgyas sku ston to/ /ji ltar sgyu mkhan 'gro ba rnams la sgyu ston pa/ /lus mang bye ba sna tshogs de dag dngos po myed/ /de bzhin rgyal sras mkhas pa ye shes sgyu mkhas pa/ /spyod pa thams cad ston kyang de dag dngos po med/ /'di 'dra'inyesgra skad brgya stong du/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs su brjod byas nas/ /lha'i rtso)bu mo mi smra bar/ /zhi la mos pas rgyal ba ltas/ /'khor rnams rnam par dang bas na/ /bde gshegs sras la yang smras pa/ /dam chos spyod pa'i spyod pa rnams/ /brgyad pa'i gong du yang gsungs shig9) /byang chub sems dpa'amakyerdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa la gnas pa ni de lta bu'i blo tshad med pa'i ye shes kyis〈nyarnam par dpyad pas de nas gong du rnam par thar pa zhi ba la mos par zhe non cing de nas gong du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes shin tu rdzogs pa rnam par spyad 8pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'ipha/nyerjes su 'jug par bya ba la 'jug pa dang / ye shes bsam gyis 8mi khyab pa'i che ba nyid rnam par dbyetsob dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin rab tu dbyi7ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mngon par bsgrub pa dang /36—535

'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dbye ba khong du chud par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yongs su mi 'phrogs pa sbyang bar7bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / khyu mchog gi tshogemathu phyung ba'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / snying rje chen po'i mthu phyung ba yongs su myi gtong bar byed pas/byang chub sems dpa'i sa dgu pa yongs su gnon te/ de byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'di la gnas pa'i tshe/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang /ge lung du ma bstan pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes sol/ /zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang ske/ 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang / bsam pa dang bsam du med pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang nges pa dang / ma nges pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'isnyispyod pa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang / 'dus 2byas kyi chos mngon par 'du bya ba dang /'dus ma byas kyis chos mngon par 'du bya ba yang yang7dag palaji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de de lta bu'i shes par bya ba 9)khong du chud pa'i blos (2 sems can gyi 11sems thibs po rab tu rgyu ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ nyon mongs pa'i 12thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / las thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / dbang po thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / mos pa'i hu thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / khams thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / bsam pa dang 36—536

bag la nyal ba ②thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / skye ba thibs napo rab tu rgyu ba dang ske/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba 55thibs po rab tu rgyu ba dang / phung po gsum du rnam par gnas pa'i thibs po rab tu rgyu ba yang dag pa 5ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de ni sems can rnams kyi sems rnam pa ( tha dad pa yang dag pa 47)ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ sems rnam pa sna tshogs dang /sems skad cig tu myur du 'gyur zhing 'jig 8pa dang mi 'jig 9pa dang /sems lus med pa dang / sems mtha' yas shing thams cad du dbang byed pa dang ske/ sems 'od gsal zhing dang ba dang / sems nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa dang / 1 /nyon mongs pa med pa dang / sems bcings pa dang / rnam par grol ba dang / sems sgyu ma lta bur rnam par bsgrub 1 pa dang / sems 'gro ba'i rgyud ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar gnas pa nas/ sems rnam pa 1 sna tshogs/stong phrag du ma'i bar du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de ni nyon mongs pa rnams nyu riring du song ba yang dag pa ji lta 1 ba bzhin du rab tu shes temi / sbyor ba mtha' yas pa dang lhan cig skyes shing tha mi dad pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / kun nas 'khor ba'i loganas gcig pa dang / sems dang ldan pa dang / mi ldan pa dang skye ba'i mtshams sbyor ba dang / lam gyi rgyud ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar gnas pa dang / khams gsum 1 rnam par phye ba dang /sred nya pa dang / ma rig 19pa dang / lta ba'i zug rngu dang / nga rgyal dang gti mug gi kha na ma tho ba chen po dang / las rnam pa gsum gyi gzhi rgyun myi 'chad 2 pa nas mdor bsdu na nyon mongs pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad cu 21rtsa bzhi'i bar du rjes su 'jug par bya ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de ni 36wa 537

las dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung du ma0)bstan pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te②/ rnam par dmyigs pa dang / rnam par mi dmyigs pa dang / sems dang lhan cig tu skyes shing tha mi dad pa dang / rang gi ngang gis skad cig tu rgyus 'byung zhing 'jig sprel 'bras bu chud myi za bar mtshams sbyor cab dang / rnam par smin pa yod pa dang ma/ rnam par smin pa med pa dang / nag po dang / dkar po dang / myi dkarasko6)myi gnag pa dang /phyogs du ma'i las yongs su len pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / las kyi zhing tshad med pa dang 'phags pa dang / 'jig 7rten pa rnam par phye ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnam par dgod pa dang / nye bar len pa dang bcas pa dang / nye bar len pa myed pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus〈)ma byasashedang ske/ tshe 'di dang skye ba dang / rgyud gzhan du tshor bar 'gyur ba zodang /theg pa dang theg pa ma yin par nges pa dang ma nges pa nasatso/ las hunyarnam pa hunyetha dad pa stong phrag brgyad cu 1 rtsa bzhi'i bar du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshesade ni dbang po zhan pa dang / 'bring dang rab rnams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu 7shes te/ sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar tha dad pa tshadang / tha mi dad pa dang / yangs pa dang / 'bring dang tha ma dang ske/ nyon mongs pa dang / lhan cig tu skyes shing tha mi dad pa dang / theg pa dang theg pa ma yin par nges pa dang / ma nges pa dang / yongs su smin pa'i tshul bzhin 1 du 'dul ba dang / dbang po'i dra ba'i rjes su 'brang zhing myur du 'jig pa dang / mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang / dbang po'i dbang 3shegazhan gyis myi thul ba 19dang / dbang po'i rnam pa phyir bzlog tu rung ba dang /36wa 538
