nas rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i 1)thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du yid la bya ba dang / mi 'bral ba yin te/ de 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig tu ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas sangs rgyasasngo kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mthong ba dang /de dag gi nibyin gyi rlabs ④kyang yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed skyod55)pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing (9)brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dushe'agro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa byerte'u)ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed sheXsnang bar bya ba dang ske/ sems can sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyedas3 )yongs su smin par bya ba dang / bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag 31bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa 32sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed sna la rab tu 'jug pa dang / chos kyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mirnam par dbye bar bya ba dang / lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed payongs su bstan pa dang / lus re 36—587

re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyedas 1yang dag par bstan pa'i brtson 'grus kyi rnam pa de lta bu rtsom mo/ /de yan cad ri byang chub sems dpa'ispo smon lam gyi mthu can rnams smon lam gyi khyad par gyis carnam par 'phrul te/de dag gi lus sam 'od dam/ rdzu 'phrul lam/ mig gam spyod yul lam/dbyangs sam spyod pa 'am/ rgyan tam/ byin gyi rlabasamachosam mos pa 'am/mngon par 'du byed pa 6dag kyang bskal pa du ma dang / bskal pa brgya phrag du ma dang / bskal pa stong phrag du ma dang / bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma'i bar gyis kyang bgrang bar dka'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po 7de dag ni rim gyis mngon du gzhol bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la rnam pa thams cad du rjes su 2song bar blta'o9/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ 1 mtsho chen po ma dros pa las byung ba'i 'bab chu ni chu klung chen po'i rgyud kyi sgo bzhis 'dzam bu'i gling yongs su ngoms par byas 11nas mi zad par byas te/ gong du rnam par 'phel ba dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i bar du zhen par 'gyur te/ chu de ni thog ma nas kyang rgya mtsho chen po la mngon par gzhol ba yin te12/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 1 chu 'bab pa yang smon lam chen po'i chu klung gi murgyun gyi sgo nas bsdu ba'i dngos po 15bzhis sems can gyi rkokhams ngoms par byas te/ mi zad par byas nas gong du rnam par 'phel ba dang / rnam pa thams cad du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar gyi rgya mtsho chen po la zhen par 'gyur 1 te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i chu 12de ni thog ma nas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgya mtsho chen po la 36wa 588

mngon par gzhol ba yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi gzhi las yod 3)par 'gyur po te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po'i gzhi las ri'i ri rgyal po chen po bcu yod par gyur pa 'di lta ste/ ri'i rgyal po chen pos rmekha ba can dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po spos phyogangad can dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po rnam par 'dal5yeb dang /ri'i rgyal po chen po drang srong ri dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po gnya' shing 'dzin dang ske/ ri'i rgyal po chen po 3)rta rna rin ri dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po sa 'dzin dang ske/ ri'i rgyal po chen po khor59)yug dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po dpal chen dang /7 ri'i rgyal po chen po ri /lharab bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po kha ba can ni sman gyi rnam pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas tenyurte/ sman sna tshogs thams cad blangs pas 32mthar thug pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag dang / tshig dang sngags dang / rig ༅pa'i gnas kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag dang tshig spudang sngags dang / rig tshapa'i gnas bstan 3 pas mthar thug pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po tsho/spos kyi ngad can ni/ spos kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ spos kyi rnam pa sna tshogs blangs pas nyu9mthar thug pa med do / /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa dri ma dang bral ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'angs31)byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dang / sdom pa dang tshul thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dang 36wa 589

sdom pa dang / tshul rnam pa sna tshogs kyi spos kyi mthar thug pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po rnam par 'dalatub ni/rin pos che'i rang bzhin shin tu dag pa/ rin po che'i rnam pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad blangs pasashezad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'od7byed pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan dang / mngon par shes pa dang /(da rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /snyoms 6)par 'jug pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su dris pa rtsibastan pas5nyezad pa med do / /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste/ dper (spun/ ri'i rgyal po chen po drang srong ri nitshwa ririn po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i 'byung gnas07te/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i drang srong bgrangs pas nyu2zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'od 'phro ba can la nyusnyeganas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang lam dang lam ma yin pa'i khyad par chadang / bye brag shes pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ lam dang lam ma yin pa'i khyad par bedang bye brag gi rgyus7yongs su dris pa yongs su bstan pas zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po gnya' shing 'dzin ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa gnod sbyin 7rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul chen po can bgrangs pas hunye36wa 590

zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa shin tu rgyal bar dka' ba ①la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang mngon par shes pa dang / rju 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ mngon par shes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam7par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul yongs su dris pa bstan pas zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po rta rna7ri ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ shing togashegi rnam pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas༄te/ shing tog gisarnam pa sna tshogs thams cad blangs pas57zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i/ sa mngon sum la gnas pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pa shin tu bstan pa'i 'byung gnas yin te/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu mngon parashekhong du chud par bya ba yongs su dris pa bstan pas zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po sa 'dzin ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ klu rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung gnasashete/ klu rdzu 'phrul chen po can bgrangs pas nyu )zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang thabs dang shes rab shin tu bstan pa'i 'byung gnas yin te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu mngon par khong du chud par bya ba yongs su dris pa/ bstan pas zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po khor yug ni rin po che chen po'i〈nyarang bzhin rnam par dag pa dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/36—591

dbang du gyur pa bgrangs pas gyo)zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang mngon par bsgrub du pa/ yongs su dris pa shin tu bstan pa'i 'byung gnas yin te/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par phye ba yongs su dris pa bstan pas zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ri'i rgyal po dpal dang ldan pa ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa lha〈khum yin la rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ lha ma yin rdzu 'phrul chen po can bgrangs pas rigazad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa legs pa'i blo gros la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can 'byung ba dang / 'jig pa yeshes pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi 7'byung gnas yin te/ 'gro ba thams cad 'byung ba yongs su drisam3)pa bstan pas zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po chen po 9 ri rab ni rin po che'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa lha rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ lha rdzu 'phrul chen po can bgrangs pas 1 zad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sa chos kyi sprin 11la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin hurtelas yang dag par bstan pa yongs su dris pa 1lhabastan pas lazad pa med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras ji ltar rin po che'i ri chen po de dag 1gergya mtsho chen po skyalas byung zhing rgya mtsho chen po las smos pa de bzhin du/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu po 36wa 592

'di dag kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las byung ngos17/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lasakhesmos pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni rnam pa bcus mi 'phrogs pa'i phyir rgya mtsho'i grangs su 'gro ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rim gyis gzhol ba dang / shi ba'i ro dang myi 'gogs pal nadang /chu gzhan gyi grangs yongasam4)su spangs pa dang / ro gcig pa dang / rin po che mang ba dang / zab cing gting ring ba dang / yangs shing tshad med pa dang /'byung po mang po'i gnas su gyur pa dang / dbres kyi tshul las mi 'da' ba dang /sprin chen po'i char thams cad yongs su 'dzin pas mi ngoms pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang spyod pa'i rnam pa bcus mi 'phrogs pa'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta sterigano/ byang chub sems dpa'i yis rab tu dga' ba la smon lam chen po 7rim gyis mngon par bsgrubs58ripas gzhol ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i 9cis dri ma dang bral ba la tshul khrims ngan pa'i ro dang mi 'grogs 3 )pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 11sa 'od byed pa la 'jig rten pa rnam par gdags pa'i grangs yongs su spangs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa 'od 'phro ba can la/ sangs rgyas la mos pa mi phyed pa'i ro gcig pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa shin tu rgyal bar dka' ba la thabs dang mngon par shes pa tshad med pas 12'jig rten gyi bya ba mngon par bsgrubs pa'i rin po che mang ba 1 dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa mngon sum ñdzal rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rab tu brtags nyidapas shin tu zab pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sa ring du song ba la blo dang rnam par 'byed pa dang /mkhas pa yangs 7shing tshad med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa mi g.yo ba 36wa 593

la rgyan chen po mngon par bsgrub pa yang dag par bstan pa'inye'abyung po mang po gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa legs pa'i blo gros la rnam par thar pa thabalo7mo dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi spyod pa ji lta bsnyebazhin du khong du chud pa'i tshul gyi〈gedabres las mi 'da' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa chos kyi sprin la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos snang ba'i phyisprin chen po'i char yang dag par bzung bas⑥/ mi ngoms pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ nor bu rin po che ni ༄7rin po che'i mkhan po mkhas pas shin tu bsregs 2)shin tu bsgrubs shin tu sbyangs shin tu yang dag par byas legs par phug /rin po che'i srad bus legs par btags/ rin po che'i be+e ḍūr+ya'i 7rtsa ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la bzhag ste/ 'od thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur〈nyal rgyal pos bsngags par gyur te/ rin po che'i rigs bcu las 'das shing shin tu 'phags hu par gyur pa de'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la rin po ches〈nyephan gdags pa'i don du nye bar gnas pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi thusems rin po che bskyed pa yang sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi nyagesdom pa dang tshul khrims dang brtul shugs7dang dka' thub kyis shin tu bsregs/ bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pas shin tu bsgrubs/ lam gyi yan lag gis/ 7rnam pas shin tu sbyangs/ thabs nyusnyedang mngon par shes pas shin tu dag par byas/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung bas shin tu phug /thabs dang shes rab rin po che sna tshogs kyi srad bus 3)shin tu btags4) / dbang gi5 lharin po che be+e ḍūd+ma'i yu 22ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la bzhag(3 /sems can gyi spyod 36wa 594

pa rab tu brtags7pa dang / thos pa'i ye shes kyi 'od rab tu 'byung bar gyuralate / chos kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyisamangon par dbang bskur bsasnyedabang bskur bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi phrin ⑤las rin 6)po che ④thams cad kyis yang dag par phan gdags pa'i don du nye bar gnas pa yin te/ de'i tshe thams cad mkhyen pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang dag par bsgrubakucing / rnam pa7thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang yon tan yang dag par bstsags〈nye pa'i chos kyi sgo'i rgyud 'di ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed (nyapa rnams kyi rna lam du grag (rtepar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par grol ba'i zla bas smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'o na rnam pa thams cad du hunyethams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang yon tan (7yang dag par bstsags pa'i chos kyi sgo'i rgyud 'di gang gi rna lam du grag par 7gyur pa de dag bsod nams kyi tshogs ji5nyetsam zhig dang ldan par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthu ji tsam pa de snyed kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed cing bsgrub7)par dmigs pa la yod de/ chos kyi sgo'i rgyud 'di grag07cing mngon par gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang de tsam du shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rnamatsha 7pa thams cad du (lhathams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang yon tan yang dag par bstsagasam pa'i chos kyi rgyud 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pas mnyan pa 'am/ mos par bya ba 'am / gzung bar yang rtemi nus na bsgom pa'i rnam par gesbyor bas brtson par 36wa 595

mi nus pa lta ci smos1tsho/ de bas na kye rgyal ba'i sras gang gis chos kyisari sgo'i rgyud 'di thos te thos nas mos par byed pa dang / mos par byas shing 'dzin pa dang /bsgom pa'i rnam pas dbartson par byed na/ sems can de dag ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sgo dang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang chos nyid thob pas/ phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing khrag khrig phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rnam pa drug dang ltas chen po brtswa 4brgyad du g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chemar/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig /kun tu shig shig go/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang chos nyid rab tu thob pas lha rdzas kyi 'phreng ba'i nesprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi gos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo / /lha rdzas kyi gdugs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo / /lha rdzas kyi ba dan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba dang glu'i dbyangs kyi sprin gyi sgra mngon par sgrog go/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i 8 thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la mngon par bstod pa'i glu'i 9dbyangs kyi sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 1 mngon par sgrog go/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 11gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas su lha'i 12rgyal po dbang bsgyur 1 gyi gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che'i snying por ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams 36wa 596

cad du yang 7phyogs bcu rgyas par gang zhing chos bstan pa 'di yang thams cad du byung bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi bzhing khrag khrig phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed chosaphyogs bcu5gergyas par byed cing lhags te de dag phyin nas kyang 'di skad ces zer ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid 'di brjod pa legs so legs bso/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar ming5nyamathun pa sha stag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i dpal zhes bya ba (3)nas de bzhin gshegs pal mtshan rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dag gi drung nas 'dir lhags te/ 'jig rten gyi 9)khams de dag thams cad na 1 riyang chos bstan pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor gyi rnam pa 'di 'dra ba dag la tshig 'di dag nyid dang yi ge 'di dag nyid dang khong du chud par bya ba 'di dag nyid dang ske/ don 'di nyid lhag chad med par mngon par brjod de 'byung bar gyur 31torka/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang dbang du gyur pa sha stag /sangs rgyas kyi hu mthus 'khor 'dir phyin to3ge/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'jig rten gyi mukhams 'dir bdag cag ji ltar phyin pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi 15khams re re'i gzhan 'phrul dbang nyizhe byed kyi gnas kyi lha'i rgyal po dbang bsgyur 1 gyi gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che'i snying por yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khrag khrig phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyin par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos/ phyogs bcur bltas te 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bltas nas/ chos kyi dbyings la rnam par blta 18ba dang / thams cad 36—597

mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sems bskyed pa yang dag par brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yul yang dag par bstan pa dang / spyod pa'i stobs yongs su sbyangs pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par bsgrub patubarjod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dri ma selakhub dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nye bar bsgrub pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi rgyan yongs su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan rab tu brjod pasnyebyed cing sa'i don 'di yang brtag par bya ba dang / bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhi dang dul dga' zhi zhing dul ba'i yid ldan la/ /nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra༄bar snangasnyimakha' dang mtshungasatso'adra zhing / /tha ba'i dri ma rnam sbyangasashelam rnams shes gnas pa'i(mi / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i khyad par rab la7nyon/ /bskal pa bye bar dge ba brgya stong rab bsags shing / /sangs rgyas brgya stong drang srong chen po mchod byas te/ /dbang bsgyur hu )rnams dang rang rgyal mtha' yas mchod byas nas/ /'gro ba kun la phan phyir byang chub sems skye'o/ /brtul zhugs〈 tedaka' thub dka'apha spyad dul bzod ldan gyur la/ /khrel yod dpal gyis spyod ldanatshwanyen shes dge 'phags shing / /blo gros rig yangs7sangs rgyas ye shes sems ldan gyi/ /byang chub sems rab mirgyal ba'i stobs dang mnyam 'dra skyes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ji snyed mchod rab mchod pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i dbyings tshad zhing rnams thams cad yongs su sbyong / /chos rnams thams cad ji snyed de dag mnyam rtogs nyi 7pas/ /'gro ba dgrol ba'i don du byang chub sems skye'o/ /gzhal yas sems skyes sa mchog rab tu thob gyur nas/ /sdig pa thams cad 36—598

bsal phyir rdul med rab tu dga'/ /smon lam stobs dpyad ①dkar chos yang dag bstsagasashebyas nas/ /snying rje brtsesaldan sa yisnyigong ma yongs su gnon6)//'gro phyir byams sems tshul khrims thos dang yon tan ldan/ /dri med dri bral rang bzhin yang dag bsam pa yis④/ /'jig rten thams cad me'ugasum 'bar bar mthong gyur nas/ /gsum pa rnam〈peyangs blo yis 'gro ba'i don du gnon⑩ / /sdug bsngal mi rtagarwartend pa zug rngus mi bde ba'i/ /khams gsum rtag tu sdug bsngal brgya yi hunyeme 'bar bas/rte/ /'dus byas nyes mthong rgyal ba'i legs pa mngon mos shing / /ye shes 'od 'phro yangs ldan 'od 'phro yod pa gnon / /dran dang blo ldan lam gyi ye shes thob gyur cing / /sa mchog de la sangs rgyas brgya 8stong bsnyen bkur nas/ / mi yi gtso skobo'i yon tan rtag tu dran byed cing / /'gro ba kun gyis thub dka' rgyal bar dka' ba gnon/ /ye shes blo gros thabs dang shes rab blo dpyod pas/ /'gro don mtha' yas sna tshogs bya ba bsten byas shing / /stobs bcu 32mchod pa sems can don rnams bsgrubs〈nyebyas te/ /mi skye mngon sum mtha' yas sa drug yongs su gnon/ /'jig rten kun tu 'gro bas shes dka' spyod byed cing / /bdag bral byed med yod dang med pa rnam bstsal5) ba'i/ /rang bzhin stong chos yan lag bcu gnyis rab 'byung zhes/ /phra zhing rno ba'i sems ldan bdun pa yongs su gnon/ /thabs dang shes rab sems yangs rab tu thob gyur cing / /ring du song ba gdul dka' ring du song ba gnon/ /rang bzhin dul zhing zhi phyir du ma'i sems spangs te/ /de nas nam mkha' tsuna'adra ba'i〈 mi g.yo yongs su gnon/ /de la mkhas pa'i ye shes las rnams sna tshogs phyir/ /zhi ba de las bslang zhing 36—599

mi yi 1mchog tu bsnamasan/ /dbang bcu ldan zhing 'jig rten yang dag nyid dpyod pa'i/ /rang bzhin chen po )'gro phyir legs pa'i blo gros gnon/ /'di la shin tu phra bar 'jig rten kun dpyad cing / /sems can thibs po'i spyod ldan nyon mongs las dpyad de/ /de dag gdul ba'i spyod pasamagayon tan mang po gnon/ /bde gshegs mdzod thob don gyi dam pa rab tu ston/ /dkar chos rim gyis de 'dra'i spyod dang 45ldan gyur pas/ /sa dgu'i bar du bsod nams ye shes tshogs thob cing / /rgyal ba rnams kyi stobs mchog don dam mngon 'dod pa/ /ye shes yon tan dbang bskur sangs rgyas kun las 'thob⑥//brgya stong phrag bcu'i ting 'dzin grangs med gang yod pa/ /spyod yul shes pa chemacho 3 nyid shes yangs thob gyur nas/ / de yi 8)rjes la thams cad mkhyen par ḍādabang bskur 'thob1 / /yul yangs ting 'dzin de dag thos pa de mi sgulanya/ /gang tshe de yis kun mkhyen dbang bskur thob pa'i tshe/ /pad mo rgya chen rin chen kun gyis brgyan 12pa 'byung / / de yi 12tshul mthun lus kyi dbus 〉su gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis 15yongs bskor de la lta zhing gnas/ / de yitshasa'od gzer 1 khrag khrig mtha' yas stong phrag mang / /phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun kyang zhi bar byed/ / mgo yi 1 gtsug nas 'od gzer 37bye ba stong byung zhing / /phyogs rnams na kun gyi mi yi 21gtso bo'i 'khor du rgyu/ /steng gi nam 22mkha'i dbyings la 'od gzer dra ba 2dganas/ /sangs rgyas mchod phyir brtson par rgyal ba'i 2 zhabs su 'dong 5/ /de'i 27tshe rgyal ba rnams dang ri morgyal sras 28rnams kyis na kyang / /chos rab don du rgyal sras dbang bskur thob dpar mkhyen / /mchod pa'i don du rgyal sras mtha' yas kun kyang 'ong01/ /des2tshe 36wa 600

kun mkhyen dbang bskur mi mchog mdzod spu nas/ /dbang bskur 'od gzer 1dam pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'od gzer namachog gis bskor zhing (spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub/ /gang tshe rgyal mchog bu yi 4thu bo srid mchog la/ /dbang bskur bzhin pa du sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kun nas g.yo bar 'gyur/ /mnar med bar gyi sdug bsngal de tshe ñtsa zhi zhing 'dug /gang tshe kun mkhyen dbang gis mngon par dbang bskur brka/ /de phyir mkhas pas chos sprin sa mchog thob ces bya/ /mkhas pa 'di la gnas pa'i shes rgyud tshad med de/ /sa rab 'di la gnas pa 'gro kun gtso yin no / /gzugs dang gzugs med de bzhin 'dod pa'i khams yangs dang / /sems can khams dang zhing dang chos khams yangs pa dang / /grangs dang grangs med nam mkha'i khams kyi bar du ste/ /chos dbyings yangs pa /thams cad ma nor khong du chud/ /'di la gnas 9pa mthu chen sprul pa'i las kun dang / /de bzhin byin rlabs rgyal ba'i ye shes phra ba dang / /mi mchog gsang ba bskal pa'i grangs rnams shes bya dang / /spa rtse 1 gcig tu 'jig rten khams rnams gzud pa /rjedang / / mi yi 3glegatso bo 1 'byung dang sku tshe 'tshang rgya dang / /'khor lo dam pa bskor dang mya ngan 'da' ba'i 1 rnams/ /thams cad rab shes gong 15du rnam thar zhi ba dag /sngan chad ma thob kun kyang de tshe rab tu 'thob/ /'di la gnas pa'i mthu chen sargyal ba'i chos kyi sprin/ /thams cad khong du chud byed dran pas kun kyang 'dzin/ /klu rnams kun gyi sprin char rgya mtsho 'dzin pa ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i chos sprin char chen kun kyang 'dzin/ /rgyal ba gcig las chos gang mthu chen des thob pa/ /de la phyogs bcu mtha' yas zhing gi sems 36—601

can rnams/ /thams cad bde gshegs nyan thos thos patu'adzin gyur kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'akhuthos pa'i grangs char mnyer mi 'gro/ /ye shes spyod pa'i stobs kyis sngan cadamagaspyad pa'i mthus/ /skad cig yud tsam gcig tu khrag khrig zhing bkang zhing / /bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs0)nyon mongs kun kyang zhi bar byed / /de phyir rgyal bas 'di ming chos kyi sprin ces gsungs/ /'di nas mthu chen lha yi tha'ajig rten gtsor gyur pa'i/ /phyogs rnams kun tu mi yi gtso bo'i9)yul yang ston/ /rnam 'phrul khrag khrig stong phrag du ma yang ston te/ /byang chub spyod pa de sems 'gro ba myos par 'gyur8)/ /mkhas pa legs ldan 'di gnas gom pa bor ba tsam/ /sa dgu'i bar du gnas pas0)shes par mi nus na/ /sems can gzhan gyis shes par mi 'gyur smos ci nyi byedagos/ /dus gsum nyan thos rang rgyal kun gyis de bzhin no/ /'di gnas nyamathams cad mkhyen par 'gro ba kun la ston/ /shes pas 12dus gsum kun tu thogs med zhi 3 chos can/ /zhing rnams kun tu rgyas bkang 1 chos rnams kun gyi bar/ /rgyal ba kun gyisnyiyon tan brjod cing ston pa 7byed/ /mkhas pa 'di la gnas pa sangs rgyas mchod byed cing / /phyogs rnams kun tu zhing dang 3 rmechos kyi dbyings bkang ste/ /rgyal ba mngon du mchod pas mchod byed 'phrogs rdzo/8pa med/ /yon tan kun ldan sa yi lha yi nyu7lha zhes bya/ /mkhas pa 'di gnas shes rab snang bas 'gro kun gyi tshol/ /mun pa kun bstsal 21chos kyi tshul yang rab tu ston/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i mthu yis 'gro ba'i 'dod chags sel/ /de bas rgyal sras nyon mongs sel la mkhas zhes 22bya/ /'di la gnas pa de dag khams gsum dbang phyug 'gyur/ /ye shes tshul shes theg pa gsum po ston la mkhas/ /skad cig yud tsam cig〈 ge36wa 602

gis ting 'dzin gcig min thob①/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rgyal ba'i dam pa gcig min ston/ /'di ni bdag gis rgyal sras sa rnams mdor bstan gyi/ /rgya cher mibaskal pa brgya phrag stong gis bstan mi nus45ni/ /yon tan 'di 'dra'i sangs rgyas ye shes sa 'di la/ /gnas pa rtag tu ri yi 4)rgyal po bzhin mi g.yo/ /rgyal sras thog ma gtsug lag kun gyis mi g.yo ste/ /sman gyi rnam pa kun nas ri༄ri rgyal gangasalabazhin no/ /tshul khrims thos pas gnyis pa spos ngad spos dang 'dra/3)/ /rnam 'dal5nyeme tog ji bzhin gsum pa (7shes par bya/ /lam la mos bzhin mi 'khrugs 'od 'phro thob pa ste/ /drang srong gnas bzhin mkhas pa rnams kyi rten gyur pa'o/sto/ /gnod sbyin gnya' shing 'dzin bzhin bsam yas lnga pa thob/ /rta rna'i shing tog 'dra bar drug pa'i 'bras bu ste/ /bdun pa 32sa 'dzin klu bzhin shes 3nyerab chen pos7thob/ /khor g.yug dbang ldan bzhin du brgyad pa dbang can thobatso/ /dgu pa dri ma sel ba dpal 3 sgyucan lha min bzhin3she/ /bcu pa rgyal ba'i legs ldan ri rab lha gnas 'dra/ /dang po smon lam sngon 'gro gong ma tshul khrims tshogs/ /gsum pa spyod pa'i yon tan bzhi77pa gcig gi dngos/ /lnga pa dge mang drug pa shin tu zab pa'i dngos/ /brgyad pa blo gros yangs pa kun tu gcig min rgyan )/ /dgu pa (nyamakhas pa ye shes phra zhing zab dang ldan/ /'gro rgyud thams cad ye shes ldan pas rab tu gnon/ /bcu pa rgyal ba rnams las yang dag chos 'dzin te/ /rgyal sras spyod pa mi sgul 32rgya mtsho de 'dra'o/ /spyod pa bcu 'das thog ma'i sems rab skye bar 'gyur/ /dka' thub rtul —snyebs gnyis pa gsum pa bsam gtan gyis/ /dag 30pas bzhi pa shin tu byang bas lnga pa'o / /drug pa rnon pos rtogs pa bdun pa mi phyed sa(lta/ /brgyad pa mthu chen 36wa 603

rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan ldan pa tsho1)yin/ /dgu la 2ye shes ldan pas thibs po'i〈 ge)spyod pa shes/ /bcu la rgyal bas dbang bskur ci rgyal po dbang thob bzhin/ /yon tan rin chen dag pas de bzhin rim 5du 'phar/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi zhing rnams bshig 6ste bgrang bar nus/ /rnam 7shes gcig gis 'gro ba kun sems shes par rung / /nam mkha'i dbyings kun skra yis gzhal bar nus srid kyi/ /rgyal ba'i 8yon tan bskal pa khrag khrig 9bshad mi nus/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mngon par gnang ste/yid dga' bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying pos de skad ces smras 3 pa dang / bcom ldan 'das gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i nang na bzhugs shing mngon par sangs rgyas nas ring por 11ma lon te/ zhag bdun pa gnyis la bab pa'i tshe lha'i rgyal po dbang byed kyi gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che'i snying po can 1 na bzhugs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i snying pos bshad pa la mngon par dgyes pa mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i (snye'akhor de dag thams cad dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon 'dang /dbang phyug chen po dang / gtsang ma'i ris su gtogs pa'i 'khor bothams cad kyang mngon par dga'o/ /pos bcu'i le'u ste sum cu 1 gcig pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/12 bam po nyi shu gnyis pa19/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 3 )la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la sogs 31pa 36wa 604

thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la gnas pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu dang thabs gcigs3tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid du/ phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'khod pa bcu 'thonas5)par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor seng guge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan lagyi snying po can la 'khod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas pa sha stag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu snang ba'i 5rimadzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zab mo'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal kyi gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi sne)snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin sgra zab mo 7 rnam pa tha dad pa'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 8mi phyed pa'i gtsug gi 9rimadzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gi lam myi 1 g.yo bar kun tu 'gro ba'i 'od gzer 31snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grags pa snyan pa 1 kun tu rnam par 36—605

grags pa'i 'od kyi 07gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi ②snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ri'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i 'od zerasnyesnang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas blta ba'i gzugs rnam par dmigs pa'i 'od gzer ④gyi rgyal po snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po stobs bcu rnam par dag pa thub pa med pa'i 'od gzerapo/snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba dang55)/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag de ltar 'thon57ma thag tu de'i mod la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po ma gtogs par byang chub sems dpa'i⑧'khor de dag thams cad kyang langs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'aphrochen po kun tu bzang po'i 'od ma gtogs par 'od thams cad kyang mi snang bar gyur te/ / )thams cad kyang zil gyis gnon51par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos kyi dbyings thams cad tu rgyas par khyab pa mang po'ang mngon par byung bar gyur te/ 'di ltar spos kyi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa byed 3nyepa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par tshibab par gyur tol/ /me tog gi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad ⑩rgyas par khyab pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i chatshaskyemangon par bab par gyur to/ /byug pa'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa nyu2bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char tsho/temangon par bab par gyur to/ /gdugs kyi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba02 36wa 606

khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /gos kyi sprin0/chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /rin po che'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /rgyal mtshan gyi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /ba dan gyi sprinanechos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa7bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag pa'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pasabye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi5nyechar mngon par bab par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin mchos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to / /'od gzera' gyi dra ba snang ba chen po'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa nibye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal med khang gi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa 6)bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par phye ba'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan snang ba'i gos kyi sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char mngon par bab par gyur to / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi seng ge'i khri mang po de dag las byang chub sems dpa' re re'i seng ge'i khri'i rgyan rin po che rnam par 36—607

dag pa re re dang dmyigs yipa mang po de dag thams cad las dmigs pa re re las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam bklas pa thams cad yongs su snang bar gyur tol/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad las dmigasam55)pa re re zhing yang sems can gyi khams 'byam bklas pa thams cad yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad las dmyigs pa re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa 'byam ra klas pa thams cad yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad las dmigs pa re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' 'byam 0klas pa thams cad yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad las dmigs pa re re zhing yang dus 'byamalo7klas pa thams cad yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad dus las dmigs pa re re zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 9'byam 1 klas pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa sangs rgyas 'byung 11ba dang bcas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang bcas pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ sems can 'dul ba dang bcas pa / ming gi 12'khor lo dang bcas pa/ mang po yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' 1 de dag gis sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i dus dag tu 'jig rten gyi khams gang dang gang du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad 14par gyur pa de dag kyang yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi 15zhabs kyi drung na/ 'khod cing pha rol tu phyin pa 17thams cad yongs su sbyong bas yang yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /dmigs pa mang po de dag thams cad las 36wa 608

dmyigs pa re re zhing yang gyo)phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i dus kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam tsho klas pa brjod du med pa'i yang ribarjod du med pa sangs rgyas 4)skye ba dang bcas pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi 45dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ sems can 'dul ba dang bcas pa/ ming gi 'khor lo dang bcas pa mang po yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' nede dag gi naphyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i dus dag tu 'jig rten gyi khams gang du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod rinapar gyur pa 9de dag kyang yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi zhabs kyi drung na 'khod cing pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyong ba labyed pa dag kyang yongs su snang bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'di snyam du gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 11glas pa ni gang 12dang gang nas lhags/de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang dang gang gi 1 zhabs kyi drung nas phyin snyam ste1 /byang chub sems dpa'i 1ge'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag lhags ni 1logang nas lhags/'jig rten gyi 1 khams 'byam 1/klas pa ni gang shed nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang zhig gis17zhabs kyi drung nas 'dir phyin/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 5 ride bas na khyed 21nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag 'jig rten gyi 36wa 609

khams ni gang nas lhags/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang gi0)zhabs kyi drung nas phyin pa yongs su brtagatshanadapa dang / yongs su dpyad pasnyigyis shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med pa'i mig gis kun tu 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thams cad kyi 4rjes su song ba zhes bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba dang / mngon par shes pa thams cad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba dang / dmigs pa thams cad bshin tu rnam par phye ba'i snying po zhes bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dang 'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi gzhi rab tu rtogs pa zhes bya ba dag la mnyam par gzhagashone)go//de ltar de dag la sogasam pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu la byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang mnyam par gzhag 8ste/ kun gyis byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gzhan dang gzhan sha stag la mnyam 9par gzhag bo kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa de dag 31kyang ma mthong / de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi zhabs kyi drung na byang chub sems dpa' de dag tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyodatshwa pa de dag kyang ma mthong nas/ting nge 'dzin de dag las langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa 1 bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu la mnyam par gzhag r+shakyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 'aklas pa de dag kyang ma mthong / byang chub sems dpa' de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gi zhabs kyi drung na tshangs par spyod pa'i de 36—610

bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang ma mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos/ yang byang chub sems dpa'i ①'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /da dung du byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam miklas pa gang nas lhags pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi sne/zhabs kyi drung nas lhags pa brtags④par gyis shig dpyad par gyis shig /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam rgyaklas pa de dag ni mthong bar dka'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gi zhabs kyi drung na byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod sti pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang de bas kyang shin tu mthong bar dka'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag las byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu laphra ba snyed la mnyam par gzhagashego/ /de ltar mnyam par gzhagamatho)kyang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams7klas pa de dag kyang ma mthong / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gi zhabs kyi drung na byang chub sems dpa' de dag tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang ma mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ting nge 'dzin de dag las langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag tsho1byang chub sems dpa' re res byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la mnyam par gzhagatshwanyekyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam nyi klas pa de dag kyang ma mthong ngo / /gangatsha8gi zhabs kyi drung na byang chub sems dpa' de dag tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod 36—611

pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang 3rim mthong ngo / /de (gunas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po stan de las nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phags te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ri nothams cad la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 47)de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chags pa mi mnga' ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa dus gsum mtshungs paras mnyam par 65'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 7noklas pa thams cad kun tu khyab pa chos kyi dbyings 2khongs su chud pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa 'di la ltos shig dang de la 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam (9riklas pa thams cad kyang gzugs brnyan du gyur par snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byam nya klas pa thams cad kyang 11gzugs brnyan du gyur par 32snang ngo ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'byam 1 klas pa thams cad kyang gzugs brnyan du gyur par sasnang ngo / /sems can gyi khams 'byam tshoklas pa thams cad kyang gzugs brnyan du gyur par lasnang ngo / /lam gyi rgyud 'byam 1 tshoklas pa thams cad kyang gzugs brnyan du gyur par 1 snang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bas na khyod kyis 19rang gi lus kun tu lta ba'i myig dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs la shes rab kyi mig nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas par byin gyis rlob ste sku/ ye shes yangs pa'i mig dmigs pa thams cad kyi rjes su song la 21khong du chud par gyis la 22phyogs 'byam 2 klas pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byin gyis rlob ste / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku thams cad du mi gnas pa 'di la gnas pa 25thams cad yongs su bstsal ba'i lta bas ltos ni shig /mngon par 36—612

zhen pa thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa dang srid pa thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang shin tu phra ba'i tshul gyis stobs bcu'i stobs yongs su non pa dang ske/ dmigs pa chung ngu la rgya chen por 'jug pa'i blta 17bas ltos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i〈sakun tu bzang po'i gdams gengag gebazhin du thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas sems shing rtoga'agepa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil gnyis kyi 6)'khor lo rtsibs stong yod 3)pa la 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba yod pa mthong bar gyur tenini/ 'jig rten gyi khams de na de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyan gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu snang ba mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu 7—skuphra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan 0gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs byin pa hu1ri dgas lha e na 32ya'i byin pa lta bu gnyis la 'jig rten gyi khams chags pa med pa'i snying po can 6zhes bya ba yod de de na de bzhin tsho/snyegashegs pa 'od rgya mtsho chags pa med cing dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho miskyong ngo / /chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' zab mo'i nyu mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 36—613

kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te/ 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs pus mo gnyis kyi 3)lha nga 5la 'jig rten gyi khams sa le mesgam yod pa zhes bya ba yod de de na de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'bar ba 3)dam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas55)byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi gzi brjid 59)mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'ishe'akhor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te/'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyisnyisnying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ste ༄9)zur gyi dkyil 'khor la 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyi snying po can ⑩zhes bya ba yod de/ de na (tede bzhin gshegs pa dge ba sna tshogs kyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs tu shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' hunyespyin sgra zab mo rnam pa tha dad pa'i mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku lte ba'i dkyil 'khor skon 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang ba'i snying po can 15zhes bya ba yod de de na de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid kyi tshargyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje mi phyed pa'i gtsug gi 36wa 614

mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba chakhrag khrig brgya stong phrag 95bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis gebaskor cing mdun du byas te ④'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs /snyin 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi 'od gzer59)snying po zhes bya ba yod de / de na de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi be'u rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' ngag gi lam mi g.yo bar kun tu 'gro ba'i 'od gzer 9)snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pas brgyan pa'i rinanasnying po can la 'dug go//bcom ldan 'das kyi sku phrag pa'i lhun gnyis la 'jig rten gyi khams gser yod pa zhes bya ba yod de de na de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'bar ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' grags pa snyan par kun tu rnam par grags pa'i 'od kyi gzi 6)brjid kyi tsomadzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tu)phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis the bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas/ seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi 12snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal gyi gsung gi dbyangs la 'jig 36—615

rten gyi khams rin po che sna tshogs zhes tu bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od gzer nadapag tu med pa'i gzi brjid kyis rab tu brgyanas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' cari'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i 'od gzer gerisnang ba'i gzi brjid kyi dzimadzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi smin mtshams na 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dus gsum du mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' kunas kyinas blta ba'i gzugs rnam par dmigs pa'i 'od gzer 8)gyi rgyal po snang ba'i gzi brjid mdzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'im499'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te/ 'ongs nas seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu 1 la 'jig rten gyi khams gzhi spyi'u tshugs kyi lhun yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i me tog brtsegs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chos ston to/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' stobs bcu rnam par dag pa thub 36—616

pa med pa'i 'od gzer 3)snang ba'i gzi brjid kyi namadzod kyi snying pos byung ba zhes gebya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te 'ongs nas/ seng ge'i khri chags pa med pa'i rgyan gyi snying po can la 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sade dag dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong bar gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad las byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po la stsogs 5)pa ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang gzungs chos thams cad kyi sa las stsogs 46)pa gzungs sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thob par gyur to ci/ /byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdul dang bral ba'i snying po la sogs napa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad las byang chub sems dpa' 9 re res kyang stobs kyi glog la sogs 1 tshopa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi glog11 /sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thob par gyur to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag chos kyi sgo 'di dag ni 12bsam pa rdo rje dam pa lta bur byas te/ yongs su chub 1 par bya'o/ /rim gro chen po dang ldan pa'i bsam pas yongs su bsrung bar bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras mchos 36wa 617

kyi sgo 'di tsho ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams ma gtogs par gzhan gyi rna lam du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos de skad ces smras pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag yid dga' ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos smras pa la mngon par dga'o/ /②kun tu bzang pos bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //snyebacom ldan 'das thog ma mngon par sangs rgyas pa pho brang 'od thams cad kyi snying po can na de bzhin du mnyam par gzhags par bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan khrag khrig brgya'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thams cad kyis myi phyed pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas thob pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku shin tu dag pa dang / gnas med pa la rten pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku0dang mi gnyis pa'i zhi gnas dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / tshad myed par khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid dang mi gnas pa'i bsam gtan gyi rgyud dang 'gro ba thams cad kyis rnam par dmigs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lta57ba dang dus la bab pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang skad cig gcig gis byung ba'i mtshan nyid med pa la spyod pas bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'aphrodabang bskur ba byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa la rab tu tsoganas pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyis 31byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kun tu lta ba rab tu thob pa 'gro ba 36—618

thams cad 3)bde bar byed pa'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pan / bdud kyi dpung thams cad rab tu 'joms (mi pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par bsgrub ④pa 'gro ba thams cad ⑤rab tu zhi bar gnas 6)pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa mi gnas pa la rtso)gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i gtsug nidang gzhal du med pa'i blo gros dang / zhi ba'i blo gros dang gtong ba'i blo gros dang / klu'i blo gros dang thob pa'i blo gros dang / sbyin pa'i blo gros dang stobs kyi blo gros dang bsam gyis (myi khyab pa'i blo gros dang chags pa med pa'i blo gros dang / mchog gi blo gros dang lha'i blo gros dang /mchod sbyin byas pa'i blo gros dang mthu'i blo gros tshedang / don gyi blo gros 11dang chos la dad pa'ilo blo grosasngortedang / chos kyi blo gros dang zhi ba'i blo gros dang /nam mkha'i blo gros dang / skad cig gcig gi blo gros dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / sdom pa'i blo gros dang / samakha'i blo gros dang / stobs kyi blo gros dang ske/ glang po'i blo gros dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu'i blo gros dang / don rnam par dmigs pa'i blo gros dang / dam pa'i blo gros dang / ye shes snang ba'i blo gros dang / 'phags pa'i blo gros dang dran pa'i rgyan dang / dngos po med pa'i mthar phyin pa dang / rang bzhin gyi rgyan dang yul zab mo dang gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas pa dang / klu'i 'od dang snang ba 'dzin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi rim gro la brtson pa dang / sems kyi rgyal po dang spyod pa gcig pa dang mngon par shes pa mnyams pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dang yon tan 'byung gnas dang chos kyi sgron ma dang / 'gro ba'i bdag po dang /12 'gro ba 36—619

'dzin pa dang / bde ba byed pa dang mchog tu gyur pa dang bla na med pa dang mnyam pa med pa dang 'dra ba med pa dang / 'od thogs pa med pa 1dang /'od rab tu snang ba dang / grags 2pa'i 'od dang / shin tu rnam par snang ba dang lag pa brtan pa dang / chos kyi char pa dang thig le dam pa dang / ye shes kyi mig dang chos kyi mig dang / shes rab kyi sprin dang sa'i rgyal po dang smon lam khyad par du thogs pa med 4pas 'gro ba dang / ye shes kyi 5snying po dang bsam pa'i rgyal po dang nang gi blo gros 0yang dag par grub pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul dang / sa'i stobs kyis rnam par gnon pa dang sa dang 7stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa 'dzin pa dang zla ba bzang po dang ri bo chen po'i 8dpal dang / rin po che chen po'i dpal dang bar snang gi rgyud dang / khams chen po'i rgyal po dang dkyil 'khor mnyam pa 9khong du chud pa dang / gzi brjid gzhan gyis mi 'pham 1 pa dang / klu chen po 11lta ba'i dpal dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang 12tshul dang phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo 1 yang dag par 'dzin pa'i dpal dang / dran pa'i yul nyams pa med pa dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i blo gros kyis rnam par rtogs pa dang mtha' dang dbus 1 med pa'i blos 15rnam par rol pa dang / mdzod zad mi shes pa dang /ye shes nyi ma'i dpal dang / chos kyi nyi ma dang / ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i snying po dang / blo dam pa'i char 'bebs pa dang / kun tu lta tshab dang /blta na don yod pa dang rdo rje 1 mngon par shes pa dang / ye shes rdo rje'i blo gros dang kun tu mig gi dpal dang / sangs rgyas kyi don gyi nyi ma dang sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje yang dag par gzung ba'i bsam pa dang byang chub sems dpa' 36—620

sems dpa' chen po mig gi yul kun tu ye shes kyi rgyan dang / de dag la sogs ༷11pa byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyeda' kun kyang sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba la grogs su gyur pa sha stag dang thabs gcig go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar rinas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te / bcom ldan 'das gang na 5ba der thal mos btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te bdag gis zhus nas zhus pa'i lung bstan par bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye bar gnang na/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las tshophyogs gcig cig zhu'o/ /de 0)skad ces gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu mig la 'di skad ces bka' stsal 8to/ /kun tu mig khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang ngas dris pa de dang / de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems tshim par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal 9pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun 1 pa bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin dang 11/ rnam par thar pa du ma 1 dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i sgo dang /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam du ldan pa 1 rnams ting nge 'dzin dang rnam par thar pa la snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang ba lags/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyi gnas 'thob pa lags/ byang chub sems dpa'i 1 ting nge 36—621

'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa la snyoms par 'jug pa dang rnam par ldang ba la mkhas pa rgyun mi 'chad pa 'thob pa lags/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyinyekhyu mchog gi mthu dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang ldan pa lags de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig la 'di skad ces bka' stsalas to/ /kun tu mig khyod kyis de ltarashe'adas pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dngasangs/ da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'dingo5)'dri bar bsamar0pa legs so legs so/ /kun tu mig de bas na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog gis(8)mthu bsgrub par ('onodaka' ba dang ldan pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa tshad med pas mngon par byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa la 11shin tu bslabs pa byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam bsgrub hu par dka' bas rnam par sbyangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung ba nyu phyir mi ldog pa dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul mtha' yas pas rnam par sbyangs pa/ gzungs 'thob par bya ba mu med pa dang ldan pa tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa/ zad mi shes pas thogs pa myed par rnam7par dag pa/ 'gro ba 12thams cad la skyo ba myed pa thob 7pa'i snying rje chen pos phyirwa snama'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i smon lam dang ldan pa/ 'di 'khor 'dirarwage'adus te/'dug pa yin gyis nyu7de la dris shig dang / ting nge 'dzin dang rnam par 'phrul pa ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i rdo )'khor de dag gis tebyang chub 36wa 622

sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i ming thos ma thag0)tu/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon du gyur to/ /chagasakhepa med pa'i sems rnam par phye bas kyang byin gyis brlabs par gyur to/ /ye shes bsamadzabagyis mi khyab par 'jug par bya ba la 'angarang)rab tu gzhol b.ralgigyur to/ /ye shes mi 'phrogs7pa'i spyod yul yang rab tu byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa mthong zhing rnam par dmyigs pa ri7/yang mngon du gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad med pa yangashīkhong du chud par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang rgyud kyi tshul gcig pa yang rjes su rtogs par gyur to/ /dus gsum mtha' yas pa la 'jug pa yang khong du chud par gyur to/ /bsod nams zad mi shes pa'i byin yang57thob par gyur to/ /rnam par 'phrul pa bzang po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'ang khong du chud par gyur nas/ de dag thams cad kyis 7rim gro dang bcas shing rje sa 1rtodang bcas pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du lta 8bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs nyunyedang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rdzu 'phrul gyi khyu mchog gi mthus byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po yang ma mthong ske/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus kyang bom mthong /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po gang na gnas pa'i stanasnyiyang ma mthong ngo ske/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po da lta ga la mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 3 pa/ kun tu mig she'akhor 'di nyid na nga'i zhabs kyi drung na 'dug 17go/ /nga'i zhabs kyi drung na 36—623

spyod do/ /nga'i zhabs kyi drung nasamagyo)ma g.yos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag thams cad kyis/yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kun tu bzang po de ma mthong ngo / /de'i lus kyang ma mthongs de'i stan yang ma mthong ngo ske/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus ma mthong zhing stan ma mthong ba ni/de de bzhin te lus so de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de ni brjod du med cing zab pa la gnas pa ste/ 'di ltar ye shes kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa la gu'ajug pa la zhugs pa'o/ /seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul bla na med pa rab tu thob pa'o/ /chags pa med pa'i mthas ④rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rabacus grub pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings dam pa'i las du/ dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs 7)la gnas pa'o/ /'das pa dang ma byon 8pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad dngam1)ye shes tha mi dad pa'i rgyun 1 dang ldan pa'o/ /'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'di ni sems skad cig gi mtha'i rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis de bzhin gshegs pa las kun tu bzang po'i yon tan rnam par dag pa thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu la mnyam par gzhag 11ste/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po tshonamangon par 'dod cing mthong bar bya ba dang /36—624

gsol ba gdab pa'i bsam pas tshol lo/ /yongs su tshol lo rab tu rtog go/ /shin tu zhib cing brtags par rnam par dpyod do/ /rjes su rtog go/ /rnam par lta'o༅7/ /'on kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ma mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag thams cad kyis kyang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin grangs ma mchis pa stong phrag bcu la mnyam par gzhag tsho ste/ rnam par bltas kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ma mthong ngo cu / /de'i lus kyi las kyang ma mthong ngo ri4/ /de'i ngag dang ngag gi ri'ilas kyang ma mthong ngo 6/ /de'i yid dang yid kyi 7las kyang ma namathong ngo 49)/ /de'i stan yang ma mthong ngo 1 / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po /1kun tu bzang po de gang na mchis pa dang spyod 32pa'i phyogs de yang ma mthong ngo bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun tu mig don 12de bzhin te/ khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de mi mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la shin tu bslabs pa ni 1 〉byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'o/ /kun tu mig de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i gzugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs mang po lha sgyu ma'i sngags kyi yi ge gang la gnas pa dmyigs par nus 15samal/ btsun nyu pa bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal518pa/ kun tu mig sgyu ma'i sngags kyi gzugs kyi19/ rnam pa de zhu )dag kyang dmigs shing bstan par mi nus na/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu 36wa 625

bzang po'i lus kyi spyod yul gsang ba dang / ngag gi spyod yul gsang ba dang /yid kyi spyod yul gsang ba la 'jug par mi nus pa dang / mthong bar mi nus pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'atukun tu bzang po ni zab cing / bsam gyis mi khyab par rnam par spyod7pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni tshad med cing tshad las 'das pa ste/ ye shes rdo rje'i blo dang ldan pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus7med pa la yang dag par gnas pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gnas med par spyod cing / sems can thams cad kyi lus dang gzugs kyi rjes su zhugs pa'o/ /blang ba med pa'i chos kyi tshul dang ldan pa'o/ /mi zad cing tha misridad pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang khyu mchog gi mthu la lhun gyis grub par gnas pa'i mthar phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni chos kyi dbyings khong du chud pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de ltar rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni blta na don yod pa'o/ /mnyan na 45don yod pa'o bsnyen bkur byed pa don yod pa'o / / bsam pa ri7)don yod pa'o rjes su dran pa don yod pa'o/ /de la dad par byas patre don yod pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de ni mthong b.lo don yod pa'o/ /thos pa nyi )don yod pa'o/ /bsnyen bkur ba don yod pa'o/ / bsam pa 31don yod pa'o/ /rjes su dran par byas pa don yod pa'o / /de la mos /2par byas pa don yod pa'o/ /blta bsngo don yod pa'o/ /brtags patshathudon yod pa'o/ /btsalamatshab don yod pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni rjes su smon lam gdab pa don yod pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu myig dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag 36—626

thams cad byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po hu)mthong bar 'dod cing /thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal zhing tshig 'di skadashebarjod do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad〈kyel phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la btud de phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor chen po de dag la bka' stsalasapa/ rigs kyi bu dag byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshol lasnyigasol ba thob shig /phyogs thams cad du mngon du gyis la kun tu mig gi las su byin gyis rlob stekho/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang posnyil dmigs pa gyis la/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad mngon tu bya ba'i sems kyis byin gyis brlab pa gyis te⑨/ chos thams cad 'dod chags dang bral bar khong du chud par gyis la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang smon lam gcig par5)byung ste/ gnyis su med pa la mnyam par zhog la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lus las mngon par byung bar byin gyis rlob ste32/dbang po tha mi dad pa'i rjes su 'brang bar gyis la/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam kun tu 'gro ba yongs su sbyang bar〈nyegyis shig dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal khyenyepa de skad hunyethos nas/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag dang bcas pas spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la gsol ba gtabatsobo/ /36wa 627

17byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsol ba gtabarkam thag tu/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gernam par thar pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa gang gis byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi zhe 5drung na gnas shing pad mo'i stan la 'dug par mthong bar 'gyur ba na dang / 'khor de'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus snyo las kyang 'byung bar snang ba dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'byam 7kyiklas pa dag nas kyang 'ong bar snang ba dang / sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad na ciyang dag par ston pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin 'orilas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rab tu brjod pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad rab tu ston pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi lam snang bar byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yang dag par ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba thams cad yang dag par brjod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa'i dus gsum rab tu ston pa de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa kun tu bstan to1 ri/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu myig dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag thams cad kyis rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong nas dga' zhing mgu ste/ 11rangs nas rab tu dga' zhing bde ba dang yid dga' ba skyes nas dmigs pa thams cad kyis btud pa'i rje sasalho /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal to/ / /de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi sarlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'/ de dag gemos pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'/ kun tu bzang po'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas sprin gyi 36wa 628

char stong phrag bcu mngon par bab par7gyur pa 'di lta ste/ me tog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ / spos sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /laspos kyi phye ma sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /gdugs sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /na〈 gebaza' sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /spos sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /snam bu rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa rnam pa༄drug tu g.yos so rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol bab thams cad kyi〈sgra mang po byung ngoshe/ /lha'i nga ro snyan pas8)mang po rab tu byung ngo ske/ /'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas1)snang ba chen pos khyab par snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sems can rnams 31rnam par dag par gyur to3rte/ /ngan song gi lam gyi rgyud gsum rnam paral zhi bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa rnam par dag par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la zhugs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' 3 brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la yongs su grub par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 36wa 629

pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas par gyur to6)/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skadakhuces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni/ bdag nyid che ba la mngon57par spyod pa'o/ /mtshungs pa ma mchis pa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /yongs su mi chodasnyipa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /slar mi ldog pa la rnam par spyod pa'o / /mnyam pa nyid rjes su rtogs pa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /gzhan gyis mi zloga'asnyepa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /chos thams cad tha mi dad pa la rnam par spyod pa'o / /chos thams cadapo)ma 'dres par rnam par spyod pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi byin gyi rlabasalgemakhas pa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni chos thams cad kyi dbang dang / ting nge 'dzin dang rnam par thar pa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsalas1)pa/ kun tu mig de khyod kyis ji skad du smras pa de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ni yon tanamanyagrangs med pas rnams12par dag pa'o/ /yon tan mtshungs pa med pas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /yon tan tshad med pas/ rin po che dang ldan pa'o/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'byung gnas rgya mcho'o/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yon tan mu med pa'i sprin to/ /yon tan sa mtshams 8med pas bsngags 6shing bstod pa'o/ /chos7rin po che zad mi shes pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po tini sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yon tan brjod cing bsngags pa mi zad nyu8pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal 6)to/ /kun tu 36—630

bzang po khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mig dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor thams cad la/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang ske/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin shinas①tu bstan pa gang gis 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa byung ba dang /'byung ba dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin bcu shin tu bstan pa la mkhas pas ting nge 'dzin rgya chen po bcu (mishin tu bstan pa spobs par khugyis shig /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya chen po la mkhas pa rab tu thob pa dngasnyi/ rjes su 'gro ba snang ba zhes bya ba dang ske/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya chen po rab tu thob pa yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ zhing 'byams⑤klas pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rjes su song ba dang / 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa gtsangasnyims spyod pa zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste 'das pa'i rgyan gyi snying po zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ ye shes rnam par snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rnam par bkod ⑧pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyan ces bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi lus tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi 7khams la dbang ba zhes bya ba dang / 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mchen po la mkhas pa rab tu thob pa bcu pa humachags pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba stenya/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin rgya chen posa'adi bcu ni/ 'das pa dang ma byon78pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de 36—631

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur ro//byang chub sems dpa' gang gis ting nge 'dzin bcu po 'di dag la0)bsten cing bsgoms te rimang du byas pa dang / dngos por byas pa dang / shes par byas pa dang / mngon du byas pa dang mdun du byas pa dang / mnyam par gzhag50pa dang / shin tu brtsams pa de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bcu po 'di dag dang ldan pas/ byang chub sems dpa' yin yang sangs rgyas zhes 4bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /stobs bcu pasnyizhes bya'o/ /'dren pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par 'dren pa zhes bya'o/ / thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ /ne thams cad gzigs pa zhes bya'o/ /chags pa med pa 3)la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /bsgribs 8pa myed pa'i spyod yul can zhes bya'o/ /chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob pa 9de ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rjes tu 3su song ba /1yang yin la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas phyir log pa'ang yin/sems can thams cad kyi khams su rab tu song ba'ang yin la sems can med pa'i mtha' yang khong du chud pa yin/ chags pa med pa'i lus kyi snying po'i rjes su song ba'ang yin la/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad la 32'jug par spyod pas12yin no1 / /chos kyi dbyings mtha' 1lhadang dbus lamed pas kyang rnam par dgatshwa tshol 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang rjes su 'brang ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chosarwashernam par mthong ba yang yin la/ spyod pa thams cad kyi yang nyu)rjes su song ba yin / dbyangs kyi yan lag dang yi ge la rab tu spobs shing / byang chub 36wa 632

sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas rnam par dag pa 'pho/yin la/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par phye ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la'ang rab tu gnas pa yin/ rtag par dus gsum skad cig tu/ zhugs pa'ang yin la dus gsumango thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir yang yang chadag par gzhol ba'ang (4)yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos ston pa yang yin la/thabs cigekyis chos thams cad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las phyir mi ldog pa'i lus dang yang56)ldan pa yin/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnam par 'tshang rgya bar bya ri ba'i tshul la yang rab tu zhugs la sangs rgyas gcig mngon par sangs rgyas pas8)/ sangs rgyas thams cad du'ang shin tu ston pa yin te/ 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos kyi 49rnam pa'i tshul lo/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi/ ye shes rnam par sbyangs pa'i7 5tshul lo/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal mtshan gzhan gyis mi pham 11pa'i tshul lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam gyi tshul lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 32mngon par shes pa rnon po dang / 'grogs pa'i tshul lo/ /gzungs dang spobs pa thams cad kyi tshul lo/ /dus gsum tha mi dad pa'i tshul lo/ /'das pa dang ske/ ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul lo/ /sems can thams cad thams cad snyemakhyen pa nyid la rab tu dgod pa'i tshul lo/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba'i khukhyu mchog gi tshamathu bstan pa'i tshul lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di dag thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 36—633

ni mthu mi7zad pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs thob pa yin no②/ /'pho ba med pa'i mthar thug par 'gyur ba'i phyirashenam mkha'i dbyings ltar tshad med pa yin / chos kyi rgyal srid la 'gro ba dbang bskur ba'i phyir dbang mtha' yas par bsgyur rtso)ba yin/ stobs bcu shin tu yangs pa'i tshul thob pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba thams cad du tshad med pa'i ye shes thob pa yin/ rab tu zhi ba'i mtha' la zhugs pas/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i sems rab tu bsgoms pa yin/ shugs dang ldan pa'i rtsal bdogasagepas snying rje chen po'i seng ge yin/ yon tan dang bsngags pa thams cad dang ldan pas chos kyi sgron ma la ⑥yang dag par gzhol zhing mi zad pa yin/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyishebasam gyis mi khyab pa yin/ chos shes shing khong du chud pas gnas kyi mthar phyin pa yin/spyod pa dngas2)rnam par gdagasaspyodapa dang / brda thams cad la sna tshogs su shin tu bstan pa byed par mkhas pa yin/ chos thams cad mtshan ma〈nyamed pa la nyusnyemakhas pa la zhugs pas/ mtshan ma med pa la mos pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnga' chen pos rnam par dag pas rigs dang / rgyud rnam par dag pa yin/ gzhi med pa la 'jugatshwa pa'i ye shes kyisatswachos kyi gzhi rab tu dbye ba'i snying po'i rjes su song ba yin/ chos yongs su gtong ba la brtson pas dus thams cad du mkhas pa dang ldan pa yin/ shes par bya ba thams cad khong du chud pas sems can gyi nang na mkhas pa yin/ skye dgu thams cad shin tu dag par7byed pas mtha' yas pa7rnam par sbyong batshwanyeyin/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnam par sangs rgyas pa dang / 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i spyod pa yang dag par ston pas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi〈nyedakyil 'khor gyi thabs la mkhas 36—634
